head: Chapter 18 — 因子化的破坏与非标准情形 / Breakdown of factorization and non-standard cases
box: 证明了：`prop:break-colour`（[R, R_PT]）；`prop:break-measurement`（[R, R_cond]，前提 `asm:appO-lcopt`）。
给出全阶论证：`thm:break-ddis`、`thm:break-double-dy`（[A]）。
破坏（附证据类型）：`thm:break-tmd`（模型反例）、`prop:break-spacelike`（显式单圈计算，振幅层次）、`prop:break-fss`、`prop:break-jet-veto`（显式反例）、`prop:break-hh-diffraction`（实验）（[V]）。
没有证明：超出 NNLO 的质量奇异性因子化（`prop:break-mass-singularity`，[C]）；有色末态的 DPS 与“口袋公式”（[C]）。

items.label: thm:break-tmd
items.title: 强子—强子末态强子的 TMD 因子化不成立
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: model calculations of a general method ("if methods fail in the model, they will also fail in QCD", C07); phenomenological size not established; the CQ mechanism could first give uncancelled divergences in partonic cross sections at N$^3$LO.
  - `\uses{prop:break-colour, def:break-generalized-tmd, rem:break-measurement-failures}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:break-tmd` — 强子—强子末态强子的 TMD 因子化不成立** [V] · v1 (+ refdoc S39)
  - **陈述.** **Standard TMD factorization fails** for TMD-sensitive observables in $h_1h_2\to H_1H_2X$: `CollinsQiu2007` (SSA, abelian model, one extra gluon: the T-odd coefficient is $g_1+2g_2$, not $g_1$, so no Wilson line of hadron 1 can represent it); `Collins2007` (unpolarized, abelian, two extra gluons; anomaly $4\pi^2g_2(g_2+g_1)\delta(l_1^+)\delta(l_2^+)$, VF-GLA-7). **Generalized TMD factorization fails** in a non-abelian theory (`RogersMulders2010`, double transverse-spin asymmetry): entanglement test $\sum_{X,Y}C(X,Y)=C_F^2+\frac{4T_F^2(N^2-1)}{N^2}\ne C_F^2$ (SU(3): $24/9$ vs $16/9$; c_glauber [C6]; VF-GLA-10; the attachment-sum form of `RogersMulders2010` eq. (34), our derivation of a known result); in the abelian case "actual = product" identically. **Survives** at the orders examined: collinear factorization ($\int d^2k_T(I_1+I_2)=0$). **Not affected:** SIDIS, DY, $e^+e^-\to h_1h_2X$. Further: `Rogers:2013zha`, `Vogelsang:2007jk`. Location in the App O framework: step (O-3) (`rem:break-measurement-failures`).
  - **证明.** Sketch reproducing the eikonal algebra (`ex:break-c07`).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: model calculations of a general method ("if methods fail in the model, they will also fail in QCD", C07); phenomenological size not established; the CQ mechanism could first give uncancelled divergences in partonic cross sections at N$^3$LO.
  - `\uses{prop:break-colour, def:break-generalized-tmd, rem:break-measurement-failures}`

items.label: prop:break-spacelike
items.title: 类空共线极限中严格共线因子化的失效
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit one-loop calculation. **The DY collinear theorem stays [A]** (M21: this does not show that PDF factorization fails).
  - `\uses{prop:sudakov-amplitude-factorization}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:break-spacelike` — 类空共线极限中严格共线因子化的失效** [V] · v1
  - **陈述.** (Amplitude level; critic O16.) For an incoming and an outgoing parton becoming collinear, the one-loop splitting amplitude depends on the colours of the non-collinear partons through $\mathbf T_2\cdot\mathbf T_3$ terms with $i\pi$ (`CataniDeFlorianRodrigo2012` eq. (68)); for $n\ge5$ (four coloured partons in the reduced $2\to2$ amplitude) $\mathbf T_2\cdot\mathbf T_3$ is not proportional to $1$; for three partons it is; the one-loop breaking term is anti-Hermitian and cancels in $2{\rm Re}\langle M_0|M_1\rangle$ (c_glauber §4.1–4.2; VF-GLA-12; order of first violation per level: c_glauber §4.3 table).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit one-loop calculation. **The DY collinear theorem stays [A]** (M21: this does not show that PDF factorization fails).
  - `\uses{prop:sudakov-amplitude-factorization}`

items.label: prop:break-mass-singularity
items.title: 超出 NNLO 的质量奇异性因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** CdFR predict possible "entangled" logarithms from N$^3$LO (e.g. small-$Q_T$ dihadron/dijet); `Becher:2024kmk`: three-loop active–active Glauber terms restore consistency with PDF factorization below the veto scale (by the authors' own account not a proof); no general statement is proven; status separation as in `prop:jets-sll`; the amplitude-level violation `prop:break-spacelike` ([V]) motivates the question but is not a premise.
  - `\uses{def:pdf-quark, def:pdf-gluon}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:break-mass-singularity` — 超出 NNLO 的质量奇异性因子化** [C] · v1
  - **陈述.** Mass singularities of hadron-collider cross sections factorize into PDFs beyond NNLO.
  - **地位与缺口.** CdFR predict possible "entangled" logarithms from N$^3$LO (e.g. small-$Q_T$ dihadron/dijet); `Becher:2024kmk`: three-loop active–active Glauber terms restore consistency with PDF factorization below the veto scale (by the authors' own account not a proof); no general statement is proven; status separation as in `prop:jets-sll`; the amplitude-level violation `prop:break-spacelike` ([V]) motivates the question but is not a premise.
  - `\uses{def:pdf-quark, def:pdf-gluon}`

items.label: prop:break-fss
items.title: Coulomb 相位与软交换不对易导致的共线因子化破坏
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (amplitude/strict-factorization level, three loops); connection `prop:jets-sll`; PDF factorization of the cross sections themselves: [C].
  - `\uses{prop:break-spacelike, prop:jets-sll}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:break-fss` — Coulomb 相位与软交换不对易导致的共线因子化破坏** [V] · v1
  - **陈述.** `ForshawSeymourSiodmok2012`: the breakdown in gap-between-jets-type cross sections is driven by the non-commutation of Coulomb/Glauber exchanges with other soft exchanges; colour pattern (c_glauber §4.2; VF-GLA-9, VF-GLA-12, VF-GLA-13): the tripole $\langle M|f_{abc}\mathbf T_i^a\mathbf T_j^b\mathbf T_k^c|M\rangle=0$ for real colour vectors (pure-QCD tree); $\langle M|[A,D]|M\rangle=0$ (no two-loop Coulomb × eikonal term); $\langle M|[D,[D,A]]|M\rangle\ne0$ at three loops (the SLL structure).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (amplitude/strict-factorization level, three loops); connection `prop:jets-sll`; PDF factorization of the cross sections themselves: [C].
  - `\uses{prop:break-spacelike, prop:jets-sll}`

items.label: prop:break-jet-veto
items.title: 对多重部分子相互作用敏感的观测量
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit model counterexample (Zeng); `Gaunt2014` shows that the CSS argument fails at two spectator–spectator Glauber gluons and only suggests a violation; `Schwartz:2018obd` contradict only the pure-Glauber part (their argument does not apply to doubly differential observables, so the $\Delta p_\perp$ mechanism of `RothsteinStewart2016` §11.1 and Zeng's model lie outside its scope) — never cite Gaunt without SYZ (S58); which graphs violate first is not settled (c_glauber §1.6 item 3); in the measurement criterion these observables do not commute with the light-cone evolution.
  - `\uses{prop:break-measurement}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:break-jet-veto` — 对多重部分子相互作用敏感的观测量** [V] · v1
  - **陈述.** (a) **[V] — the content of the tag:** *generalized* factorization (decoupled collinear sectors) of DY with a jet veto / beam thrust is violated: explicit model counterexample, a leading-power longitudinal spin asymmetry from spectator–spectator Glauber exchange in QCD with scalar quarks (`Zeng:2015iba`); amplitude-level violation of strict collinear factorization is the separate [V] statement `prop:break-spacelike`. (b) (in words, not part of the [V] claim) For MPI-sensitive observables (hadronic $E_T$, transverse thrust) `Gaunt2014` shows that the CSS cancellation *argument* fails at two spectator–spectator Glauber gluons and suggests a leading-power violation; `Schwartz:2018obd` show that pure Glauber ladders cancel for single-scale observables, so a violation needs soft emission off the Glauber rungs (Glauber–soft mixing); the status of standard factorization for these observables is [C] (Ch24 `conj:front-mpi-violation`, pointer). Never cite Gaunt without SYZ (S58).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit model counterexample (Zeng); `Gaunt2014` shows that the CSS argument fails at two spectator–spectator Glauber gluons and only suggests a violation; `Schwartz:2018obd` contradict only the pure-Glauber part (their argument does not apply to doubly differential observables, so the $\Delta p_\perp$ mechanism of `RothsteinStewart2016` §11.1 and Zeng's model lie outside its scope) — never cite Gaunt without SYZ (S58); which graphs violate first is not settled (c_glauber §1.6 item 3); in the measurement criterion these observables do not commute with the light-cone evolution.
  - `\uses{prop:break-measurement}`

items.label: thm:break-ddis
items.title: 衍射 DIS 的因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** As DIS (`thm:disall-factorization`), plus the $r^+$ deformation argument; fits `H1:2006zyl`.
  - `\uses{def:break-diffraction, thm:method-template, prop:method-glauber-deformation, thm:disall-factorization, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:break-ddis` — 衍射 DIS 的因子化** [A] · v1
  - **陈述.** $d\sigma(\gamma^*p\to p'X)=\sum_i\hat\sigma_i\otimes f^D_{i/p}$ (`Collins1998a`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **证明.** Sketch (Collins 1998 §III; c_glauber §3.2, checks D1a–c; VF-GLA-11). The detected proton belongs to the target subgraph A, whose final state is **constrained**, so the sum over the cuts of A is not available (unlike inclusive DIS); a soft gluon attached to A has its $r^-$ contour trapped (A contains initial- and final-state lines); the proof escapes by deforming $r^+$: near the soft region only final-state current-jet poles constrain $r^+$, A-collinear poles sit at $|r^+|\sim Q$, and the virtual photon has no spectators; Ward identities then factor the soft gluons, and the soft factor cancels in a region unaffected by the diffractive requirement. **Do not write** "one incoming hadron, hence no Glauber problem; final-state interactions summed" (c_glauber §6 item 6).
  - **地位与缺口.** As DIS (`thm:disall-factorization`), plus the $r^+$ deformation argument; fits `H1:2006zyl`.
  - `\uses{def:break-diffraction, thm:method-template, prop:method-glauber-deformation, thm:disall-factorization, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.label: prop:break-hh-diffraction
items.title: 强子—强子硬衍射中的因子化破坏
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: experiment (not a perturbative counterexample); the gap projector does not commute with the light-cone evolution (`prop:break-measurement`).
  - `\uses{thm:break-ddis}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:break-hh-diffraction` — 强子—强子硬衍射中的因子化破坏** [V] · v1
  - **陈述.** HERA diffractive PDFs overestimate Tevatron diffractive dijets by $O(10)$ (`AffolderEtAl2000`, `CDF:1997gvd` ($W$), `CDF:2012nhl`; see also `CMS:2012odd`); mechanism: spectator interactions fill the gap ("gap survival", `Bjorken:1992er`); unitarity protects only traces, not colour projections; in the dipole toy, singlet→octet leakage is quadratic in the phase difference, with coefficient $C_F/(2N)=\frac29$ (c_glauber §3.3–3.4, checks D2a–f); original proposal `IngelmanSchlein1985`; tests `Alvero:1998ta`; photoproduction analogue `prop:coll-diffractive-photo`.
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: experiment (not a perturbative counterexample); the gap projector does not commute with the light-cone evolution (`prop:break-measurement`).
  - `\uses{thm:break-ddis}`

* **定理 `thm:excl-transition` — $\gamma^*\gamma\to\pi^0$ 形状因子** [A] · v1
  - **陈述.** $Q^2F_{\gamma^*\gamma\pi}=\frac{\sqrt2f_\pi}3\int_0^1dx\frac{\phi_\pi(x)}x+O(\alpha_s)\to\sqrt2f_\pi$ (VF-EXC-7; BaBar normalization); NNLO `Gao:2021iqq`; data `CELLO:1990klc`, `CLEO:1997fho`, `BaBar:2009rrj`, `Belle:2012wwz`.

  - `\uses{def:excl-da, thm:method-template, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.label: prop:excl-endpoint
items.title: 端点区域与软重叠
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Established in models and at fixed order; no QCD bound on the soft overlap.
  - `\uses{thm:excl-pion-ff}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:excl-endpoint` — 端点区域与软重叠** [P] · v1 (+ refdoc S40)
  - **陈述.** The soft (Feynman) mechanism competes numerically at accessible $Q^2$ (`IsgurLlewellynSmith1984`, `Isgur:1988iw`; exact soft fractions VF-EXC-14: the closed forms are our evaluation of the Isgur–Llewellyn Smith fraction function, $f(\varepsilon)=1-R(\varepsilon)$, $f(1/150)=0.892$ for the asymptotic DA; novelty not asserted, the 1989 ILS papers were not accessible); its formal power counting is $1/Q^4$; the Sudakov/$k_T$ resummation scheme (`LiSterman1992`) is model dependent; colour transparency (the Wilson-line pair of a small dipole is $1+O(b\Lambda)$) and the endpoint-area estimate $c(1-\ln c)$, combined with the exact $R_{\rm as}(c)$ curves (c_exclusive) (refdoc S40, T24).
  - **地位与缺口.** Established in models and at fixed order; no QCD bound on the soft overlap.
  - `\uses{thm:excl-pion-ff}`

items.label: thm:excl-dvcs
items.title: DVCS 的因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Per Collins–Freund, the issues are the collinear region (Ward identities → Wilson line) and the endpoint/breakpoint regions $x=\pm\xi$; do **not** say that "soft gluons cancel by Ward identities" (c_exclusive §10 item 11); GPDs at $x=\pm\xi$ are a frontier question (Ch22, pointer).
  - `\uses{def:excl-gpd, thm:method-template, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:excl-dvcs` — DVCS 的因子化** [A] · v1
  - **陈述.** DVCS amplitudes factorize at leading power into GPDs and perturbative coefficient functions (`CollinsFreund1999`, `JiOsborne1998`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **地位与缺口.** Per Collins–Freund, the issues are the collinear region (Ward identities → Wilson line) and the endpoint/breakpoint regions $x=\pm\xi$; do **not** say that "soft gluons cancel by Ward identities" (c_exclusive §10 item 11); GPDs at $x=\pm\xi$ are a frontier question (Ch22, pointer).
  - `\uses{def:excl-gpd, thm:method-template, asm:intro-bridge}`

* **定理 `thm:excl-meson-L` — 纵向光子介子产生的因子化** [A] · v1 (+ refdoc S40)

Leading order, pseudoscalar case: $\varepsilon_L\cdot A_\pi=-i\frac{C_F}{N_c}\frac{4\pi\alpha_sf_\pi}Q\int dz\,\phi_\pi(z)\int dx\big[\frac{e_a}{\bar z(x-\xi+i0)}+\frac{e_b}{z(x+\xi-i0)}\big]\tilde F^{ba}$ (VF-EXC-11; agrees with VGG eqs. items.title: 横向光子：标准共线因子化失效
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (twist-3 WW); do not quote MP's "$9/\tau$" (their eq. (10) gives $6/\tau=4g^v(0)/\tau$ and the ratio $2{:}1$ for every DA; App Q, row Q.6); never write 「横向光子失效源于 $\int\phi/z^2$ 型发散」 (S58); the earlier sentence on "NLO claims that omit collinear subtractions" is **dropped** (claim E22 refuted as phrased: the criticized NLO calculation — Hoodbhoy–Lu, unpublished — concerned $\gamma_L^*N\to V_TN$, not $\gamma_T^*\to V_T$, and its author later redid it with the collinear subtractions and found zero; nothing is printed about it); phenomenological models `Goloskokov:2005sd`.

items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:excl-meson-T` — 横向光子：标准共线因子化失效** [V] · v1 (+ refdoc S40, ERR-M17)
  - **陈述.** (a) The leading-twist $\gamma_T^*\to V_T$ amplitude vanishes to all orders by chirality and helicity conservation ([A]; `Diehl:1998pd`, `CollinsDiehl2000`). (b) At twist 3, in the Wandzura–Wilczek approximation, the integrals diverge **logarithmically** at the endpoints, because $g_\perp^{(v)}(0)=\frac12\int du\,\phi_\parallel(u)/u\ne0$ (VF-REF-15, status T); endpoint suppression of $\phi_\parallel$ does not help; the GPD convolutions also have double poles $(\xi\mp x-i0)^{-2}$ (`Mankiewicz:1999tt`).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (twist-3 WW); do not quote MP's "$9/\tau$" (their eq. (10) gives $6/\tau=4g^v(0)/\tau$ and the ratio $2{:}1$ for every DA; App Q, row Q.6); never write 「横向光子失效源于 $\int\phi/z^2$ 型发散」 (S58); the earlier sentence on "NLO claims that omit collinear subtractions" is **dropped** (claim E22 refuted as phrased: the criticized NLO calculation — Hoodbhoy–Lu, unpublished — concerned $\gamma_L^*N\to V_TN$, not $\gamma_T^*\to V_T$, and its author later redid it with the collinear subtractions and found zero; nothing is printed about it); phenomenological models `Goloskokov:2005sd`.
  - `\uses{thm:excl-meson-L}`

items.label: prop:excl-near-threshold
items.title: 近阈重夸克偶素光生（重夸克极限）
items.status:
地位与缺口.** [P]: LO two-gluon exchange; the persistence of all-order GPD factorization of the high-energy region (`Ivanov:2004vd`) at threshold is argued, not proven; the spin-2 truncation requires large $|t|$ and $\xi$.
  - **Remark.** $\phi(0)$ is the non-relativistic wave function at the origin in the normalization of VF-YZL-15; NRQCD itself is introduced in Ch20 (`def:heavy-nrqcd`, forward pointer, not a dependency: only the LO normalization constant enters).
  - `\uses{def:excl-gpd}`

**Worked example.** `ex:excl-pion-ff-lo`.

**Tables.** `tab:excl-correspondence` (refdoc S45.2): `prop:excl-soft-cancel`, `thm:excl-pion-ff`, `thm:excl-meson-L` ↔ App N §N.6 (`asm:appN-endpoint`).
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:excl-near-threshold` — 近阈重夸克偶素光生（重夸克极限）** [P] · new (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §12.2; frontier YZLIU §3.F1)
  - **陈述.** (LO in $\alpha_s(M_V)$, NRQCD at LO, $M_V\to\infty$.) Near threshold ($\xi=1+O(M_N/M_V)$, $-t\sim M_NM_V$): $\mathcal M=\frac{8\sqrt2\pi\alpha_s(M_V)}{M_V^2}\phi^*(0)\,G(t,\xi)\,(\varepsilon_V^*\cdot\varepsilon)$, $G=\frac1{2\xi}\int_{-1}^1dx\,A(x,\xi)F_g(x,\xi,t)$, $A=\frac1{x+\xi-i0}-\frac1{x-\xi+i0}$; at $\xi\to1$ the spin-2 (gluonic gravitational form factor) moments dominate; cross section and $|G|^2$ as in VF-YZL-15 (corrected normalization of `Guo:2023pqw`; the 2021 definition of `Guo:2021ibg` had a spurious factor $\frac12$ in the gluon GPD, corrected by the authors in `Guo:2023pqw` §II — cite where used; it is listed among the author corrections of App Q, `tab:appQ-errata-b` (row Q.18, E12), not in `tab:appQ-errata`).
  - **地位与缺口.** [P]: LO two-gluon exchange; the persistence of all-order GPD factorization of the high-energy region (`Ivanov:2004vd`) at threshold is argued, not proven; the spin-2 truncation requires large $|t|$ and $\xi$.
  - **Remark.** $\phi(0)$ is the non-relativistic wave function at the origin in the normalization of VF-YZL-15; NRQCD itself is introduced in Ch20 (`def:heavy-nrqcd`, forward pointer, not a dependency: only the LO normalization constant enters).
  - `\uses{def:excl-gpd}`

**Worked example.** `ex:excl-pion-ff-lo`.

**Tables.** `tab:excl-correspondence` (refdoc S45.2): `prop:excl-soft-cancel`, `thm:excl-pion-ff`, `thm:excl-meson-L` ↔ App N §N.6 (`asm:appN-endpoint`).

**Figures.** Existing (tikz3, final): `fig:pion-ff`, `fig:dvcs-handbag`, `fig:meson-production`; optional new: `fig:excl-erbl`, `fig:excl-endpoint`.

**Misconception box.** Critic O18 (transverse photons); "soft gluons cancel by Ward identities in DVCS" (no: Collins–Freund).

items.label: thm:heavy-bdpi
items.title: $B\to D\pi$ 的全阶因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Literature: `BauerPirjolStewart2001`; two-loop IR demonstration `BenekeEtAl2000` (which "does not accomplish an all-order 'proof'"); NNLO kernel `Huber:2016xod`; colour transparency `Bjorken:1988kk`, `Dugan:1990de`, `Politzer:1991au`; SCET premises (`rem:scet-assumptions`).
  - `\uses{def:excl-da, thm:scet-decoupling, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:heavy-bdpi` — $B\to D\pi$ 的全阶因子化** [A] · v1
  - **陈述.** At leading power and all orders in $\alpha_s$: $\langle D\pi|O|B\rangle=N\,F^{B\to D}(0)\int_0^1dx\,T(x,\mu)\phi_\pi(x,\mu)$, with $N=\frac i2m_BE_\pi f_\pi$ for $O_{\bf0}=[\bar c\gamma^\mu P_Lb][\bar d\gamma_\mu P_Lu]$, $P_L=\frac12(1-\gamma_5)$ ($O_{\bf8}$ with $T^a\otimes T^a$; VF-BQ-6), for $\bar B^0\to D^+\pi^-$ and $B^-\to D^0\pi^-$; BPS write $F^{B\to D}(0)$, not $F(m_\pi^2)$ (difference power suppressed); the endpoint-suppression **assumption** is part of the statement (c_scet §6 item 7).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **地位与缺口.** Literature: `BauerPirjolStewart2001`; two-loop IR demonstration `BenekeEtAl2000` (which "does not accomplish an all-order 'proof'"); NNLO kernel `Huber:2016xod`; colour transparency `Bjorken:1988kk`, `Dugan:1990de`, `Politzer:1991au`; SCET premises (`rem:scet-assumptions`).
  - `\uses{def:excl-da, thm:scet-decoupling, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.title: 重到轻形状因子：软重叠与硬旁观者
items.status:

items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:heavy-btopi-ff` — 重到轻形状因子：软重叠与硬旁观者** [A] · refdoc S41 (corrects ERR-M21 of literature-style presentations)
  - **陈述.** At leading power in $\Lambda/m_b$ and large recoil, $F^{B\to\pi}=C(E)\,\xi_\pi(E)+\int T\,\phi_B\,\phi_\pi$ (soft overlap + hard spectator), to all orders in $\alpha_s$ (`Bauer:2002aj`, `Beneke:2003pa`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **地位与缺口.** All-order SCET argument; the further factorization of $\xi_\pi$ fails (endpoint divergences, `prop:heavy-qcdf-endpoint`).

items.label: prop:heavy-qcdf-lp
items.title: 无粲两体衰变的领头幂次 QCD 因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Tag [P] (survey item 18, more conservative than critic O19's [A]); SCET LP derivations: `Bauer:2004tj` (BPRS, with the charming-penguin caveat) and Chay–Kim (`Chay:2003ju`), with `Beneke:2003pa`, `Hill:2002vw`; the open BBNS–BPRS dispute on charming penguins is reported without a verdict (`Beneke:2004bn` vs `Bauer:2005wb`); never write 「BBNS 只在 $O(\alpha_s)$ 成立」 (S58).
  - `\uses{prop:heavy-btopi-ff, def:excl-da, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:heavy-qcdf-lp` — 无粲两体衰变的领头幂次 QCD 因子化** [P] · v1 (+ refdoc S41)
  - **陈述.** (BBNS) $\langle M_1M_2|Q_i|\bar B\rangle=F^{B\to M_1}(0)\int dx\,T^{\rm I}_i(x)\phi_{M_2}(x)+\int d\xi\,dx\,dy\,T^{\rm II}_i(\xi,x,y)\phi_B(\xi)\phi_{M_1}(y)\phi_{M_2}(x)$; one-loop vertex term $V_M=12\ln\frac{m_b}\mu-18+\int_0^1g\,\Phi_M$ (the 12 forced by $\mu$-independence; $\int g\Phi_M=-\frac12-3i\pi+(\frac{11}2-3i\pi)\alpha_1^M-\frac{21}{20}\alpha_2^M$; VF-BQ-1/2); IR finiteness established explicitly through NNLO for $T^{\rm I}$ (`Bell:2007tv`, `Bell:2009nk`, `Beneke:2009ek`; penguins `Bell:2015koa`, `Bell:2020qus`) and at one loop for $T^{\rm II}$ (`Beneke:2005vv`, `Beneke:2006mk`, `Kivel:2006xc`, `Pilipp:2007mg`; jet function `Beneke:2005gs`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **地位与缺口.** Tag [P] (survey item 18, more conservative than critic O19's [A]); SCET LP derivations: `Bauer:2004tj` (BPRS, with the charming-penguin caveat) and Chay–Kim (`Chay:2003ju`), with `Beneke:2003pa`, `Hill:2002vw`; the open BBNS–BPRS dispute on charming penguins is reported without a verdict (`Beneke:2004bn` vs `Bauer:2005wb`); never write 「BBNS 只在 $O(\alpha_s)$ 成立」 (S58).
  - `\uses{prop:heavy-btopi-ff, def:excl-da, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.label: prop:heavy-qcdf-endpoint
items.title: 幂次修正中的端点发散
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (divergent convolutions); refactorization of these endpoint divergences is [C] (case-by-case successes elsewhere: `Liu:2019oav`, `Liu:2020wbn`, `Liu:2022ajh`, `Hurth:2023paz`; attempts for annihilation `Lu:2022kos`); colour-suppressed $B\to D^0M^0$: `Mantry:2003uz`.
  - `\uses{prop:heavy-qcdf-lp}`
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:heavy-qcdf-endpoint` — 幂次修正中的端点发散** [V] · v1
  - **陈述.** The annihilation and twist-3 spectator terms are divergent convolutions at $O(\alpha_s)$: $X_A=\int_0^1\frac{dy}y$, $X_H=\int_0^1\frac{dy}{1-y}\Phi_p(y)$; the model $X=(1+\varrho e^{i\varphi})\ln\frac{m_B}{\Lambda_h}$, $\varrho\le1$, $\Lambda_h=0.5$ GeV is a **model** (VF-BQ-3/4; `BenekeNeubert2003`; the printed "$\ln(m_M/\Lambda_h)$" must read $m_B$, c_scet §6 item 17; App Q, row Q.7); annihilation coefficients VF-BQ-5 (the model dependence is stated by `BenekeEtAl2001` and `BenekeNeubert2003` themselves; no illustration of our own is printed).
  - **地位与缺口.** Evidence: explicit calculation (divergent convolutions); refactorization of these endpoint divergences is [C] (case-by-case successes elsewhere: `Liu:2019oav`, `Liu:2020wbn`, `Liu:2022ajh`, `Hurth:2023paz`; attempts for annihilation `Lu:2022kos`); colour-suppressed $B\to D^0M^0$: `Mantry:2003uz`.

items.label: thm:heavy-inclusive-b
items.title: 单举 $B$ 衰变的重夸克展开
items.status:
地位与缺口.** All-order status that of the OPE (`thm:dis-ope`, [A]) and, in the shape-function region, of the SCET factorization (premises `rem:scet-assumptions`). Applying the expansion to the physical rate at fixed kinematics needs local quark–hadron duality ([C], `conj:ee-duality`), which is not a premise of the statement as formulated (pointer); pole-mass renormalon: `Bigi:1994em`, `Beneke:1994sw`.
  - `\uses{thm:dis-ope, thm:scet-decoupling, asm:intro-wightman, asm:intro-composite, asm:intro-af-coeff, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:heavy-inclusive-b` — 单举 $B$ 衰变的重夸克展开** [A] · v1
  - **陈述.** OPE in $1/m_b$ for total and inclusive semileptonic rates, as an asymptotic expansion of the rates smeared over the hadronic energy release, with no $1/m_b$ term (`ChayGeorgiGrinstein1990`, `BigiUraltsevVainshtein1992`, `ManoharWise1994`, `BigiEtAl1994`); in the endpoint/shape-function region: factorization into hard × jet × shape function (`Neubert1994a`, `Neubert1994b`, `KorchemskySterman1994`, `BauerFlemingLuke2000`, `Bauer:2003pi`, `Lange:2003ff`, `Becher:2006qw`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-wightman}、\cref{asm:intro-composite}、\cref{asm:intro-af-coeff}（MA0、MA4）；端点（形状函数）区的因子化另需 \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）。
  - **地位与缺口.** All-order status that of the OPE (`thm:dis-ope`, [A]) and, in the shape-function region, of the SCET factorization (premises `rem:scet-assumptions`). Applying the expansion to the physical rate at fixed kinematics needs local quark–hadron duality ([C], `conj:ee-duality`), which is not a premise of the statement as formulated (pointer); pole-mass renormalon: `Bigi:1994em`, `Beneke:1994sw`.
  - `\uses{thm:dis-ope, thm:scet-decoupling, asm:intro-wightman, asm:intro-composite, asm:intro-af-coeff, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.label: thm:heavy-nrqcd-decay
items.title: 衰变的 NRQCD 因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** Perturbatively [A] (BBL; NRQCD cutoff dependence of $f_n$ and $\langle O_n\rangle$); non-perturbatively the decay rate needs local duality, since it is Minkowskian at a fixed point and not covered by the OPE assumptions (refdoc S41, ERR-M9); never write 「NRQCD 衰变因子化与 OPE 同样严格」 (S58).
  - `\uses{def:heavy-nrqcd, asm:intro-bridge}`
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:heavy-nrqcd-decay` — 衰变的 NRQCD 因子化** [A] · v1 (+ refdoc S41)
  - **陈述.** $\Gamma=\sum_n\frac{2{\rm Im}f_n}{m_Q^{d_n-4}}\langle H|O_n|H\rangle$, $m_Q$ the heavy-quark pole mass (BBL §II.F–G; P-wave consistency `Bodwin:1992ye`).
  - **非微扰地位.** \cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1、MA2）；非微扰地还需局域对偶（`conj:ee-duality`）。
  - **地位与缺口.** Perturbatively [A] (BBL; NRQCD cutoff dependence of $f_n$ and $\langle O_n\rangle$); non-perturbatively the decay rate needs local duality, since it is Minkowskian at a fixed point and not covered by the OPE assumptions (refdoc S41, ERR-M9); never write 「NRQCD 衰变因子化与 OPE 同样严格」 (S58).
  - `\uses{def:heavy-nrqcd, asm:intro-bridge}`

items.label: conj:heavy-nrqcd-production
items.title: 产生的 NRQCD 因子化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** At NNLO, IR poles appear that conventional octet operators do not match: NQS find uncancelled NNLO poles $\propto\alpha_s^2v^2/\varepsilon$, generated exactly by the gauge-completed octet operators — the Wilson lines are **necessary** at NNLO (relative order $v^2$) ([P]: `NayakQiuSterman2005a`, `NayakQiuSterman2005b`, `NayakQiuSterman2006`); beyond NNLO new non-local operators may be needed; universality and polarization tensions (`Butenschoen:2010rq`, `Butenschoen:2011yh`, `Butenschoen:2012px`, `Chao:2012iv`, `BrambillaEtAl2011`, `Lansberg:2019adr`); updates: Ch24 (pointer). Never write 「NQS 的规范完备 Wilson 线在 NNLO 不改变结果」 (S58).
  - `\uses{def:heavy-nrqcd}`
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:heavy-nrqcd-production` — 产生的 NRQCD 因子化** [C] · v1 (+ refdoc S41)
  - **陈述.** $\sigma=\sum_nF_n\langle O_n^H\rangle/m_Q^{d_n-4}$ (BBL §VI.A), for all inclusive production with $m_Q$ hard, order by order in $v$.
  - **地位与缺口.** At NNLO, IR poles appear that conventional octet operators do not match: NQS find uncancelled NNLO poles $\propto\alpha_s^2v^2/\varepsilon$, generated exactly by the gauge-completed octet operators — the Wilson lines are **necessary** at NNLO (relative order $v^2$) ([P]: `NayakQiuSterman2005a`, `NayakQiuSterman2005b`, `NayakQiuSterman2006`); beyond NNLO new non-local operators may be needed; universality and polarization tensions (`Butenschoen:2010rq`, `Butenschoen:2011yh`, `Butenschoen:2012px`, `Chao:2012iv`, `BrambillaEtAl2011`, `Lansberg:2019adr`); updates: Ch24 (pointer). * **命题 `prop:power-adler-large-beta0` — 大 $\beta_0$ 极限下的 Adler 函数** [P] · v1
  - **陈述.** (In the large-$\beta_0$ (bubble-chain) approximation.) $B[D](u)$ has IR renormalon poles at $u=2,3,\dots$ and **none at $u=1$**, consistent with the absence of a dimension-2 gauge-invariant operator; the $u=2$ pole matches $\langle\frac{\alpha_s}\pi G^2\rangle$; UV renormalon poles at $u=-1,-2,\dots$; the closed form including the $\overline{\rm MS}$ scheme constant $e^{5u/3}$ is transcribed from `Beneke1999` §5 (also `Beneke1993`, `Broadhurst1993`, `BenekeBraun1995a`) (to verify).
  - **证明.** Full `proof` in the large-$\beta_0$ limit (`ex:power-renormalon-chain`, which follows as the explicit computation); Mueller's analysis `Mueller1985`.

items.label: conj:lamet-principle
items.title: LaMET 原理（非微扰形式）
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:lamet-principle` — LaMET 原理（非微扰形式）** [C].
  - *Statement.* Let $\mathcal O_E$ be a renormalized equal-time (Euclidean) operator whose formal infinite-boost limit is a light-front operator $\mathcal O_{LF}$ (the "universality class" $[\mathcal O_{LF}]$; e.g. $\Gamma=\gamma^0$ and $\gamma^z$ quasi-PDF operators belong to the class of $\gamma^+$). For hadron states with $P^z\gg\Lambda_{\rm QCD},M$:
    $$\langle P|\mathcal O_E|P\rangle(P^z,\mu)=\big[\mathcal Z(P^z/\mu,\alpha_s(\mu))\otimes\langle P|\mathcal O_{LF}|P\rangle(\mu)\big]+\sum_{k\ge1}\Big(\frac{\Lambda}{P^z}\Big)^{2k}\times(\text{matrix elements of higher-twist equal-time operators}),$$
    where $\mathcal Z$ has a perturbative expansion free of infrared sensitivity, the power expansion is asymptotic and organized by the hard scales of the partons ($|x|P^z$, $|1-x|P^z$), and linear terms $\Lambda/P^z$ are absent when the Wilson-line self-energy and the matching coefficients are defined with one renormalon prescription (`prop:lamet-lrr`, later in this chapter).
  - `\uses{def:pdf-quark, def:pdf-lightray}`.
  - *Status and gap.* No non-perturbative proof exists for any member of any universality class; it would require a non-perturbative OPE/factorization in QCD (`conj:ee-np-ope`, `asm:intro-np-ope`, `rem:power-np-status`). The perturbative content is `cor:lamet-principle-pt` ([A], end of chapter); the precise non-perturbative content of the collinear case is the set `asm:lamet-uniform`, `asm:lamet-twist4`, `asm:lamet-large-z` (`thm:lamet-hadronic`). Evidence (never proof): renormalon analyses (`prop:lamet-bvz`), exactly solvable 2D models (Ch23 `thm:yzliu-gn-convergence`, pointer), lattice data. Ji's slogan "the two orders of limits differ only in perturbation theory" (`Ji:2024oka`, read) is a heuristic. Literature: `Ji2013`, `Ji:2014gla`, `JiEtAl2021` §II–III, `Ji:2020byp`, `Ji:2024oka` (all read). Over-claim to avoid: 「LaMET 原理已被非微扰地证明」 (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.9).
  - *Budget.* 0.3 pp.

items.label: prop:lamet-support
items.title: 准关联函数的支撑性质（逐图）
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-support` — 准关联函数的支撑性质（逐图）** [R, R_PT].
  - *Statement.* （$R_{\rm PT}$ qualifier.）For every Feynman diagram, including counterterm diagrams, contributing to $\langle p|\bar\psi(z)\Gamma W[z,0]\psi(0)|p\rangle$ with partonic external states (and to the analogous multiparton correlators), the Fourier transform in $\lambda=p\cdot z$ at fixed $z^2$ is supported in $[-1,1]$; equivalently $\tilde h(\lambda,z^2)=\int_{-1}^1dx\,e^{ix\lambda}\mathcal P(x,-z^2)$ diagram by diagram. `% VF-LAM-1`
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch (0.4 pp): α-(Schwinger) representation of each diagram; the $(p\cdot z)$ dependence enters as $\exp[-i(p\cdot z)\sum_k\alpha_kc_k/\sum\cdots]$ with a coefficient that is a convex combination bounded by $1$ in modulus. Original: `Radyushkin:1983wh` (recalled by the frontier agent — do not attribute details to it); statement and use read in `Radyushkin2017`, `Radyushkin:2018cvn`, `IzubuchiEtAl2018`. Analogue: `thm:pdf-support-pt`.

items.title: 含类空辅助静态色源的 QCD 的可重整性
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-aux-renorm` — 含类空辅助静态色源的 QCD 的可重整性** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (AX1) Extend QCD by a colour-triplet spinless Grassmann field $Q$ with $\mathcal L_Q=\bar Q\,i\hat n\cdot D\,Q$ (+ $\delta m\,\bar QQ$ for cut-off regulators), $\hat n=\hat e_z$; in a background field $S_Q(x,y)=\theta(x^z-y^z)\delta(x^0-y^0)\delta^2(\vec x_\perp-\vec y_\perp)W[x,y]$, so that $O_\Gamma(z)=\langle\bar\psi(z)\Gamma Q(z)\,\bar Q(0)\psi(0)\rangle_Q$ is a product of the local composite operators $\bar J=\bar\psi Q$, $J=\bar Q\psi$ of the extended theory.
  - (AX2) The extended theory is renormalizable with the counterterms $Z_Q$, $Z_1^{QQg}$ (tied to $Z_g$ by Slavnov–Taylor identities) and $\delta m$ only, BRST-invariantly.
  - (AX3) The $Q$-loop determinant $\det(i\hat n\cdot D)$ is a constant in the regularization used (DR).
  - `\uses{def:prelim-qcd, def:prelim-brst, def:prelim-wilson}`.

items.label: prop:lamet-ad-spacelike
items.title: 类空与类时 Wilson 线算符的反常维度相同
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-ad-spacelike` — 类空与类时 Wilson 线算符的反常维度相同** [A].
  - *Statement.* Green functions of the non-local quark operator with space-like and with time-like Wilson lines are related by an explicit substitution rule (analytic continuation in $v^2$); the renormalization constants and anomalous dimensions coincide to all orders; $\gamma_O=2\gamma_{hl}$ ($\gamma_{hl}$: heavy–light current), independent of $z$. (三圈内容，\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$) three-loop $\gamma_O$ in `Braun:2020ymy` App. A (TR; BCK normalization $a_s=\alpha_s/(4\pi)$, $\mu^2d/d\mu^2$).
  - `\uses{prop:lattice-renormalizability}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch (analytic continuation; `Braun:2020ymy`, read). Status: [A] (continuation argument; explicit three-loop agreement). Pointer: the analytic-continuation technology of Ch23.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: the substitution rule (analytic continuation in $v^2$ at the level of the integrands) is argued for all orders but not written as an identity of renormalized Green functions; it inherits the bottleneck `asm:lamet-aux-renorm` of `prop:lattice-renormalizability`; explicit agreement to three loops (`Braun:2020ymy` App. A, read). Upgrade: a proof of the continuation in the auxiliary-field formulation.
  - *Budget.* 0.15 pp.

items.label: prop:lamet-lrr
items.title: Wilson 线自能的线性重整子与领头重整子重求和
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-lrr` — Wilson 线自能的线性重整子与领头重整子重求和** [P].
  - *Statement.* (Large-$\beta_0$ / bubble-chain statement, first sentence.) (a) On the lattice $\delta m=m_{-1}(a)/a+m_0$; $m_{-1}=O(\alpha_s)$ is universal, $m_0=O(\Lambda)$ depends on the condition used to fix $\delta m$ (static potential, large-$z$ decay, auxiliary-field propagator, RI/MOM). (b) The perturbative series of the linearly divergent self-energy has the pole-mass renormalon at $u=\frac12$ (`def:power-borel`); truncation at $n\sim1/\alpha_s$ leaves an $O(\Lambda)$ ambiguity of $\delta m$. (c) A residual $e^{-m_0|z|}$ smears $\tilde q$ by a Lorentzian of width $m_0/P^z$ (`lem:lamet-lorentzian`): a linear power correction $O(\Lambda/(xP^z))$. (d) In $\overline{\rm MS}$ the Wilson coefficients $C_k(\alpha_s,z^2\mu^2)$ of the quasi-ITD carry the corresponding renormalon at $u=\frac12$, with an ambiguity linear in $|z|$ and independent of spin; leading-renormalon resummation (LRR) — the same principal-value prescription in $C_k$ and in $m_0$, with $m_0$ fixed from the $P^z=0$ matrix element at short $z$ — removes the $O(\Lambda/P^z)$ corrections; normalized (ratio) schemes have no $u=\frac12$ term.
  - `\uses{lem:lamet-lorentzian, def:lamet-schemes, def:power-borel, prop:power-renormalon-examples, prop:lattice-renormalizability}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: (a) `Ji:2020brr` (read); (b) pole-mass renormalon (`Beneke:1994sw`, `Bigi:1994em`); (c) `lem:lamet-lorentzian`; (d) `Braun:2018brg` (read: UV renormalon $w=\frac12$ of the coefficient function = Wilson-line linear divergence), `Zhang:2023bxs` (read: LRR, pole-mass normalization cross-checked with lattice perturbation theory to 20 loops), `Holligan:2023rex` (abstract).
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: rigorous only as a statement about the bubble chain; the prescription is a scheme choice; the universality of $m_0(\tau)$ across matrix elements is open (it depends on the external states, `Zhang:2023bxs`); the ensemble-specific numbers ($m_0\approx0.16$ GeV; "factor 3–5" improvement) are not printed as general facts.
  - *Budget.* 0.4 pp.

items.label: prop:lamet-euclid-minkowski
items.title: 欧氏格点矩阵元与 Minkowski 矩阵元的等同
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-euclid-minkowski` — 欧氏格点矩阵元与 Minkowski 矩阵元的等同** [A].
  - *Statement.* Equal-time matrix elements computed in Euclidean lattice QCD coincide with the Minkowski (LSZ) matrix elements; the identification is unique to all orders in PT (`Briceno:2017cpo`, abstract: 「据该文摘要」). Remark: finite-volume effects of spatially non-local operators are exponentially small but grow with $|z|$ (`Briceno:2018lfj`, abstract).
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] at abstract-level reading; the writer states the claim as the authors' and gives no proof beyond the idea (equal-time operators: no Euclidean continuation of the operator needed).
  - *Budget.* 0.1 pp.

items.label: prop:lamet-oneloop
items.title: 准 PDF 匹配的单圈结果
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-oneloop` — 准 PDF 匹配的单圈结果** [R, R_PT].
  - *Statement.* （$R_{\rm PT}$ qualifier.）At one loop, non-singlet, $a=\alpha_sC_F/(2\pi)$, $\overline{\rm MS}$ operator renormalization (the one-loop counterterm is computed here; it is the one-loop content of `prop:lattice-renormalizability`(d), a pointer, so the [A] registry tag of that composite statement does not enter), partonic states with DR as IR regulator:
    (a) coordinate kernel ($\Gamma=\gamma^0$: $\sigma=0$; $\gamma^z$: $\sigma=1$)
    $$\mathcal C(\alpha,L_z)=\Big[1+a\Big(\frac32L_z+\frac32\Big)\Big]\delta(1-\alpha)+a\Big\{\Big[\frac{1+\alpha^2}{1-\alpha}\Big]_+(-L_z-1)-\Big[\frac{4\ln(1-\alpha)}{1-\alpha}\Big]_++2(1+\sigma)(1-\alpha)\Big\}\theta(\alpha)\theta(1-\alpha),$$
    with moments $C_n=1+a\big[\big(\frac{3+2n}{2+3n+n^2}+2H_n\big)L_z+\frac{5+2n}{2+3n+n^2}+2(1-H_n)H_n-2H^{(2)}_n\big]$ ($+\frac{2a}{2+3n+n^2}$ for $\gamma^z$), $C_0=1+a(\frac32L_z+\frac52)$, and RG $\frac{d\mathcal C}{d\ln\mu^2}=a[\frac32\delta(1-\alpha)-B(\alpha)]$, $B=[\frac{1+\alpha^2}{1-\alpha}]_+$ (consistent with DGLAP and with $\frac{d\ln O^R}{d\ln\mu^2}=\frac32a$); `% VF-LAM-4`
    (b) ratio kernel $\mathcal C^{\rm ratio}=\mathcal C-\delta(1-\alpha)C_0$ = Radyushkin's reduced-ITD relation (his $\nu=-\lambda$); `% VF-LAM-5`
    (c) the unphysical-region quasi-PDF of `ex:lattice-quasi-tree`(b);
    (d) momentum-space kernels $C^{\overline{\rm MS}}(\xi)$ and $C^{\rm ratio}(\xi)$ of VF-LAM-8 (three-domain plus distributions $[g]^D_{+(1)}$; $\gamma^z$ variants; δ functions at $\xi=\pm\infty$ dropped for $f(y)\sim y^{-1+a'}$, $a'>0$), which are the distributional Fourier transforms of (a), (b) at fixed parton momentum; `% VF-LAM-8`
    (e) endpoint structure (input of the threshold factorization, Ch23 `thm:yzliu-threshold`, pointer): for $0<\xi<1$, $C^{\overline{\rm MS}}\supset\frac{2a}{1-\xi}\big(L_\zeta+\ln(1-\xi)-1\big)$; for $\xi>1$, $C^{\overline{\rm MS}}\supset\frac{2a\ln(\xi-1)}{\xi-1}$; together $a(L_\zeta-1)\big[\mathcal P\frac1{1-\xi}+\mathcal P\frac1{|1-\xi|}\big]+a\,\mathcal P\frac{\ln(1-\xi)^2}{|1-\xi|}$, $L_\zeta=\ln(4p_z^2/\mu^2)$;
    (f) momentum RGE: $P^z\frac{d\tilde q}{dP^z}=\frac{\alpha_sC_F}\pi\big[\big(\frac{1+y^2}{1-y}\big)_+-\frac32\delta(1-y)\big]\otimes f+O(\alpha_s^2)$.
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi, def:lamet-schemes, def:prelim-msbar, prop:pdf-partonic-dr, prop:pdf-lo-kernels, def:prelim-plus}`.
  - *Proof plan.* (c), (e), (f): full (algebra from (c) and VF-LAM-8; 0.3 pp). (a), (b),

items.label: prop:lamet-polarized
items.title: 极化、横度与扭度 3 准分布的匹配
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-polarized` — 极化、横度与扭度 3 准分布的匹配** [P].
  - *Statement.* Helicity ($\gamma^z\gamma_5$) and transversity ($\gamma^0\gamma^\perp\gamma_5$) quasi-PDFs match onto their light-cone counterparts at one loop (cut-off `XiongEtAl2014`; RI/MOM `Lin:2018pvv`, `Liu:2018hxv`†; abstracts). Twist 3: $g_T$ (`Bhattacharya:2020xlt`), $e$ and $h_L$ with essential zero-mode contributions $\propto\delta(x)$ (`Bhattacharya:2020jfj`); twist-2/twist-3 separation for axial-vector (`Braun:2021aon`) and chiral-odd (`Braun:2021gvv`) quasi/pseudo-distributions via Jaffe–Ji-type relations (abstracts).
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi, def:pdf-polarized, prop:lattice-renormalizability}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: one-loop matching only; the all-order twist-3 matching including zero modes is open; all sources at abstract level (「据该文摘要」); $\gamma_5$ scheme per `def:prelim-gamma5`.
  - *Budget.* 0.15 pp.

items.label: asm:lamet-ope
items.title: 类空 Wilson 线算符的短距离 OPE（重整化微扰论）
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-ope` — 类空 Wilson 线算符的短距离 OPE（重整化微扰论）** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (OP1) As $z^2\to0$ at fixed $\lambda$, in renormalized PT,
    $$O^R_{\gamma^\alpha}(z,\mu)=\sum_{n\ge0}\Big[C_n(-z^2\mu^2)\frac{(-i)^n}{n!}z_{\mu_1}\cdots z_{\mu_n}O_1^{\alpha\mu_1\cdots\mu_n}(\mu)+C'_n(-z^2\mu^2)\frac{(-i)^n}{n!}z_{\mu_1}\cdots z_{\mu_n}O_2^{\alpha\mu_1\cdots\mu_n}(\mu)\Big]+(\text{twist}\ge4),$$
    $O_{1,2}$ the traceless symmetric twist-2 quark/gluon operators, $C_n=1+O(\alpha_s)$, $C'_n=O(\alpha_s)$ ($=0$ for non-singlet); with our ITD phase the forward matrix element reads $\sum_nC_n\frac{(i\lambda)^n}{n!}a_{n+1}$ (the sign of $(-i)^n$ depends on the derivative convention: convert, §F0.3 rows 1–2).
  - (OP2) For massless on-shell partonic states there is no other scale: order by order the leading-twist expression holds for all $z$.
  - `\uses{prop:lattice-renormalizability, asm:lamet-aux-renorm, def:dis-twist}`.

items.label: rem:lamet-early-form
items.title: 以强子动量为变量的早期匹配形式不成立
items.entry:
* **注 `rem:lamet-early-form` — 以强子动量为变量的早期匹配形式不成立** [V].
  - *Statement.* The early form $\tilde q(x,\mu,P^z)=\int_x^1\frac{dy}y\,Z\big(\frac xy,\frac\mu{P^z}\big)q(y,\mu)$ (`Ji2013`) is wrong at $O(\alpha_s)$: by `thm:lamet-parton-momentum` the kernel depends on $\mu/(|y|P^z)$; replacing $|y|P^z$ by $P^z$ changes $\ell_p=\ln\frac{\mu^2}{4y^2P_z^2}$ by $\ln y^2$, i.e. by a term $\propto a\,(P\otimes\ln|y|f)$ that does not vanish.
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-parton-momentum, prop:lamet-oneloop}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [V]; evidence: explicit one-loop calculation (`IzubuchiEtAl2018`, read). Claim E06 confirmed — the authors' own later correction, cited as such (attribution; App Q `tab:appQ-errata-b`). The exact $O(\alpha_s)$ difference (VF-LAM-19) is $\frac{\alpha_sC_F}\pi\ln|y|\,\frac{1+\xi^2}{(1-\xi)_+}\otimes f=\frac{\alpha_s}\pi\ln|y|\,[P_{qq}-\frac32C_F\delta(1-\xi)]\otimes f$ ($P_{qq}$ normalized as in Ch8); the early integration range $\int_x^1$ is also too small (support $[-1,1]$); the point is explicit in `IzubuchiEtAl2018` and, for quasi-GPDs, already in `Ji:2015qla`.

items.label: prop:lamet-cfp
items.title: 光锥规范下的共线减除路线（Ma–Qiu）
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-cfp` — 光锥规范下的共线减除路线（Ma–Qiu）** [A].
  - *Statement.* In light-cone gauge $A^+=0$ the quasi-PDF of an on-shell massless quark admits the 2PI ladder decomposition $\tilde f=C_0\sum_iK^i$, with the operator and its renormalization entirely in the top kernel $C_0$; with the collinear projector $\hat{\mathcal P}W\equiv\int\frac{d^4k}{(2\pi)^4}\delta\big(x-\frac{k\cdot n}{p\cdot n}\big)\frac{{\rm Tr}[\gamma\cdot n\,W\,\gamma\cdot p]}{4p\cdot n}+{\rm UVCT}$ (the light-cone PDF cut vertex),
    $$\tilde f^{\rm ren}=\Big[C_{\rm ren}\frac1{1-(1-\hat{\mathcal P})K}\Big]\Big[\frac1{1-\hat{\mathcal P}K}\Big]=f_{q/q}\otimes C+O\big((\tilde xP^z)^{-2}\big),$$
    the second factor being the light-cone PDF of the quark and the first collinear (IR) safe; this gives the momentum-space form of `thm:lamet-parton-momentum` independently of `asm:lamet-ope`.
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子态。）
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi, prop:lattice-renormalizability, def:pdf-quark, thm:pdf-dglap}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch (0.4 pp): `Ma:2014jla` (read), `JiEtAl2021` §III.B (read): (1) cut-vertex representation with vertex $\frac{\gamma^z}{2P^z}\delta(\tilde x-k^z/P^z)$ (resp. $\gamma^0$); soft divergences cancel between real and virtual contributions; (2) ladder decomposition in $A^+=0$ (`EllisEtAl1979`, `CurciFurmanskiPetronzio1980`); (3) iterate the projector; (4) Feynman-gauge version: in the collinear region $\gamma^z\to\gamma^+/\sqrt2$; $A^+$ gluons attached to the space-like link carry $1/P^z$, compensated by the boost factor, and are removed in $A^+=0$; the regions $R_i$ are subtracted recursively "in a way similar to the BPHZ relation".
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (CFP/Collins-style, cf. Ch9; error type of the power-counting steps E-S). Sketched points: light-cone-gauge spurious poles $1/(n\cdot k)$ in the presence of the space-like link; the claim that $C_0$ has no collinear divergence; the cut-vertex representation of an equal-time operator. **No Glauber or final-state issue** arises: single hadron, no measured final state, fields at space-like separation — the obstruction of Ch12 cannot occur (state this explicitly; for quasi-TMDs see `thm:lamet-quasi-tmd`). The RMP adds "while the proof is only for perturbative free quark states, the factorization formulas are widely believed to be true nonperturbatively".

items.label: thm:lamet-lcs
items.title: “好的格点截面”的因子化（Ma–Qiu）
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:lamet-lcs` — “好的格点截面”的因子化（Ma–Qiu）** [A].
  - *Statement.* For a good lattice cross section,
    $$\sigma_n(\omega,\xi^2,P^2)=\sum_a\int_{-1}^1\frac{dx}x\,f_a(x,\mu)\,K^a_n(x\omega,\xi^2,x^2P^2,\mu)+O(\xi^2\Lambda^2),\qquad K^a_n=\sum_J\frac2{S_a}W^{(J,a)}_n\Sigma_J(x\omega,x^2P^2\xi^2),\quad \Sigma_J=\sum_i\binom{J-i}i\omega^{J-2i}\Big(-\frac{P^2\xi^2}4\Big)^i,$$
    with exact target-mass sums $\Sigma_J$; for partonic states the coefficient functions are entire in $\omega$ (`cor:lamet-entire`), so the statement holds for all $\omega$ order by order. LO examples (TR, `MaQiu2018`): $K^{q(0)}_q=2x\omega e^{ix\omega}$; scalar current $K^{q(0)}_S=\frac i{\pi^2}x\omega(e^{ix\omega}-e^{-ix\omega})$, in momentum space $-2i\frac{x^2\tilde\omega^2}{1-x^2\tilde\omega^2}$ with cuts for $\tilde\omega^2>1$ ("good" only for $\tilde\omega^2<1$).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* Partonic states; the hadronic extension from $|\omega|\ll1$ to finite $\omega$ is `asm:lamet-uniform`(UI-a) (status paragraph).
  - `\uses{thm:dis-ope, thm:pdf-moments-local, cor:lamet-entire, def:lattice-quasi}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: OPE of two local currents for $|\omega|\ll1$ (`thm:dis-ope`); moments via `thm:pdf-moments-local`; analyticity in $\omega$ (`MaQiu2018`: "if we fix $\xi$ at short distance while we increase $\omega$ … we cannot introduce any new perturbative divergence").
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: the route needs only the OPE of local currents of ordinary QCD — not `asm:lamet-ope`; for partonic states it could be upgraded to [R, R_OPE] along the lines of `thm:dis-moments` (decision for the lead author, §F5 item 7). Related programmes (evidence, abstracts): heavy-quark Compton tensor `DetmoldLin2006`; position-space current correlators for DAs at NNLO + twist 4 `Braun:2007wv`; Compton amplitude via Feynman–Hellmann `ChambersEtAl2017`; Euclidean hadronic tensor `Liu:1993cv`; LaMET with current–current correlators `Zhang:2026lle`† (read: abstract and setup) — "simple renormalization properties and [no] linear power divergences", at the price of four-point functions.

items.label: thm:lattice-lamet
items.title: LaMET 匹配定理（部分子态、领头幂次、全阶）
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:lattice-lamet` — LaMET 匹配定理（部分子态、领头幂次、全阶）** [A] (v1 label and tag; v1 title "LaMET/短距离因子化" refined; the v1 power-correction remark moves to `thm:lamet-hadronic`).
  - *Statement.* For partonic states, at leading power and to all orders, $\tilde q_\Gamma(x,P^z;\mu_R)=\int_{-1}^1\frac{dy}{|y|}C_\Gamma\big(\frac xy,\frac{\mu_R}\mu,\frac\mu{|y|P^z}\big)f(y,\mu)$ with an infrared-safe perturbative kernel $C_\Gamma$, established by two independent routes: the OPE route (`thm:lamet-parton-momentum`, content [A]) and the collinear-subtraction route (`prop:lamet-cfp`).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本定理只涉及部分子态；强子层次见 `thm:lamet-hadronic`，内容等级 [C]。）
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-parton-momentum, prop:lamet-cfp, prop:lattice-renormalizability, prop:lamet-tails}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: either route. Literature: `IzubuchiEtAl2018`, `Ma:2014jla`, `MaQiu2018`, `JiEtAl2021`, review `Constantinou:2020hdm`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]; bottlenecks: `asm:lamet-ope` (route A), the light-cone-gauge sketch (route B). Over-claim to avoid: 「准 PDF 匹配定理对强子严格成立」.

items.label: prop:lamet-gluon-singlet
items.title: 单态夸克与胶子准 PDF：带混合的匹配
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-gluon-singlet` — 单态夸克与胶子准 PDF：带混合的匹配** [A].
  - *Statement.* $q_i(x)=\int\frac{dy}{|y|}\big[\sum_j\tilde C_{q_iq_j}\tilde q_j+\tilde C_{qg}\tilde g\big]$, $g(x)=\int\frac{dy}{|y|}\big[\sum_j\tilde C_{gq}\tilde q_j+\tilde C_{gg}\tilde g\big]$ (inverse-matching form, `JiEtAl2021`, read) + power corrections; the operators do not mix under renormalization (`prop:lattice-renormalizability`(c)), mixing arises only in the matching; small-$y$ convergence of the momentum-space convolutions: `prop:lamet-tails`(iii) for the quark kernels ($\overline{\rm MS}$ and hybrid need the same small-$y$ condition, the ratio scheme only $\int|yf|<\infty$, and for physical quark distributions the $O(1)$ terms combine into $q-\bar q$), while the gluon and mixing kernels are not covered — never write that only ratio/hybrid-type schemes converge for Regge-like singlet distributions (claim N09 refuted as stated).
  - `\uses{thm:lattice-lamet, prop:lattice-renormalizability, prop:lamet-tails, prop:pdf-lo-kernels}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]; one-loop kernels: RI/MOM with mixing `Wang:2019tgg`, pseudo-gluon `Balitsky:2019krf`, unified forward/non-forward singlet `Yao:2022vtp` (abstracts) — no independent check in our material, so no [R] item. Title-only items (`Good:2025daz`, `NieMiera:2025mwj`†) are not used for content.

items.label: prop:lamet-scheme-validity
items.title: 动量空间匹配在何种重整化方案中成立
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-scheme-validity` — 动量空间匹配在何种重整化方案中成立** [A].
  - *Statement.* Let $X$ be a scheme with conversion $\tilde h^X=Z'_X(z^2\mu_R^2,\mu_R/\mu)\tilde h^{\overline{\rm MS}}$. If $Z'_X(z)$ is perturbative for **all** $z$ that contribute to the Fourier transform, then the momentum-space matching of `thm:lattice-lamet` holds in scheme $X$ with $C^X=\bar Z'_X\circledast C$, where at fixed parton momentum $\tilde{\mathcal C}^X(\lambda)=Z'_X(\lambda^2\mu_R^2/p_z^2)\tilde{\mathcal C}(\lambda)$ and $\circledast$ is the ordinary convolution in $\xi$ on $\mathbb R$ ($\bar Z'_X$ = Fourier transform of $Z'_X$). The hybrid scheme satisfies the condition by construction (`prop:lamet-hybrid-kernel`).
  - `\uses{thm:lattice-lamet, def:lamet-schemes, prop:lamet-hybrid-kernel}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (inherits `thm:lattice-lamet`). Source: `JiEtAl2021` (read), `Ji:2020brr`.

items.label: rem:lamet-ratio-large-z
items.title: 比值与 RI/MOM 方案在大 $|z|$ 处的动量空间匹配
items.entry:
* **注 `rem:lamet-ratio-large-z` — 比值与 RI/MOM 方案在大 $|z|$ 处的动量空间匹配** [C].
  - *Statement.* Momentum-space matching in the pure ratio or RI/MOM scheme with lattice data at $|z|\sim1/\Lambda$ is not justified: $Z'_X$ contains $\alpha_s(1/|z|)$ logarithms, non-perturbative there; "it is not legitimate to use momentum-space factorization for any other scheme that differ from $\overline{\rm MS}$ non-perturbatively" (`JiEtAl2021`, read). The resulting error is a non-perturbative distortion concentrated at the end points. Coordinate-space (SDF) use at short $z$ is unaffected.
  - `\uses{prop:lamet-scheme-validity}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [C] (no derivation exists; the claim of validity is unjustified rather than refuted).
* **Table `tab:lamet-schemes`** (from `def:lamet-schemes`: scheme | definition | conversion to $\overline{\rm MS}$ | momentum-space matching | references). **Figure** `fig:lamet-hybrid` (N7; the FIGURES_INDEX_v2 section label `sec:lamet-schemes` is this section).
* *Budget of §22.8.* 0.9 pp.

items.label: asm:lamet-gap
items.title: 谱隙与边界值正则性
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-gap` — 谱隙与边界值正则性** [C]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (GP1) In the channel of the two-point function considered, the external state is an isolated one-particle state of mass $m$, the vacuum and one-particle contributions are separated, and all other contributing states lie at least $\Delta m>0$ above the external state (no one-particle intermediate states, or they are treated separately, Ch23 `prop:yzliu-decay-extensions`).
  - (GP2) The analytic continuations of the ordered two-point functions in complex time have boundary values of moderate regularity near the cuts (Fredenhagen's conditions).
  - (GP3) QCD application: the Wilson-line operator reduces non-perturbatively to local operators $\bar Q\Gamma\psi$ of QCD + static source (cf. `asm:lamet-aux-renorm`), and the heavy–light sector has a gap $\Lambda_X=m_X-m_Q>0$ above the static threshold (confinement; $\Lambda_X\approx0.5$ GeV from $B^{(*)}$ masses, with a renormalon-scheme-dependent split $m_Q(\tau)+\Lambda(\tau)$).
  - `\uses{asm:lamet-aux-renorm}`.

items.label: conj:lamet-decay-qcd
items.title: QCD 准分布矩阵元的长程渐近形式
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:lamet-decay-qcd` — QCD 准分布矩阵元的长程渐近形式** [C].
  - *Statement.* In QCD the hadronic quasi-PDF matrix elements decay exponentially with a heavy–light binding energy $\Lambda$; for the pion valence distribution
    $$\tilde h^{\rm LA}(z,P^z)=\big[A_2e^{i{\rm sgn}(z)\phi_2}+A_1e^{i{\rm sgn}(z)\phi_1}e^{-iP^zz}+A_3e^{i{\rm sgn}(z)\phi_3}e^{iP^zz}\big]e^{-\Lambda|z|},$$
    with next-to-leading asymptotics $\propto e^{-\Lambda|z|}/|z|$; nucleon unpolarized: $A_2e^{i\phi_2{\rm sgn}z}e^{-\Lambda|z|}(1+A_2'/|z|+\dots)$; analogous forms for helicity, transversity, DAs and GPDs. `% VF-LAM-18`
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-exp-decay, asm:lamet-gap, asm:lamet-aux-renorm, def:lattice-quasi}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [C]: relies on confinement ((GP3)), on the non-perturbative HQET reduction, and on extending the scalar theorem to gauge theories with Wilson lines; support: dispersive analysis, Lorentz symmetry, heavy-flavour spectra (`Ji:2026vir`† §§2–3, read), two-loop $\varphi^3$ checks (Ch23). Used in practice to extrapolate lattice data (`Gao:2021dbh`, `Su:2022fiu`). Over-claim to avoid: 「指数衰减定理在 QCD 中成立」.

items.label: prop:lamet-bvz
items.title: 扭度 4 修正的重整子模型（大 $\beta_0$）
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-bvz` — 扭度 4 修正的重整子模型（大 $\beta_0$）** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「在大 $\beta_0$（泡链）近似中，」 the Borel transform of the coordinate-space coefficient function has: a UV renormalon at $w=\frac12$, $B[H]\to\frac{-4C_F}{w-1/2}\sqrt X$, which is the Wilson-line linear divergence (absent after normalization); the leading IR renormalon at $w=1$, $B[H^\parallel]\to\frac{-4C_F}{1-w}[\alpha+\bar\alpha\ln\bar\alpha]X$, $B[H^\perp]\to\frac{-4C_F}{1-w}[\alpha+\bar\alpha\ln\bar\alpha+\alpha\bar\alpha]X$ ($\parallel/\perp$ = $\Gamma=\gamma^z$/$\gamma^0$). The model in which the ambiguity is cancelled by a twist-4 term of the same functional form gives $\mathcal I^\parallel(\tau)=I(\tau)+\kappa z^2\Lambda^2\int_0^1d\alpha(\alpha+\bar\alpha\ln\bar\alpha)I(\alpha\tau)$, $|\kappa|\simeq\frac{\pi e^{5/3+2\gamma_E}}{4\beta_0}\simeq1.5$ (indicative, sign undetermined), and in momentum space (`lem:lamet-fourier`)
    $$\mathcal Q^\parallel(x)=q(x)+\frac{\kappa\Lambda^2}{x^2P_z^2}\Big\{\int_{|x|}^1\frac{dy}y\frac{y^2}{[1-y]_+}q\Big(\frac xy\Big)+q(x)-|x|q'(x)\Big\}$$
    with the $[0,1]$ plus distribution (so $q(x)\ln(1-x)$ appears when the integral is written over $[x,1]$); hence $\mathcal Q=q\{1+O(\frac{\Lambda^2}{x^2(1-x)P_z^2})\}$ while $\mathcal P(x,z)=q\{1+O(z^2\Lambda^2(1-x))\}$; normalizing by the $P=0$ matrix element adds $-\frac14\bar xx^2q''/q$ to $R^\parallel$ ($-\frac5{12}$ for $\perp$), a $\Lambda^2/((1-x)^2P_z^2)$ term ($[k]_+$ contains $-\frac14\delta(\bar\alpha)$, $\int_0^1k=\frac14$). `% VF-LAM-13`
  - `\uses{lem:lamet-fourier, cor:lamet-endpoint, def:power-borel, prop:power-renormalon-examples}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch; `Braun:2018brg` (read). The Borel variable $w$: the writer checks on the source that $w$ coincides with our $u$ (§F0.3 row 11).
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: a statement about the bubble chain; the identification of the model with the actual twist-4 matrix element (form, $\kappa$) is a conjecture (`conj:power-renormalon-ht`). Extension to quasi-/pseudo-GPDs and the special point $x=\pm\xi$: `Braun:2024snf` (abstract) → Ch23 `conj:yzliu-gpd-xi` (pointer).
  - *Verification outcome.* `Braun:2018brg` eq. (cR) omits $q(x)\ln(1-x)$ for both $R^\parallel_{\mathcal Q}$ and $R^\perp_{\mathcal Q}$ (claim E03 confirmed; App Q, row Q.9); print the correct form. Cite the journal equation numbers (definition (55), (61)–(64)); the 30 %/24 % sizes refer to their model (60); for $x<0$ the term is $-xq'(x)$, not $-|x|q'(x)$.

items.label: asm:lamet-uniform
items.title: 扭度展开对 Ioffe 时间的一致性
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-uniform` — 扭度展开对 Ioffe 时间的一致性** [C]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - Notation: $\tilde h_{\rm tw2}$ = leading-twist part (`thm:lamet-coordinate` with the target-mass completion of `prop:lamet-tmc`); $\tilde h_{\rm tw4}$ = the twist-4 term of `asm:lamet-twist4`.
  - (UI-a) (coordinate form, used by SDF and by the hadronic reading of `thm:lamet-lcs`) For hadron states and $0<-z^2\le z_0^2$: $|\tilde h(\lambda,z^2)-\tilde h_{\rm tw2}(\lambda,z^2)|\le K(-z^2)\Lambda^2(1+|\ln(-z^2\mu^2)|)^k$ uniformly in $\lambda\in\mathbb R$.
  - (UI-b) (ray form, used by `thm:lamet-hadronic`) Along the quasi-PDF ray $z^2=-\lambda^2/P_z^2$, the remainder $R\equiv\tilde h-\tilde h_{\rm tw2}-\tilde h_{\rm tw4}$ restricted to $|\lambda|\le z_0P^z$ has Fourier transform $o(P_z^{-2})$ at fixed $x\in(0,1)$.
  - Writer note (a correction of the frontier report's formulation, not a literature erratum): a pointwise bound of the type (UI-a) does **not** give a $P^z$-suppressed Fourier transform, since $\int_{|\lambda|\le z_0P^z}\lambda^2d\lambda/P_z^2\sim z_0^3P^z$; the twist-4 term contributes $O(P_z^{-2})$ only because of its structure (`lem:lamet-fourier`). Hence the separate ray form (UI-b).
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-coordinate, prop:lamet-tmc}`.

items.label: asm:lamet-twist4
items.title: 领头幂次修正的结构（扭度 4）
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-twist4` — 领头幂次修正的结构（扭度 4）** [C]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (TW1) The $O(z^2)$ term of the hadronic ITD has the form $\tilde h_{\rm tw4}=z^2\Lambda^2\int_{-1}^1d\alpha\,e^{i\alpha\lambda}\rho_4(\alpha,z^2)$ with $\rho_4$ a distribution supported in $[-1,1]$, smooth inside.
  - (TW2) The $z^2$ dependence of $\rho_4$ is at most logarithmic (twist-4 anomalous dimensions).
  - `\uses{prop:lamet-support, cor:lamet-entire}`.

items.label: asm:lamet-large-z
items.title: 大距离区域的控制
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-large-z` — 大距离区域的控制** [C]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (LZ1) $\int_{|\lambda|>z_0P^z}\frac{d\lambda}{2\pi}e^{-ix\lambda}[\tilde h-\tilde h_{\rm tw2}](\lambda,-\lambda^2/P_z^2)=o(1)$ as $P^z\to\infty$ at fixed $x\in(0,1)$.
  - (LZ2) The same with $\tilde h-\tilde h_{\rm tw2}-\tilde h_{\rm tw4}$ is $o(P_z^{-2})$.
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-coordinate, asm:lamet-twist4}`.

items.label: rem:lamet-inverse-problem
items.title: 逆问题之争：数学陈述与经验问题
items.entry:
* **注 `rem:lamet-inverse-problem` — 逆问题之争：数学陈述与经验问题** (no tag). `Dutrieux:2025jed` (abstract): with realistic data the inverse-problem uncertainty "remains significant without very restrictive assumptions", the crux at $\lambda\sim5$–15; `Chen:2025cxr` (abstract): LaMET "theoretically solves the ill-posed inverse problem" at fixed $x$, some data qualify for asymptotic extrapolation; `Ji:2026vir`† provides asymptotic forms and error estimates; Bayesian/NN reconstructions `Karpie:2019eiq` (abstract). Assessment (to print): `lem:lamet-strip` + `prop:lamet-truncation` make the fixed-$x$ quasi-PDF well posed *given* a theorem-level tail bound with known constants (only [C] in QCD: `conj:lamet-decay-qcd`); `prop:lamet-slepian` shows that without such information the data fix only $\approx2\lambda_L/\pi$ modes. Both sides' mathematical statements are compatible; the disagreement is about the size of $e^{-mz_L}$-type effects with present data — an empirical question. Over-claim to avoid: 「格点直接计算了 $x$ 依赖」.
* *Budget of §22.11.* 0.6 pp.

items.label: thm:lamet-quasi-gpd
items.title: 准 GPD 与准 DA 的匹配
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:lamet-quasi-gpd` — 准 GPD 与准 DA 的匹配** [A].
  - *Statement.* $\tilde F(y,\xi,t,\bar P^z)=\int_{-1}^1\frac{dx}{|x|}\tilde C\big(\frac yx,\frac\xi x,\frac\mu{x\bar P^z}\big)F(x,\xi,t,\mu)+$ power corrections, with $\tilde C$ independent of $t$ (at least at one loop) and equal to the PDF kernel at $\xi=0$; $\tilde\phi(x,P^z)=\int_0^1dy\,C(x,y,\mu/P^z)\phi(y,\mu)+$ power corrections. LaMET predictions are reliable on $[-1+x_0,-\xi-x_0]\cup[-\xi+x_0,\xi-x_0]\cup[\xi+x_0,1-x_0]$ with $x_0$ set by the hard parton momenta (threshold study `Holligan:2025baj`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* Partonic statement; hadrons as in `thm:lamet-hadronic` (no separate R_cond theorem is formulated for GPDs).
  - `\uses{def:lamet-quasi-gpd, asm:lamet-ope, prop:lattice-renormalizability, prop:lamet-support}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: OPE route with conformal non-forward twist-2 operators; the support/analyticity argument extends to non-forward kinematics. One loop (abstracts): unpolarized and helicity `Ji:2015qla` ("no matching is required for $E$ ($\tilde E$)" at one loop, leading power), transversity `Xiong:2015nua`, RI/MOM `Liu:2019urm`, all quasi-GPDs incl. gluons and arbitrary spin `Ma:2022ggj`, coordinate space `Radyushkin:2019owq`, unified NLO `Yao:2022vtp`; meson DA one loop with the GPD paper, RI/MOM `Liu:2018tox` (the quasi-PDF renormalization factor can be used "provided that they are implemented on lattice and in perturbation theory in the same manner"), lattice `Zhang:2017bzy`, `LatticeParton:2022zqc`, `Holligan:2023rex`; NNLO coordinate-space kernels for non-singlet GPDs and the meson DA `Ji:2025mvk`† (abstract; single group).
  - *Status and gap.* [A]; bottleneck `asm:lamet-ope` (non-forward version). Kinematic twist-3 contributions needed for translation invariance are logarithmically enhanced and discontinuous at $x=\pm\xi$ (`Braun:2023alc`, abstract). The point $x=\pm\xi$: Ch23 `conj:yzliu-gpd-xi` (pointer). No [R] item: all fixed-order sources are at abstract level in our material.

items.label: prop:lamet-other-objects
items.title: 其他准分布：重子与重介子 LCDA、$\Delta G$、双部分子分布
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-other-objects` — 其他准分布：重子与重介子 LCDA、$\Delta G$、双部分子分布** [P].
  - *Statement.* (i) Baryon LCDAs: one-loop factorization of quasi-DAs "explicitly demonstrated at the one-loop level" with $\overline{\rm MS}$ and RI/MOM kernels (`Deng:2023csv`); (ii) heavy-meson LCDAs: two-step factorization, QCD LCDA = perturbative jet-like function ⊗ HQET LCDA (`Beneke:2023nmj`), LaMET access to the HQET LCDA through equal-time correlators with a dynamic fast heavy quark (`Han:2024fkr`), hierarchy $\Lambda\ll m_Q\ll P^z$; (iii) $\Delta G$ as the large-momentum limit of a gauge-invariant, frame-dependent gluon spin $\vec E\times\vec A_\perp$ (`Ji:2013fga`) and its universality class with only $O(1/P_z^n)$, $n\ge2$, corrections (`Hatta:2013gta`); (iv) double parton distributions: general DPD ↔ quasi-DPD matching for all flavour, spin and colour structures with one-loop quark–quark coefficients (`Jaarsma:2023woo`), colour-singlet unpolarized quark DPDs (`Zhang:2023wea`†). All abstracts.
  - `\uses{def:lattice-quasi, thm:lattice-lamet}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: one-loop or structural statements; the all-order soft/rapidity structure for colour-non-singlet DPDs and the renormalization of multi-link baryon operators are not established; heavy-meson chain combined status [P].
* *Budget of §22.12.* 0.7 pp.

items.label: asm:lamet-staple
items.title: 订书钉形类空 Wilson 线算符的重整化与 $L\to\infty$ 极限
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-staple` — 订书钉形类空 Wilson 线算符的重整化与 $L\to\infty$ 极限** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (ST1) For $z\ne0$, $b_T\ne0$, the staple operator $\bar\psi(\frac z2\hat e_z+\frac{\vec b_T}2)\Gamma\mathcal W_z(\cdots;L)\psi(-\frac z2\hat e_z-\frac{\vec b_T}2)$ divided by $\sqrt{Z_E(2L,b_T,\mu)}$ is multiplicatively renormalizable with a factor that depends only on the end points (heavy–light currents, quark fields): the linear divergences $\propto L$ and the cusp divergences of the staple cancel in the ratio.
  - (ST2) The limit $L\to\infty$ of the ratio exists in every order of PT: the pinch-pole singularity of infinitely long space-like links cancels between the staple self-interactions and $\sqrt{Z_E}$; ultrasoft modes cancel after resummation of dipole self-interactions.
  - (ST3) On the lattice, $\sqrt{Z_E}$ together with the short-distance hadron matrix element removes all UV divergences (RI/MOM fails to remove all linear divergences); same-dimension mixing as in `prop:lattice-renormalizability`(b).
  - `\uses{asm:lamet-aux-renorm, def:prelim-wilson}`.

items.label: asm:lamet-soft-rapidity
items.title: 离光锥软函数的大快度结构
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-soft-rapidity` — 离光锥软函数的大快度结构** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (SR) As $Y+Y'\to\infty$: $\ln S(b_\perp,\mu,Y,Y')=(Y+Y')\tilde K(b_\perp,\mu)+\mathcal D(b_\perp,\mu)+O(e^{-(Y+Y')})$, with $\tilde K$ the Collins–Soper kernel of `prop:tmd-evolution` and $\mathcal D$ finite.
  - `\uses{def:lamet-soft-offlc, prop:tmd-evolution}`.

items.label: asm:lamet-order-limits
items.title: 极限次序
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:lamet-order-limits` — 极限次序** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.1 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (OL1) $\varepsilon\to0$ commutes with $L\to\infty$ and with the off-light-cone rapidity regulator limit $\tilde\eta\to\infty$ for the ratio $\Omega/\sqrt S$ (self-energies cancel because the staple of $\Omega$ is half that of $S$; exchanges between the halves are exponentially suppressed; eikonal poles $1/(n_B\cdot k)$ give the same result with either regulator — verified at one loop).
  - (OL2) The large-rapidity and the Collins schemes differ only in the order of $\varepsilon\to0$ and $y_B\to-\infty$; by asymptotic freedom this is a UV effect: $f^{\rm LR}=C_q(\sqrt{\zeta_{\rm LR}}/2,\mu)f^{\rm TMD}+O(y_B^ke^{y_B})$, with $C_q$ independent of $y_n-y_B$ (otherwise the non-perturbative CS kernel would enter).
  - `\uses{def:lamet-quasi-tmd, def:tmd-collins}`.

items.label: thm:lamet-quasi-tmd
items.title: 准 TMD 因子化
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:lamet-quasi-tmd` — 准 TMD 因子化** [A].
  - *Statement.* For $b_T\gg1/(xP^z)$, $\zeta_z\gg\Lambda^2$, at leading power,
    $$\tilde f(x,b_T,\mu,\zeta_z)\sqrt{S_r(b_T,\mu)}=H\Big(\frac{\zeta_z}{\mu^2}\Big)\exp\Big[\frac12\tilde K(b_T,\mu)\ln\frac{\zeta_z}\zeta\Big]f^{\rm TMD}(x,b_T,\mu,\zeta)\Big\{1+O\Big(\frac{\Lambda^2}{\zeta_z},\frac{M^2}{\zeta_z},\frac1{b_T^2\zeta_z}\Big)\Big\},$$
    $f^{\rm TMD}$ the Collins TMD (`def:tmd-collins`), $2\zeta\partial_\zeta\ln f^{\rm TMD}=\tilde K$. The relation is **multiplicative in $x$** (no convolution), flavour diagonal (no quark–gluon or flavour mixing), spin independent ($H$ depends only on the colour representation), and holds for quarks and gluons. Momentum evolution: $2\zeta_z\partial_{\zeta_z}\ln\tilde f=\tilde K+G$, $G=2\zeta_z\partial_{\zeta_z}\ln H$. Equivalent ESSZ form: $\tilde f^{[s]}_{i/h}(x,\vec b_T,\mu,\tilde\zeta,x\tilde P^z)=C_i(x\tilde P^z,\mu)\exp[\frac12\gamma^i_\zeta\ln\frac{\tilde\zeta}\zeta]f^{[s]}_{i/h}(x,\vec b_T,\mu,\zeta)\{1+O[\frac1{(x\tilde P^zb_T)^2},\frac{\Lambda^2}{(x\tilde P^z)^2}]\}$ with $\gamma_\zeta=\tilde K$ (their proper quasi-TMD contains $S_r$). (b)（单圈内容，\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$）$H=1+a(-2+\frac{\pi^2}{12}-\frac12L_\zeta^2+L_\zeta)$, $G^{(1)}=\frac{\alpha_sC_F}\pi(1-L_\zeta)$, and the coefficient of $\tilde K\ln(\zeta_z/\zeta)$ is fixed to $\frac12$ by the one-loop expressions (`ex:lamet-qtmd-oneloop`). (c)（两圈内容，\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$）the NNLO coefficient (`delRio:2023pse`, read) agrees with the two-loop heavy–light Sudakov kernel of Ji–Liu–Su (values in Ch23 `prop:yzliu-hard-kernel`, pointer). `% VF-LAM-15`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：`asm:intro-bridge`、`asm:intro-composite`（MA0、MA1、MA2）。
  - `\uses{def:lamet-quasi-tmd, def:lamet-reduced-soft, def:tmd-collins, prop:tmd-evolution, asm:lamet-staple, asm:lamet-soft-rapidity, asm:lamet-order-limits, lem:tmd-soft-oneloop, prop:tmd-evolution-oneloop, prop:lattice-renormalizability}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch (0.7 pp) with independent routes: **(A)** Ji–Liu–Liu leading regions (`Ji:2019ewn`, read; a "sketch of mathematical proof", details "to a future publication"): collinear subgraphs identical to the light-front TMD; soft radiation between the fast colour charge and the staple captured by the off-light-cone soft function; hard subgraphs at $\zeta_z$ localized at the two quark–link vertices, since any hard momentum flowing between $0$ and $\vec b_T$ costs a power of $1/P^z$ ⇒ no convolution, in sharp contrast with the colline

items.label: prop:lattice-cs-kernel
items.title: 格点 Collins–Soper 核
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lattice-cs-kernel` — 格点 Collins–Soper 核** [A] (v1 label and tag).
  - *Statement.* At fixed $x$, $b_T$ and two momenta $P_1^z,P_2^z$:
    $$\tilde K(b_T,\mu)=\frac1{\ln(P_1^z/P_2^z)}\ln\frac{C(\mu,xP_2^z)\,\tilde f(x,b_T,\mu,P_1^z)}{C(\mu,xP_1^z)\,\tilde f(x,b_T,\mu,P_2^z)}+\text{power corrections},\qquad C(\mu,xP^z)\equiv H\Big(\frac{(2xP^z)^2}{\mu^2}\Big),$$
    equivalently $\frac{\tilde f(\zeta_{z,1})}{\tilde f(\zeta_{z,2})}=\frac{H_1}{H_2}(\frac{\zeta_{z,1}}{\zeta_{z,2}})^{\tilde K/2}=\frac{H_1}{H_2}(\frac{P^z_1}{P^z_2})^{\tilde K}$; $S_r$ and all $\Gamma$-, flavour- and spin-independent factors cancel; the $x$ independence of the right-hand side tests leading power. (单圈内容，\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$) the formula returns $\tilde K^{(1)}=-2aL_b$ exactly. `% VF-LAM-16`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：`asm:intro-bridge`（MA1、MA2）。
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-quasi-tmd, prop:tmd-evolution}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Full given the theorem (two lines). Literature: `EbertStewartZhao2019` (read; original proposal), `Ebert:2019tvc` (abstract; RI′/MOM for staples, position-space procedure); lattice determinations (evidence): `Shanahan:2020zxr`, `Shanahan:2021tst`, `Schlemmer:2021aij`, `LatticePartonLPC:2022eev`, `LatticePartonLPC:2023pdv`, `Avkhadiev:2023poz`, `Avkhadiev:2024mgd` (abstract: "first such determination with systematic control of quark mass, operator mixing, and discretization effects"), `Bollweg:2024zet`, `Tan:2025ofx` (abstract). The slow convergence of the imaginary part in quasi-TMDWF-based extractions is explained by the linear renormalon of Ch23 (pointer).
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (inherits `thm:lamet-quasi-tmd`); M17: $\tilde K$ at $b_T\sim1/\Lambda$ is non-perturbative and the lattice supplies it only through the [A] theorem.

items.label: prop:lamet-tmd-ratios
items.title: 准 TMD 之比与 TMD 之比
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:lamet-tmd-ratios` — 准 TMD 之比与 TMD 之比** [A].
  - *Statement.* At fixed $(x,b_T,P^z)$, ratios of quasi-TMDs with different $\Gamma$ in the spin-universality class, different flavours or different target polarizations equal the corresponding ratios of TMDs at leading power ($S_r$, $H$ and the CS factor cancel because $H$ is spin and flavour independent and $S_r$, $\tilde K$ depend on $b_T$ only); this justifies the earlier staple "ratio" lattice programme (`Hagler:2009mb`, `Musch:2010ka`, `Musch:2011er`, `Yoon:2017qzo`) in the large-momentum limit (`Ebert:2022fmh`, `Vladimirov:2020ofp`). Spin universality: helicity and transversity quasi-TMDs have the same one-loop coefficient as the unpolarized one, argued for pretzelosity and to all orders (`Ebert:2020gxr`, abstract). Gluon quasi-TMDs: one-loop hard kernel, independent of the pinch-pole prescription (`Zhu:2022bja`, abstract). NLP quasi-TMDs (`Rodini:2022wic`, abstract): twist-2, twist-3 TMDs and a lattice-specific non-perturbative function. Ratios at **different** $b_T$ do not cancel $S_r$ and the CS factor (the frontier report's phrase "$b_T$ at fixed $x$" is a slip; never print).
  - `\uses{thm:lamet-quasi-tmd}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (inherits the theorem); abstract-level items hedged.
* *Budget of §22.13.* 2.0 pp.

items.label: cor:lamet-principle-pt
items.title: LaMET 原理的微扰内容
items.entry:
* **推论 `cor:lamet-principle-pt` — LaMET 原理的微扰内容** [A].
  - *Statement.* For partonic external states at leading power, the expansion of `conj:lamet-principle` holds order by order in renormalized perturbation theory for: non-singlet quark quasi-PDFs (`thm:lattice-lamet`), singlet quark and gluon quasi-PDFs with mixing (`prop:lamet-gluon-singlet`), quasi-GPDs and quasi-DAs (`thm:lamet-quasi-gpd`), quasi-TMDs with the reduced soft function (`thm:lamet-quasi-tmd`); explicit at one loop (`prop:lamet-oneloop`, `thm:lamet-quasi-tmd`(b)) and at two loops for the non-singlet PDF kernel and the quasi-TMD hard kernel.
  - `\uses{thm:lattice-lamet, prop:lamet-gluon-singlet, thm:lamet-quasi-gpd, thm:lamet-quasi-tmd}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]; the order-of-limits picture ("IR physics unchanged") is a heuristic; the actual arguments are the OPE route, the collinear-subtraction route and the boost/LR route.

head: Chapter 23 — Yizhuang Liu 的严格因子化研究 / The rigorous factorization research of Yizhuang Liu
box: 证明了：`lem:yzliu-matrix-tree`、`lem:yzliu-final-state`（数学）；`prop:yzliu-sI-twoloop`、`prop:yzliu-gpd-oneloop`（[R, R_PT]，限于所述阶）；`cor:yzliu-soft-form-factor`（[R, R_cond]，前提 `asm:yzliu-heavy-pair`；内容等级 [C]）；在所述模型中：`thm:yzliu-gn-convergence`（作为 QCD 陈述为 [P]）。
