For *generalized* factorization (decoupled collinear sectors) of DY with jet vetoes/beam thrust a model counterexample exists: decoupling implies no dependence on the longitudinal spins of the hadrons, but spectator–spectator Glauber exchange gives a non-zero leading-power spin asymmetry (QCD with scalar quarks; `Zeng:2015iba`, abstract) — [V] (model), core statement `prop:break-jet-veto` (Ch18, pointer). Over-claim to avoid (S58): 「Gaunt (2014) 证明了强子 $E_T$ 的因子化破坏」 without `Schwartz:2018obd`.

items.label: prop:front-heavy-fsi
items.title: 重末态与旁观者之间的软末态相互作用
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-heavy-fsi` — 重末态与旁观者之间的软末态相互作用** [A].
  - *Statement.* Soft final-state interactions between high-$p_T$ heavy particles and spectators are power suppressed for single-particle-inclusive cross sections with an unconstrained recoiling partner (e.g. single-top inclusive in $t\bar t$) but give leading-power effects in multi-particle-inclusive cross sections (incl. pair $q_T$ distributions) without hard recoil; non-perturbative effects are suppressed by $\Lambda/p'_T$ (`Mitov:2012gt`, 「据该文摘要」). Related: small-$q_T$ resummation for $t\bar t$ needs a non-trivial soft factor with azimuthal correlations (`Catani:2014qha`, abstract).
  - `\uses{prop:method-fsi}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (abstract level).

items.label: rem:front-glauber-status
items.title: Glauber 现状与本书分级的后果
items.entry:
* **注 `rem:front-glauber-status` — Glauber 现状与本书分级的后果** (no tag). Summary table (in text): Glauber cancellation in inclusive DY [A] (unchanged; `thm:dy-factorization`); RS Lagrangian [A] (`prop:scet-glauber-operators`); spectator phase [R] for the eikonal computation as stated (Ch12); pure-ladder cancellation [A] (`prop:front-syz`); MPI-sensitive observables [C] (`conj:front-mpi-violation`); generalized factorization with a spin asymmetry [V] (model); strict space-like collinear factorization [V] at one loop (`CataniDeFlorianRodrigo2012`, abstract; `prop:break-spacelike`; they do **not** show a cancellation and say the effect "may invalidate … starting at the N³LO", A20); collinear factorization of non-inclusive $pp$ cross sections [V] from three loops in pure QCD, from two loops beyond QCD (`ForshawSeymourSiodmok2012`; `prop:break-fss`); SCET reproduction of these violations with Glauber operators (`Schwartz:2017nmr`); two-loop soft current in full colour with potentially dangerous terms when the soft gluon becomes collinear to an incoming parton (`Dixon:2019lnw` with its erratum, JHEP 06 (2024) 143: these terms **cancel after summing over colours** — never cite it as evidence of cross-section-level violation; E33 confirmed); time-like splitting amplitudes to three loops and space-like ones for three-parton amplitudes (`Guan:2024hlf`; cancellation in pure QCD to NNLO, A20). Misconception M21: the violation of strict collinear factorization is an amplitude-level statement about space-like multi-parton limits and does not by itself make PDF factorization fail.
* *Budget of §24.5.* 1.4 pp.

#### §24.6 `sec:front-sll`

items.label: prop:front-sll-all-orders
items.title: 非全局 LHC 观测量的因子化与超领头对数的全阶重求和
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-sll-all-orders` — 非全局 LHC 观测量的因子化与超领头对数的全阶重求和** [A].
  - *Statement.* For non-global hadron-collider observables (gaps between jets, jet vetoes) with veto scale $Q_0\ll Q$, $L=\ln(Q/Q_0)$, the cross section factorizes as $\sigma(Q_0)=\sum_{a_1a_2}\int dx_1dx_2\sum_{m}\langle\mathcal H_m(\{n\},Q,\mu)\otimes\mathcal W_m(\{n\},Q_0,x_1,x_2,\mu)\rangle$ (hard functions × low-energy matrix elements at $Q_0$, matrices in multiplicity and colour space); the one-loop anomalous dimension contains soft and collinear parts with Glauber phases $\propto i\pi$ (`prop:sudakov-coulomb`), whose non-commutation produces super-leading logarithms $\alpha_s^3L^3(\alpha_sL^2)^n$ (i.e. $\alpha_s^4L^5$ at four loops), resummed at LL to all orders for arbitrary $2\to M$ (`Becher:2023mtx`, abstract): alternating series with terms much larger than the sum; sizeable for $pp\to2$ jets, suppressed for $H/Z(+$jet$)$. The full "Glauber series" (arbitrary numbers of phases $(i\pi)^2$) at LL: `Boer:2023jsy`, `Boer:2023ljq`, `Boer:2024hzh` (running coupling), `Boer:2024xzy` (large $N_c$); all partonic channels of $pp\to2$ jets, some $q\bar q\to q\bar q$ interference terms only $1/N_c$ suppressed (`Becher:2024nqc`); massive final states add a Coulomb phase and a new source of SLLs (`Banerjee:2025kkq`) (abstracts). History: `ForshawKyrieleisSeymour2006` (discovery; first SLL coefficient), `Forshaw:2008cq` (colour-basis independence), `Angeles-Martinez:2015rna` (ordering variable), `Forshaw:2021fxs` (coherence violation in almost all soft-sensitive hadron-collider observables, erratum 2024).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子层次的低能矩阵元与硬函数。）
  - `\uses{thm:jets-ngl-factorization, prop:sudakov-coulomb}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] for the $\mathcal H\otimes\mathcal W$ structure and the LL resummation (EFT derivation, one-loop RG). PDF factorization below $Q_0$ is a separate question (`prop:front-restoration`, [P]). Core statement: `prop:jets-sll` (Ch16, [P]; existence of SLLs).

items.label: prop:front-sll-closed-form
items.title: 超领头对数的塔与 $q\bar q$ 单态交换的闭式
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-sll-closed-form` — 超领头对数的塔与 $q\bar q$ 单态交换的闭式** [A].
  - *Statement.* Iterating the one-loop anomalous dimension of `prop:front-sll-all-orders` gives the tower
    $$\hat\sigma_n^{\rm SLL}=\Big(\frac{\alpha_s}{4\pi}\Big)^{n+3}L^{2n+3}\frac{(-4)^nn!}{(2n+3)!}\sum_{r=0}^n\frac{(2r)!}{4^r(r!)^2}C_{rn}$$
    with explicit colour traces $C_{rn}$ (`Becher:2021zkk` eqs. (14)–(21), read; checked by the authors with ColorMath to eight loops). For $q\bar q$ singlet exchange in forward scattering ($J_2=J_{43}/2=\Delta Y$, the gap rapidity)
    $$\Delta\hat\sigma^{(S)}=\sum_{n\ge0}\hat\sigma_n^{\rm SLL}=-\hat\sigma_B\frac{4C_F}{3\pi}\alpha_s^3L^3\,\Delta Y\,{}_2F_2\Big(1,1;2,\frac52;-w\Big),\qquad w=\frac{N_c\alpha_s}\pi L^2;$$
    the first SLL is $\hat\sigma^{(S)}_1=\hat\sigma_B\frac4{15\pi^2}C_FN_c\alpha_s^4L^5\Delta Y$ (the $n=0$ term is single-logarithmic); at large $w$, $w\,{}_2F_2(1,1;2,\frac52;-w)/\ln w\to\frac32$ ($1.497$ at $w=10^8$): a slow power-like fall-off instead of a Sudakov $e^{-cw}$. SLLs also arise for $2\to1$ processes (from four loops) and $2\to0$ processes such as $q\bar q\to V$ with a central jet veto (from five loops). `% VF-FRO-7`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子截面。）
  - `\uses{prop:front-sll-all-orders}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: the tower from the iterated anomalous dimension (cited); the closed form is a series identity, full (term by term; OTHERS `s4`, $n\le8$, and `ex:front-sll-first`).
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (inherits `prop:front-sll-all-orders`). Claim N28 (K5, checked transcription; not printed as a result). The first SLL coefficient agrees with `ForshawKyrieleisSeymour2006` (A20: quoted, not recomputed there).

items.label: prop:front-restoration
items.title: Glauber 胶子引起的"因子化恢复"
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-restoration` — Glauber 胶子引起的"因子化恢复"** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「在三圈、领头对数精度上，」 the low-energy matrix elements $\mathcal W_m$ of gap-between-jets cross sections contain a perturbative active–active Glauber contribution, unambiguously defined in pure dimensional regularization, which at LL has exactly the structure needed to turn the double-logarithmic evolution back into single-logarithmic DGLAP evolution (`thm:pdf-dglap`) below the veto scale; it "breaks soft-collinear factorization at the cross-section level but restores PDF factorization" (`Becher:2024kmk`, read); consistency relations from EFT renormalization conditions, verified by an explicit three-loop computation (`Becher:2025igg`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子层次的低能矩阵元。）
  - `\uses{prop:front-sll-all-orders, thm:pdf-dglap}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P] (three loops, LL structure). Authors: "our analysis does not amount to a proof of PDF factorization, [but] demonstrates that the breaking of collinear factorization does not necessarily translate into a breaking of PDF factorization." The Glauber region involved is missed by automated region finders (`prop:front-hidden-regions`). Over-claim to avoid (S58): 「间隙截面的因子化已被证明破坏」 — the amplitude-level violation is [V]; PDF factorization of gap cross sections is [C] with restoration evidence.

items.label: prop:front-jettiness-cvl
items.title: 1-jettiness 中的相干性破坏对数
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-jettiness-cvl` — 1-jettiness 中的相干性破坏对数** [V].
  - *Statement.* For one-jettiness $\tau_1=\frac1Q\sum_k\min\{n_a\cdot p_k,n_b\cdot p_k,n_J\cdot p_k\}$ (`Stewart:2010tn`) in colour-singlet + jet production ($qg\to qZ$ studied), coherence-violating logarithms start at $\alpha_s^4\ln^6(1/\tau_1)$ relative to the Born cross section:
    $$\frac{d\sigma_1^{\rm CVL}}{dx_a\,dx_b\,d\mathcal B}\simeq\sum_{a=q,g}\mathcal A_a\Big(\frac{\alpha_s}\pi\Big)^4(-i\pi)^2\frac1{480}\ln^6\frac1{\tau_1},\qquad\mathcal A_q=\frac83N_c^2T_R^4f^q_Af^g_B\sigma^{(0)}_{qg},\quad\mathcal A_g=-\frac{32}3N_c^2T_R^4f^g_Af^q_B\sigma^{(0)}_{gq}$$
    (cumulant in $\tau_1$, differential in the Born variables; PDFs at $\mu_F=\tau_1Q$; fixed coupling); expected as $\alpha_s^nL^{2n-2}$ for $n\ge4$. Hence the cumulant cannot be written in the standard exponentiated form $\sigma(\tau_1)=\sigma\,e^{-\frac{\alpha_s}{2\pi}L^2(2C_F+C_A)}[g_0(\alpha_sL)+\alpha_sg_1(\alpha_sL)+\dots]$ (`Banfi:2025mra` eqs. (1)–(18), read). Mechanism: the Coulomb phases make $[\mathbf T^2_{ad},\mathbf T^2_s]\ne0$ (the colour of the incoming parton $a$ is resolved from that of its collinear emissions — initial-state angular ordering breaks); the extra logarithm comes from a double-logarithmic soft wide-angle phase-space area that never touches the collinear limit, hence no extra collinear poles — consistent with PDF factorization at $\tau_1Q$. `% VF-FRO-8`
  - `\uses{def:jets-algorithms, prop:sudakov-coulomb}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [V] for the all-order validity of the standard (three-Wilson-line soft function) factorization and exponentiation of $\tau_1$ in hadron collisions, evidence: explicit LL coherence-violation calculation (approximations: strongly ordered soft-collinear emissions, multiple-uncorrelated-emission approximation of the measurement, dipole-$k_T$ ordering — the $\alpha_s^4L^6$ term is ordering independent, $\alpha_s^4L^5$ is not). Conflict: `Alioli:2023rxx` state that $\tau_1$ in $V+$jet "does not suffer from superleading or nonglobal logarithms" (basis of N³LL resummation and of $N$-jettiness slicing) — contradicted in its super-leading part only; non-global logarithms are not at issue. *Verification (E16 confirmed, Q3):* established by two groups with different methods — the independent confirmation of the $qg\to q$ result in SCET with Glauber and new momentum modes is `Becher:2026kbr`, with the statement that "most existing factorization formulas for global LHC observables must b

items.label: asm:front-scet-modes
items.title: SCET 的模式完备性与 Glauber 模式的缺席
items.entry:
* **假设 `asm:front-scet-modes` — SCET 的模式完备性与 Glauber 模式的缺席** [A]. Register entry: Part VII annex §F1.3 (= `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §3).
  - (SM1) The hard, (anti-)hard-collinear, collinear, soft and soft-quark modes listed for the process reproduce all regions that contribute at the stated power (complete mode set; zero-bin subtractions consistent, `def:scet-zero-bin`).
  - (SM2) Glauber modes do not contribute at the stated power: automatic for decays into colour-neutral final states and for $e^+e^-$ annihilation; for partonic coefficient functions of processes with incoming partons the statement concerns the partonic cross section only (the hadronic version then rests on the leading-power factorization theorem of the process, e.g. `thm:dy-factorization`).
  - `\uses{def:scet-modes}`.

items.label: thm:front-hgg
items.title: $h\to\gamma\gamma$（$b$ 夸克圈）的重整化端点因子化定理
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:front-hgg` — $h\to\gamma\gamma$（$b$ 夸克圈）的重整化端点因子化定理** [A].
  - *Statement.* Let $\lambda=m_b/M_h$; the $b$-quark contribution $\mathcal M_b$ is $O(\lambda)$ (one mass insertion), with soft-quark exchange between the two photon-collinear sectors. (a) (bare theorem, `Liu:2019oav` eq. (34)) $\mathcal M_b=H_1\langle O_1\rangle+\int_0^1dz_1\,H_2(z_1)\langle O_2(z_1)\rangle+(z_1\to z_2)+H_3\langle O_3\rangle$, where $\langle O_3\rangle$ is the convolution of two radiative jet functions $J$ and a soft-quark function $S$ in $\ell_\pm$; with an analytic (rapidity) regulator $\eta$ the convolutions are defined (expand in $\eta$ before $\varepsilon$). (b) (refactorization conditions, proven in $D$ dimensions within SCET, `Liu:2020wbn` §3, the second via the discontinuity of the soft function)
    $$[\![\bar H_2(z)]\!]=-H_3\,J(zM_h^2),\qquad[\![\langle O_2(z)\rangle]\!]=-\frac{g_\perp^{\mu\nu}}2\int_0^\infty\frac{d\ell_+}{\ell_+}J(-\bar n_1\cdot k_1\,\ell_+)\,S(\ell_+\ell_-)\Big|_{z=\ell_-/\bar n_1\cdot k_1};$$
    they imply the cancellation of the rapidity-regulator dependence to all orders. (c) (renormalized theorem, `Liu:2020wbn` eq. (4.1), read; $\bar z=1-z$)
    $$\mathcal M_b=H_1(\mu)\langle O_1(\mu)\rangle+2\int_0^1dz\Big[H_2(z,\mu)\langle O_2(z,\mu)\rangle-\frac{[\![\bar H_2(z,\mu)]\!]}{z}[\![\langle O_2(z,\mu)\rangle]\!]-\frac{[\![\bar H_2(\bar z,\mu)]\!]}{\bar z}[\![\langle O_2(\bar z,\mu)\rangle]\!]\Big]+g_\perp^{\mu\nu}\lim_{\sigma\to-1}H_3(\mu)\int_0^{M_h}\frac{d\ell_-}{\ell_-}\int_0^{\sigma M_h}\frac{d\ell_+}{\ell_+}J(M_h\ell_-,\mu)J(-M_h\ell_+,\mu)S(\ell_+\ell_-,\mu)\Big|_{\rm LP}$$
    holds to all orders; the non-commutativity of endpoint cutoffs and renormalization is absorbed into $H_1(\mu)$; all ingredients obey RGEs (most anomalous dimensions known at two loops); the theorem predicts the three-loop logarithms $O(\alpha_b\alpha_s^2L^k)$, $k=6,5,4,3$, $L=\ln(-M_h^2/m_b^2)$. The writer copies the definitions of $H_i$, $\bar H_2$, $O_i$, $J$, $S$ from the sources (SCET conventions, §F0.3 row 16). `% VF-FRO-9`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本定理只涉及部分子振幅。）
  - `\uses{asm:front-scet-modes, def:front-endpoint, prop:scet-scet2}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch (0.4 pp): operator basis and matching; the endpoint behaviour of $H_2$ and $\langle O_2\rangle$; the $D$-dimensional conditions (b); rearrangement with subtractions in the $T_2$ term and cutoffs in the $T_3$ term; RG consistency.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: all-order SCET argument with refactoriz

items.label: prop:front-ggh
items.title: 轻夸克诱导的 $gg\to h$ 与重因子化减除方案
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-ggh` — 轻夸克诱导的 $gg\to h$ 与重因子化减除方案** [A].
  - *Statement.* The same structure holds with external colour for $gg\to h$ via light-quark loops; the refactorization-based subtraction (RBS) scheme yields a factorization theorem free of endpoint divergences; the three-loop logarithms $\alpha_s^3\ln^k$, $k=6,\dots,3$, are predicted and the first three towers $\alpha_s^n\ln^{2n-k}(-M_h^2/m_b^2)$, $k=0,1,2$, resummed (`Liu:2022ajh`, abstract). Precursors in conventional QCD: all-order LL for mass-suppressed amplitudes (`Liu:2017vkm`, `Liu:2018czl`, abstracts). Position-space SCET analyses of individual ingredients (abstracts): analyticity, renormalization and evolution of the soft-quark function (`Bodwin:2021cpx`); renormalization of the radiative jet function (`Bodwin:2021epw`); gauge invariance of radiative jet functions (`Bodwin:2023asf`); "hidden self-energy contributions of collinear functions" (`Bodwin:2025zzi`, 「（预印本）」). A rapidity-divergence-free definition of the $gg\to h$ soft-quark operator and an all-order relation (conformal symmetry) between the $\gamma\gamma\to h$ soft kernel and the $B$-meson LCDA kernel, bootstrapped to two loops (`Beneke:2024cpq`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子振幅。）
  - `\uses{thm:front-hgg, asm:front-scet-modes}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (abstract level; A28).

items.label: prop:front-nlp-threshold
items.title: 次领头幂次阈值 Drell–Yan 的 $d$ 维因子化
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nlp-threshold` — 次领头幂次阈值 Drell–Yan 的 $d$ 维因子化** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「在维数正规子移去之前（$d$ 维），」 for $q\bar q\to\gamma^*+X$ near $z=Q^2/\hat s\to1$ there is a general factorization at any subleading power, with NLP collinear functions defined by operator matching and checked against the method of regions to NNLO; "factorization holds only before the dimensional regulator is removed, due to a divergent convolution" when collinear and soft functions are expanded around $d=4$ first — an obstacle to NLP resummation beyond LL (`Beneke:2019oqx`, 「据该文摘要」).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子截面。）
  - `\uses{def:thr-limit, thm:thr-refactorization, def:front-endpoint}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P] (bare, $d$-dimensional; A28). Refines `prop:thr-nlp` (Ch13, pointer).

items.label: prop:front-nlp-ll
items.title: 次领头幂次的领头对数重求和与端点因子化条件
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nlp-ll` — 次领头幂次的领头对数重求和与端点因子化条件** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在领头对数精度上，」 (a) threshold resummation at NLP for DY (`Beneke:2018gvs`) and for $gg\to H$ (`Beneke:2019mua`) (abstracts); (b) off-diagonal DIS at large $x$ from $d$-dimensional refactorization: the $1/\varepsilon$-pole cancellation between regions bootstraps the LL series and reproduces Vogt's Bernoulli-number series for the off-diagonal DGLAP kernel at large $x$; off-diagonal splitting functions and soft-quark Sudakov logarithms are two-scale objects (`Beneke:2020ibj`, abstract); (c) "gluon thrust" (the power-suppressed $q\bar q$ vs gluon-jet channel of thrust): operatorial endpoint factorization conditions — the $r\to0$ limit of the B-type (anti-collinear) term equals the $\omega\to\infty$ limit of the A-type (soft) term to all orders, a "prerequisite for endpoint factorization", checked at $O(\alpha_s)$; with them a factorization formula whose terms are separately endpoint-finite and expressed through renormalized four-dimensional functions, and the first RG resummation of an endpoint-divergent SCET$_{\rm I}$ observable at LL, agreeing with the earlier $d$-dimensional result (`Beneke:2022obx`, read §§1–2, 4); (d) NLP soft function of the DY $qg$ channel, renormalization and RGE (`Beneke:2025ufd`, abstract). Related (abstracts): next-to-eikonal/generalized Low–Burnett–Kroll factorization for NLP threshold logarithms (`Bonocore:2015esa`, `Bonocore:2016awd`; N³LO checks `Bahjat-Abbas:2018hpv`); first subleading-power resummation of an event shape (thrust in $H\to gg$, LL; `Moult:2018jjd`) and radiative functions (`Moult:2019mog`).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子截面与系数函数。）
  - `\uses{asm:front-scet-modes, def:front-endpoint, thm:thr-refactorization}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] at LL only (all-order endpoint conditions argued, verified at one loop in (c)); beyond LL: `conj:front-nlp-beyond-ll`.

items.label: prop:front-nlp-dis
items.title: 次领头幂次 DIS 与 PDF 因子化：阈值 PDF 的双标度结构
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nlp-dis` — 次领头幂次 DIS 与 PDF 因子化：阈值 PDF 的双标度结构** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在领头对数精度上（预印本），」 position-space SCET factorization of the off-diagonal DIS channel at NLP in $1-x$ (leading twist): the anti-hard-collinear B1-current and soft-collinear (subleading-Lagrangian) contributions have endpoint divergences resolved by endpoint factorization relations; the PDF near threshold becomes a two-scale object at NLP; at leading power the threshold PDFs coincide with the $\xi\to1$ limit of the $\overline{\rm MS}$ PDFs and $\overline{\rm MS}$ renormalization commutes with the endpoint limit; LL resummation both in $d$-dimensional $\overline{\rm MS}$ and in a refactorization "endpoint scheme", with the all-order relation between the two PDF definitions to double-logarithmic accuracy (`Beneke:2026miy`, 「（预印本）」, read: abstract, conclusion).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子系数函数；强子层次见 `thm:pdf-dis-xspace`。）
  - `\uses{asm:front-scet-modes, def:front-endpoint, def:pdf-quark, thm:pdf-dis-xspace}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] at LL, 「（证明仅见于预印本）」 (A28).

items.label: conj:front-nlp-beyond-ll
items.title: 超出领头对数的次领头幂次端点因子化
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:front-nlp-beyond-ll` — 超出领头对数的次领头幂次端点因子化** [C].
  - *Statement.* For endpoint-divergent cross sections with incoming hadrons (threshold DY and DIS off-diagonal channels, event shapes with power-suppressed channels), NLP factorization with endpoint refactorization holds beyond LL with renormalized four-dimensional functions, and the refactorization conditions follow from a general theorem.
  - `\uses{def:front-endpoint, prop:front-nlp-ll}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [C] (open; OTHERS §5.5). Misconception M22 (领头幂次因子化可以直接推广到次领头幂次).
* *Budget of §24.7.* 1.6 pp.

#### §24.8 `sec:front-nlp-tmd`

* Text (0.1 pp): at NLP in $q_T/Q$ three kinds of corrections enter — kinematic (exact kinematics and frame dependence of the LP term), intrinsic/twist-3 (quark–gluon–quark correlators, "TMD twist") and dynamic (new hard functions); all results below are perturbative and assume, explicitly or implicitly, that Glauber exchanges do not spoil factorization at NLP.

items.label: conj:front-glauber-nlp
items.title: 次领头幂次 TMD 过程中 Glauber 交换的相消
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:front-glauber-nlp` — 次领头幂次 TMD 过程中 Glauber 交换的相消** [C].
  - *Statement.* In DY and SIDIS at next-to-leading power in $q_T/Q$, Glauber exchanges cancel to the extent needed for the NLP factorization formulas of `prop:front-tmd-nlp-operator` and `prop:front-sidis-nlp` to hold for hadronic cross sections (the analogue of the leading-power cancellation `lem:tmd-glauber`, [A]).
  - `\uses{def:tmd-kin, thm:tmd-factorization}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [C]: assumed everywhere — explicitly by `Ebert:2021jhy` ("working under the assumption that leading power Glauber interactions do not spoil factorization at this order"), implicitly elsewhere; no all-order argument exists at NLP. The forward pointers to `prop:front-tmd-nlp-operator`, `prop:front-sidis-nlp` in the statement are text, not dependencies.

items.label: prop:front-tmd-nlp-operator
items.title: TMD 算符展开与运动学幂次修正
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-tmd-nlp-operator` — TMD 算符展开与运动学幂次修正** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「以下陈述针对 TMD 算符展开本身（只含共线与软自由度）；它在强子截面中的有效性另需\cref{conj:front-glauber-nlp}。到 NLO 与 NLP，」 (a) TMD factorization follows at operator level with operators ordered by TMD twist (separating kinematic and genuine power corrections), process dependence entering through boundary conditions of background fields; the effective operator for the hadronic tensor is constructed to NLP ($\sim q_T/Q$) at NLO for any process with two detected states (`Vladimirov:2021hdn`, abstract); (b) twist-3 TMDs: definition, evolution equations (autonomous at large $N_c$), small-$b$ asymptotics, singularity structure, "physical" twist-3 TMDs (`Rodini:2022wki`, erratum, abstract); (c) each genuine term generates a series of kinematic power corrections with the same non-perturbative content; the series attached to the LP term is summed, restoring electromagnetic-current conservation and frame invariance (violated at fixed power), and gives a factorized form resembling the free-massless-quark hadronic tensor, checked at NLO (`Vladimirov:2023aot`, abstract); SIDIS version `Piloneta:2025jjb`; quasi-TMD version (link to Ch22 `thm:lamet-quasi-tmd`) `BrisCuerpo:2026pma` (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及算符展开；强子层次另需 `asm:intro-bridge` 与上述猜想。）
  - `\uses{thm:tmd-factorization, def:tmd-collins}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (NLO, NLP; abstract level). The pointer to `conj:front-glauber-nlp` in the first sentence is not a dependency (the statement is restricted to the Glauber-free operator expansion).

items.label: prop:front-sidis-nlp
items.title: SIDIS 方位角不对称的次领头幂次 SCET 因子化
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-sidis-nlp` — SIDIS 方位角不对称的次领头幂次 SCET 因子化** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在不含 Glauber 模式的 SCET 中（Glauber 相消见\cref{conj:front-glauber-nlp}），」 the power-suppressed hard-scattering effects in SIDIS azimuthal asymmetries factorize completely at NLP; TMDs depending on two longitudinal momentum fractions appear (one only beyond tree level); within the EFT only the leading-power soft function appears and is absorbed into the TMDs; one new hard coefficient enters (`Ebert:2021jhy`, erratum, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及有效理论中的因子化结构。）
  - `\uses{thm:tmd-factorization, def:tmd-soft, def:scet-modes, asm:front-scet-modes}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] within the stated restriction; the hadronic statement needs `conj:front-glauber-nlp` ([C]) (A25). (SM1) of `asm:front-scet-modes` is used; (SM2) is replaced by the restriction.

items.label: prop:front-nlp-tmd-oneloop
items.title: 单圈次领头幂次系数函数与扭度 3 TMD 演化
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nlp-tmd-oneloop` — 单圈次领头幂次系数函数与扭度 3 TMD 演化** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「在单圈阶，」 (a) all SIDIS structure functions at NLP with one-loop coefficient functions and kernels, and twist-3 TMD FFs with the LO kernel — with "several differences with earlier derivations", traced to the kinematics of quark–gluon interference terms (`Rodini:2023plb`, abstract); (b) kinematic, intrinsic and dynamic NLP pieces for DY and SIDIS, RG consistency at one loop, anomalous-dimension matrices mixing LP and NLP distributions, hard and soft functions different from LP, the rapidity anomalous dimension of the dynamic NLP distributions equal to the LP one (`Gamberg:2022lju`, 「（预印本）」, abstract); (c) DY at NLP in an EFT without explicit soft/collinear modes: power-suppressed operators $T_{(i,j)}$ giving the $O(q_T^2/q^2)$ coefficients of the usual PDFs, factorization for $q^2\gg q_T^2\gg\Lambda^2$, rapidity-divergence cancellation and overlap subtractions at NLP (`Inglis-Whalen:2021bea`, abstract); (d) Wilson-line approach: power corrections to TMD factorization (`Balitsky:2017flc`, `Balitsky:2017gis`) and the $1/Q^2$ corrections to the unpolarized DY tensor at large $N_c$ with electromagnetic gauge invariance (`Balitsky:2024ozy`) (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子系数函数与演化核。）
  - `\uses{prop:front-tmd-nlp-operator}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P] (one loop); the literature is not yet consistent — reported as the papers state it, no verdict (E34, Q3).

items.label: prop:front-msbar-negative
items.title: $\overline{\rm MS}$ 部分子分布可以为负
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-msbar-negative` — $\overline{\rm MS}$ 部分子分布可以为负** [V].
  - *Statement.* (a)（单圈 Yukawa 模型，\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$）In the Yukawa theory $\mathcal L_{\rm int}=-\lambda\bar\Psi_N\psi_q\phi+{\rm h.c.}$ with all particles massive and weak coupling, the one-loop quark-in-"nucleon" $\overline{\rm MS}$ distribution is
    $$f^{\rm renorm}_{q/p}(\xi;\mu)=a_\lambda(\mu)(1-\xi)\Big[\ln\frac{\mu^2}{\Delta(\xi)}-1+\frac{(m_q+\xi m_p)^2}{\Delta(\xi)}\Big]+O(a_\lambda^2),\qquad\Delta(\xi)=\xi m_s^2+(1-\xi)m_q^2-\xi(1-\xi)m_p^2,\quad a_\lambda=\frac{\lambda^2}{16\pi^2},$$
    with $\Delta>0$ for a stable target ($m_p<m_q+m_s$); for every $\xi$ it is negative for small enough $\mu$ and positive for large $\mu$. For $m_q=0.3$, $m_p=1.0$, $m_s=1.5$ GeV: negative for $\xi>0.264$ at $\mu=0.8$ GeV, negative for $\xi>0.567$ at $\mu=1.2$ GeV, positive for all $\xi$ at $\mu=2.5$ GeV; at $\xi\to1$ the sign changes at $\mu_*=m_s\exp\{\frac12[1-(m_q+m_p)^2/m_s^2]\}=1.70$ GeV; at $\xi\to0$ the bracket tends to $\ln(\mu^2/m_q^2)$. (b) Hence 「$\overline{\rm MS}$ 部分子分布在所有标度上非负」 is false as a general theorem. `% VF-FRO-10` (use the exact thresholds 0.264, 0.567; WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.11 item 7(c))
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题是 Yukawa 模型中的微扰陈述。）
  - `\uses{def:pdf-quark, def:prelim-msbar}`.
  - *Proof.* (a) full (0.3 pp): the DR integral of `CollinsRogersSato2022` eq. (58) with $\overline{\rm MS}$ subtraction gives the bracket and the counterterm $-a_\lambda(1-\xi)S_\varepsilon/\varepsilon$ (their eq. (57)); the $k_T$-cut-off version (eq. (59)), manifestly positive, agrees up to $O(m^2/\mu^2)$ (OTHERS `s2`; v2 check Q6 for the sign changes and $\mu_*$). Mechanism (CRS §VIII B): the $\overline{\rm MS}$ distribution equals the cut-off one minus $a_\lambda(1-\xi)\int dk_T^2/k_T^2$ over $[\mu^2,k^2_{\rm cut}]$; at low $\mu$ the $1/k_T^2$ asymptote over-subtracts the true small-$k_T$ behaviour.
  - *Status and gap.* [V], evidence: explicit perturbative counterexample (model). Dispute (E35 confirmed, Q3; both sides): `CandidoForteHekhorn2020` (abstract) argue that NLO $\overline{\rm MS}$ PDFs are positive "in the perturbative regime" (positive factorization scheme, then a scheme change small compared with LO); `CollinsRogersSato2022` (read): the argument fails at "bare PDFs are positive" — in "track B" (collinear divergences of massless partonic quantities regulated with $n>4$ and convoluted with bare hadronic PDFs) the UV-divergent contributions are positive for $n<4$ but "can and

items.label: prop:front-positivity-large-scale
items.title: 足够大标度上的正定性
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-positivity-large-scale` — 足够大标度上的正定性** [P].
  - *Statement.* Assume (PS1) leading-power collinear factorization for a set of positive observables that defines a "physical" scheme (e.g. DIS structure functions, `thm:pdf-dis-xspace`); (PS2) negligible higher twist; (PS3) perturbativity of the scheme transformation at NLO (`rem:pdf-schemes`). Then $\overline{\rm MS}$ PDFs are positive above a scale which, thanks to the Sudakov sign of the diagonal $O(\alpha_s)$ term ($\overline{\rm MS}$ over-subtracts collinear singularities, which in the diagonal channel have the Sudakov sign), is $x$-independent at large $x$; `Candido:2023ujx` estimate it conservatively as $Q^2\gtrsim5$ GeV$^2$ (from $\frac{\alpha_s}{2\pi}C_{gg}(x)<1$ at $x\sim0.3$, $\alpha_s\lesssim0.2$). CRS agree qualitatively ("once the $\overline{\rm MS}$ scale is large enough compared with intrinsic transverse momentum scales, the pdfs indeed become positive").
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：\cref{asm:intro-wightman}、\cref{asm:intro-composite}、\cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA0、MA1+MA2）。
  - `\uses{thm:pdf-dis-xspace, rem:pdf-schemes}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: an NLO argument under (PS1)–(PS3); higher orders and power corrections are not controlled; the threshold scale is non-perturbative.

items.label: prop:front-brst-bilocal
items.title: 双局域 PDF 算符 BRST 分类的矩约化
items.status: 地位与缺口).* [A] at the merge (integrator decision MD7, "frontier grades conservative"): the frontier report grades the reduction [A] (its support hypothesis is only [A] there); in this book all inputs are [R] or mathematics, and claim N04 is confirmed (two confirmations) **as an [A] proposition with prior art**: the general off-forward version is `Braun:2019qtp` eqs. (2.4), (2.6), (3.1), (3.2) (the idea goes back to Balitsky–Braun 1989), so the statement stays [A], is printed without novelty word ("not this work") and is not promoted to [R, R_PT] (the circularity check of the App L proof of `prop:appL-renormalized` was not part of the verification). Caveat: for forward on-shell partonic matrix elements in dimensional regularization, BRST and EOM operators need not drop out. The weakest step: this circularity question (E-S not applicable; an algebraic reduction). What it does **not** cover: the classification step *inside* the factorization proof (multilocal operators with fields at different light-cone positions before gauge invariance is imposed; `conj:front-brst-multilocal`); TMD operators (staples, rapidity divergences); off-shell renormalization of the light-ray operators themselves (not needed for physical predictions).
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-brst-bilocal` — 双局域 PDF 算符 BRST 分类的矩约化** [A] (planning tag at the merge: the source grade; **upgrade to [R, R_PT] only if N04 passes**, incl. the circularity check below).
  - *Statement.* Let $O_q(w^-)=\bar\psi(w)\gamma^+W[w,0]\psi(0)$, $w=(0^+,w^-,\mathbf 0_T)$, and let $O_g(w^-)$ be the analogous gluon operator (`def:pdf-lightray`). In physical (on-shell, BRST-invariant) matrix elements, to every order of renormalized perturbation theory, $O^R=Z_{OO}\otimes O_{(0)}$ with
    $$\int_0^1dz\,z^{N-1}Z_{OO}(z)=Z^{(N)}_{\rm twist\text{-}2}\quad\text{for all }N,$$
    the admixtures of BRST-exact (class A) and equation-of-motion (class B) operators drop out, and $Z_{OO}$ is uniquely fixed by its moments (compact support; for the $C$-even/$C$-odd combinations $q\pm\bar q$ and for the gluon only even or odd $N$ occur, and uniqueness follows from `thm:appK-muntz`). Hence the triangular mixing (`Collins2011` eq. (11.20); VF-FRO-15)
    $$\begin{pmatrix}O\\A\\B\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}Z_{OO}&Z_{OA}&Z_{OB}\\0&Z_{AA}&Z_{AB}\\0&0&Z_{BB}\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}O_{(0)}\\A_{(0)}\\B_{(0)}\end{pmatrix}$$
    restricted to physical matrix elements holds for the bilocal PDF operators. `% VF-FRO-15`
  - *Inputs in this book* (they replace the hypotheses of the frontier report, whose numbering is never printed): local classification for $\bar\psi\gamma^+(iD^+)^{N-1}\psi$ and $F^{+\mu}(iD^+)^{N-2}F^+{}_\mu$ — all indices "+", hence symmetric and traceless, exactly the twist-2 operators (`prop:appJ-local-operators`); support of the forward matrix elements in $[-1,1]$ order by order (`thm:pdf-support-pt`); the bare non-local operator is the generating function of the bare local ones (`prop:appL-bare`; exact for compact support, since the Fourier transform of a compactly supported distribution is entire with Taylor coefficients = moments) and the renormalized moment relation (`prop:appL-renormalized`).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及算符与部分子态。）
  - `\uses{def:pdf-lightray, prop:appJ-local-operators, thm:pdf-support-pt, prop:appL-bare, prop:appL-renormalized, thm:appK-muntz}`.
  - *Proof.* Full (0.4 pp): (1) moments of the bare bilocal operator = bare local twist-2 operators (`prop:appL-bare`); (2) local classification ⇒ in physical matrix elements only $Z^{(N)}_{\rm twist\text{-}2}$ survives (`prop:appJ-local-operators`); (3) compact support ⇒ the matrix element of the bilocal operator is determined by its moments (`thm:pdf-support-pt`); (4) define $Z

items.label: conj:front-brst-multilocal
items.title: 多局域光线算符的 BRST 分类
items.entry:
* **猜想 `conj:front-brst-multilocal` — 多局域光线算符的 BRST 分类** [C].
  - *Statement.* Every BRST-invariant multilocal operator of ghost number zero, supported on a light-like line, of the type that appears in the leading-region decomposition of the off-shell Green function (`Collins2011` (11.12)), is the sum of a gauge-invariant operator, a BRST variation (class A) and an operator that vanishes by the equations of motion (class B).
  - `\uses{def:prelim-brst, prop:appJ-local-operators}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [C]: assumed by Collins (quote in `rem:front-k-gluon`); wording of the literature status only as 「据我们截至 2026 年 10 月的文献检索（INSPIRE 与网络检索），尚未见非定域（多局域）BRST 分类的证明」 (A06 item (9): holds). Natural tool: localization by an auxiliary field (the Wilson line as a field), as in the renormalizability proofs for space-like Wilson-line operators (`Ji:2017oey`, `Ishikawa:2017faj`, `Green:2017xeu`; Ch22 `prop:lattice-renormalizability`, `asm:lamet-aux-renorm`, pointers). Over-claim to avoid: 「Collins (2011) 证明了非定域算符的 BRST 分类」. Coordination: App J `rem:appJ-nonlocal` ([A] in v1) should point here and to `prop:front-brst-bilocal` (§F5).
* *Budget of §24.10.* 1.2 pp.

#### §24.11 `sec:front-smallx`

* Framing (text, 0.1 pp): small-$x$ "factorization" is a different expansion from the collinear one — the Regge limit $s\gg|t|$ (DIS: $x\to0$ at fixed $Q^2$), organized by rapidity factorization of Wilson lines (shockwave picture): projectile impact factors ⊗ target Wilson-line correlators evolved in rapidity (BK/JIMWLK). Its results are all-order statements within the eikonal (Regge) expansion at fixed logarithmic accuracy, not leading-power theorems with power-counting control; the grades below are relative to that framework. The LO BK equation (VF-FRO-12 = VF-MISC-4) is stated in Ch17 (`thm:smallx-bk`), not here.

items.label: prop:front-nlo-bk
items.title: NLO BK/JIMWLK 与三圈 BK 核
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nlo-bk` — NLO BK/JIMWLK 与三圈 BK 核** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在 eikonal（Regge）展开的次领头对数精度上，」 (a) the NLO evolution of colour dipoles contains quadratic and cubic non-linearities; the NLO kernel is the sum of a running-coupling part ($\propto\beta_0$), a conformal part ($1\to3$ dipole transitions) and a non-conformal double-logarithmic term; its forward linearization agrees with the NLO BFKL kernel (`Balitsky:2007feb`; the $\alpha_s^2\zeta(3)\times$(dipole) mismatch reported in its §VIII was traced by the same authors to an erroneous evaluation of an integral assumed to vanish and disappears after correction, `Balitsky:2009xg` §6, "In QCD"; quark part and running coupling `Balitsky:2006wa`, `Kovchegov:2006vj`); (b) NLO JIMWLK (`Balitsky:2013fea`, `Kovner:2013ona`; conformal symmetry `Kovner:2014xia`; "unabridged" `Kovner:2014lca`; abstracts); (c) the three-loop BK kernel in planar $\mathcal N=4$ SYM via the equivalence with non-global logarithms, with a Lorentz-covariant IR/collinear subtraction method and checks against the Pomeron trajectory and the twist-2 spectrum (`Caron-Huot:2016tzz`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题是关于 Wilson 线算符的演化方程。）
  - `\uses{thm:smallx-bk, thm:smallx-bfkl}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] within the eikonal framework; no disagreement with NLO BFKL is printed: the $\zeta(3)$ term of `Balitsky:2007feb` §VIII was withdrawn by its authors (`Balitsky:2009xg` §6, "In QCD"; claim E34 item (iii), refuted as a disagreement, Q3) — never attribute it to longitudinal cutoffs.

items.label: prop:front-bk-collinear
items.title: NLO BK 的不稳定性与共线重求和
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-bk-collinear` — NLO BK 的不稳定性与共线重求和** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「对现实的初始条件，」 the NLO BK solution is unstable (`Lappi:2015fma`); kinematic constraints and collinear resummation cure it (`Beuf:2014uia`, `Iancu:2015vea`) (abstracts).
  - `\uses{prop:front-nlo-bk}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P]: the resummation prescriptions differ beyond the controlled logarithms; a scheme-independent collinear improvement is open (`rem:front-open`).

items.label: prop:front-regge
items.title: 高能极限中的 Wilson 线方法、胶子 Regge 化与 Regge 极限的红外奇异部分
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-regge` — 高能极限中的 Wilson 线方法、胶子 Regge 化与 Regge 极限的红外奇异部分** [A].
  - *Statement.* (a) The eikonal approximation with rapidity-dependent collections of Wilson lines (Balitsky–JIMWLK) reproduces Reggeization and BFKL; from four loops BFKL dynamics is incompatible with the dipole formula for IR divergences; in the strict planar limit the theory can be formulated with a finite, process-dependent number of Wilson lines without reference to a reggeized gluon, checked exactly in $\mathcal N=4$ (`Caron-Huot:2013fea`, abstract, §4 checked). (b) The IR-singular part of $2\to2$ amplitudes in the high-energy limit is given in closed form to all orders at NLL (two-Reggeon contribution), predicting the Regge limit of the soft anomalous dimension at any loop order (`Caron-Huot:2017zfo`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子振幅。）
  - `\uses{thm:smallx-bfkl, thm:sudakov-ir-poles}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: all-order arguments within the eikonal (Regge) expansion at fixed logarithmic accuracy (Wilson-line method; (a) checked exactly only in planar $\mathcal N=4$; (b) all orders at NLL); sources partly at abstract level 「据该文摘要」; not a leading-power theorem of QCD (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.9, BK/JIMWLK item).

items.label: prop:front-regge-pole
items.title: 简单 Regge 极点因子化在 NNLL 失效
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-regge-pole` — 简单 Regge 极点因子化在 NNLL 失效** [V].
  - *Statement.* Using IR factorization, the simplest Regge-pole factorization of $2\to2$ amplitudes fails at NNLL in $\ln(s/|t|)$: a two-loop non-logarithmic double pole and non-factorizing single-logarithmic singular terms at three loops; the hard functions vanish in $d=4$ to all orders up to NLL (`DelDuca:2013ara`, `DelDuca:2014cya`, 「据该文摘要」).
  - `\uses{def:smallx-regge, thm:sudakov-ir-poles}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [V] for Regge-pole factorization beyond NLL, evidence: explicit calculation based on IR factorization ([A], `thm:sudakov-ir-poles`); the corrected multi-Reggeon picture is [A] (`prop:front-regge`(b)).

items.label: prop:front-smallx-tmd
items.title: 小 $x$ 的 TMD 与 Sudakov 对数
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-smallx-tmd` — 小 $x$ 的 TMD 与 Sudakov 对数** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在色玻璃凝聚框架的领头阶与领头对数精度上，」 (a) effective $k_t$-factorization for dijets in dilute–dense collisions; the Weizsäcker–Williams and dipole gluon distributions are the universal small-$x$ TMDs, with process-dependent gauge links at small $x$ (`Dominguez:2011wm`); (b) Sudakov double logarithms combined with small-$x$ resummation in the saturation formalism (`Mueller:2012uf`) (abstracts). (c)（部分结果，\tagP）rapidity evolution of gluon TMDs from low to moderate $x$ (`Balitsky:2015qba`); gauge-invariant TMD factorization at small $x$, rapidity-only factorization, Sudakov–BFKL interpolation (`Balitsky:2020jzt`, `Balitsky:2021fer`, `Balitsky:2023hmh`, `Balitsky:2026lop`) (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （高能展开框架内的陈述；靶的非微扰信息作为初始条件输入。）
  - `\uses{thm:smallx-bk}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (LO/LL) for (a), (b); (c) [P].

items.label: prop:front-smallx-helicity
items.title: 小 $x$ 螺旋度演化：截距与 BER 的分歧
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-smallx-helicity` — 小 $x$ 螺旋度演化：截距与 BER 的分歧** [A].
  - *Statement.* 「在双对数近似与大 $N_c$（或大 $N_c\&N_f$）下（据该文摘要），」 helicity evolution at small $x$ (double logarithms $\alpha_s\ln^2(1/x)$) follows from polarized dipole amplitudes, i.e. sub-eikonal Wilson-line operators (`Kovchegov:2015pbl`, erratum; `Kovchegov:2016weo`), in the revised form of `Cougoulic:2022gbk`; its exact large-$N_c$ solution gives $\Delta\Sigma\sim\Delta G\sim g_1\sim(1/x)^{\alpha_h}$ with
    $$\alpha_h\simeq3.66074\sqrt{\frac{\alpha_sN_c}{2\pi}}\quad(\texttt{Borden:2023ugd}),\qquad\alpha_h^{\rm BER}\simeq3.66394\sqrt{\frac{\alpha_sN_c}{2\pi}}\quad(\text{infrared evolution equations, }\texttt{Bartels:1996wc});$$
    the resummed $\Delta\gamma_{GG}(\omega)$ agrees with the fixed-order anomalous dimensions through three loops and differs from the Bartels–Ermolaev–Ryskin result (`Bartels:1995iu`, `Bartels:1996wc`) from four loops on; large $N_c\&N_f$: `Adamiak:2023okq`, `Borden:2024bxa` (quark↔gluon transition operators), `Borden:2025ehe` (analytic solution; a slight disagreement with BER and with Blümlein–Vogt `Blumlein:1996hb` persists). `% VF-FRO-17` (in the book the formula is typeset with the keys as `\cite`, not `\texttt`)
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （高能展开框架内的陈述。）
  - `\uses{thm:smallx-bk, def:pdf-polarized}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (double-logarithmic approximation, large $N_c$ or large $N_c\&N_f$); the disagreement with BER is an open problem, printed without a verdict (E34(iv), Q3; 2026 status `Borden:2025ehe`). Related (abstracts): gluon orbital angular momentum at small $x$ (`Hatta:2016aoc`), small-$x$ evolution of the gluon GPD $E_g$ (`Hatta:2022bxn`) — [A]/[P] in words.
* *Budget of §24.11.* 1.2 pp.

#### §24.12 `sec:front-dps`

* Text (0.1 pp): two hard scatterings in one $pp$ collision (e.g. double Drell–Yan); formally power suppressed for integrated cross sections but leading for transverse-momentum-differential ones ($q_{T,i}\ll Q_i$) and enhanced for many final states at small $x$. Framework: colour-correlated DPDs, power counting, elements of an all-order proof, links to GPDs and the lattice (`DiehlOstermeierSchafer2012`, erratum); colour correlations, interference, evolution, the $1\to2$ splitting singularity ($\propto1/y^2$ at small separation $y$) and the double-counting problem (`Manohar:2012jr`, `Manohar:2012pe`) (abstracts). Glauber cancellation for double DY to all orders, integrated and $q_T$-differential (`Diehl:2015bca`), and soft-gluon decoupli

items.label: prop:front-dps-scheme
items.title: 无重复计数的双部分子散射
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-dps-scheme` — 无重复计数的双部分子散射** [A].
  - *Statement.*
    $$\sigma=\sigma_{\rm SPS}+\sigma_{\rm DPS}-\sigma_{\rm sub},\qquad\frac{d\sigma_{\rm DPS}}{dx_1dx_2d\bar x_1d\bar x_2}=\sum\hat\sigma_{a_1b_1}\hat\sigma_{a_2b_2}\int d^2y\,\Phi^2(y\nu)\,F_{b_1b_2}(\bar x_i,y)\,F_{a_1a_2}(x_i,y),$$
    with a cut-off function $\Phi(u)\to1$ for $u\gg1$, $\Phi(u)=O(u^\delta)$ at small $u$ (e.g. $\Theta(u-b_0)$ or $1-e^{-u^2/4}$), $\nu\sim Q$; $\sigma_{\rm sub}$ is the DPS formula with both DPDs replaced by their fixed-order perturbative splitting forms (for 1v1: $\sigma_{1v1,{\rm pt}}$). At small $y$ the $\Phi$ dependence cancels between $\sigma_{\rm DPS}$ and $\sigma_{\rm sub}$ (leaving SPS); at large $y$, $\sigma_{\rm SPS}\simeq\sigma_{\rm sub}$ (leaving DPS). DPDs are thereby defined as operator matrix elements usable at higher orders (`Diehl:2017kgu` §4.1, read). `% VF-FRO-13`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：\cref{asm:intro-composite}、\cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA0、MA1+MA2）。
  - `\uses{def:break-dpdf, thm:break-double-dy}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: scheme consistency argued at fixed order; the cancellation holds only up to higher orders when the DPDs are evolved. Full DPS factorization with coloured final states or jets stays [C] (`conj:break-dps-coloured`, Ch18, pointer).

items.label: prop:front-rapidity-renorm
items.title: 多部分子软因子快度发散的重整化定理
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-rapidity-renorm` — 多部分子软因子快度发散的重整化定理** [A].
  - *Statement.* Rapidity divergences of multi-parton soft factors arise from exchanges with the distant transverse plane and are structurally equivalent to UV divergences via a conformal map; hence a renormalization theorem for rapidity divergences (proof via the conformal transformation), a definition of multi-parton TMDs, and an exact relation between soft and rapidity anomalous dimensions (the three-loop rapidity anomalous dimension is derived) (`Vladimirov:2017ksc`, 「据该文摘要」).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及软因子（Wilson 线真空期望值）。）
  - `\uses{def:tmd-soft, def:break-dpdf}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (abstract level). Forward pointers from Ch22 and Ch23 (`prop:yzliu-rapidity-linear` status) land here; Vladimirov calls the rapidity factorization of the SIDIS soft factor "the open question" (`Vladimirov:2017ksc`, JHEP version, p. 32; not in arXiv v2; as quoted in `Liu:2023pjb`).

items.label: prop:front-dpd-evolution
items.title: 色关联 DPD 的演化与匹配
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-dpd-evolution` — 色关联 DPD 的演化与匹配** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「到次领头阶（两圈核），」 TMD DPS factorization, evolution and matching (`Buffing:2017mqm`, erratum/addendum 2021); evolution kernels for colour-non-singlet DPDs at NLO (`Diehl:2022rxb`); two-loop $1\to2$ splitting (`Diehl:2019rdh`); quark-mass effects in the splitting (`Diehl:2022dia`); momentum and number sum rules in position space (`Diehl:2020xyg`); review `Diehl:2017wew` (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及演化核与部分子层次的匹配系数。）
  - `\uses{def:break-dpdf, prop:front-rapidity-renorm}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P] (computed to NLO); phenomenology of colour-correlated DPDs is open.
* *Budget of §24.12.* 0.8 pp. Optional figure `fig:front-dps-double-counting`.

#### §24.13 `sec:front-jets`

* Text: the $e^+e^-$ factorization theorem for jet processes with non-global logarithms (`Becher:2015hka`, `Becher:2016mmh`; VF-FRO-14 — hard functions $\mathcal H_m$ × multi-Wilson-line soft functions $\mathcal S_m$, RGEs as matrices in multiplicity space, BMS at LL and large $N_c$; coft modes for narrow cones) is the core statement `thm:jets-ngl-factorization` (Ch16, [A]); the light-jet mass and hemisphere soft function (`Becher:2016omr`, abstract) likewise. This section records what goes beyond it.

items.label: prop:front-ngl
items.title: 非全局对数：超出领头对数与测量驱动的因子化
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-ngl` — 非全局对数：超出领头对数与测量驱动的因子化** [A].
  - *Statement.* (a) A colour density matrix resums non-global logarithms to all logarithmic orders; its anomalous dimension is known at LO and NLO; by a conformal transformation it is equivalent to shockwave (Regge) evolution, rederiving NLO BFKL/Balitsky–JIMWLK, and the exponentiation of divergences holds to all logarithmic orders (`Caron-Huot:2015bja`, abstract). (b) 「在大 $N_c$ 与次领头对数精度上，」 NLL resummation of NGLs: integro-differential equations in planar large-$N_c$ QCD in dimensional regularization and in a finite four-dimensional form, checked against full QCD at $O(\alpha_s^2)$ (`Banfi:2021owj`); jet calculus (`Banfi:2021xzn`); two-loop anomalous dimension (`Becher:2021urs`); NLL resummation at the LHC in a large-$N_c$ parton shower (`Becher:2023vrh`); 2026 preprints on the two-loop anomalous dimension for non-global and clustering logarithms (`Becher:2026zon`) and NLL NGLs in Higgs production (`Becher:2026iim`) (abstracts). (c) NGLs factorize and are resummed down to an unresolved scale by making sufficiently many measurements ("dressed gluons"; `Larkoski:2015zka`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子截面。）
  - `\uses{thm:jets-ngl-factorization, thm:jets-bms}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] ((b): large $N_c$, NLL; abstract level). Coordination: Ch16 `prop:jets-ngl-beyond` ([P]) concerns finite-$N_c$ and fixed-order results; the [A] here is restricted to large $N_c$ (§F5). At hadron colliders Glauber phases produce SLLs (§24.6).

items.label: prop:front-jet-substructure
items.title: 喷注子结构、修饰喷注与半单举喷注函数
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-jet-substructure` — 喷注子结构、修饰喷注与半单举喷注函数** [A].
  - *Statement.* (a) 「在 soft-drop 幂次计数 $z_{\rm cut}\ll1$ 中，」 a large class of soft-drop groomed observables (incl. jet mass) factorizes; without the groomed soft wide-angle radiation all singular contributions are collinear, so the normalized distributions have no NGLs to all orders and are process independent up to the quark/gluon fraction; NNLL resummation (`Frye:2016aiz`); (b) hadronization in groomed jets: in an intermediate jet-mass region the leading power corrections are three universal non-perturbative parameters with perturbative coefficients; at smaller mass a non-normalized shape function (`Hoang:2019ceu`); (c) semi-inclusive jet functions $J_i(z,\omega_J,\mu)$ obey exactly time-like DGLAP evolution (`prop:pdf-timelike-dglap`; $\ln R$ resummation), and single-inclusive jet production shares the hard functions of single-inclusive hadron production with $D_i^h\to J_i$ (`Kang:2016mcy`) (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子截面；(b) 的非微扰参数作为输入。）
  - `\uses{def:jets-algorithms, prop:pdf-timelike-dglap}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] ((c): NLO + RG consistency; abstract level).

items.label: prop:front-lightray-ope
items.title: 能量关联子的共线因子化与共形场论中的光线 OPE
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-lightray-ope` — 能量关联子的共线因子化与共形场论中的光线 OPE** [A].
  - *Statement.* (a) The energy–energy correlator factorizes at leading power in the collinear limit in a generic QFT, with anomalous dimensions given by moments of time-like splitting functions (`prop:pdf-timelike-dglap`); NNLL in QCD (`Dixon:2019uzg`, abstract). (b) 「在共形场论中（非微扰），」 null-integrated (light-ray) operators on the same null plane have a convergent OPE ("light-ray OPE"; celestial blocks for event shapes), derived within non-perturbative CFT using the Lorentzian inversion formula (`Kologlu:2019mfz`, abstract) — the non-perturbative analogue of the collinear factorization of event shapes, not a QCD statement.
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （(a) 是微扰陈述；(b) 是共形场论中的非微扰陈述。）
  - `\uses{def:jets-algorithms, prop:pdf-timelike-dglap}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] ((b): CFT, non-perturbative; the only non-perturbative positive statement of this chapter).
* *Budget of §24.13.* 1.0 pp.

#### §24.14 `sec:front-quarkonium`

* Text: NRQCD factorization (`BodwinBraatenLepage1995`) $d\sigma(H)=\sum_nd\hat\sigma_n(\Lambda)\langle\mathcal O^H_n(\Lambda)\rangle$ is [A] for decays (`thm:heavy-nrqcd-decay`, Ch20) and a conjecture for production (`conj:heavy-nrqcd-production`, Ch20, [C]); the questions are (i) whether the IR divergences of the short-distance coefficients match those of the LDMEs to all orders, (ii) universality of the LDMEs.

items.label: prop:front-nrqcd-ir
items.title: NNLO 的红外极点与规范完备的八重态算符
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-nrqcd-ir` — NNLO 的红外极点与规范完备的八重态算符** [P].
  - *Statement.* 「在 NNLO（两圈）阶，」 (a) in gluon fragmentation at large $p_T$ the NNLO IR poles are not matched by the conventional octet production operators; gauge invariance and factorization require operators with Wilson lines (non-abelian phases); with these "gauge-completed" matrix elements factorization is restored at NNLO, first to $O(v^2)$ and then to all orders in $v$ for the octet→singlet transition (`NayakQiuSterman2005a`, `NayakQiuSterman2005b`, `NayakQiuSterman2006`, abstracts); caveat (NQS 2005): beyond NNLO, "in the absence of special cancellations", further non-local operators outside the NRQCD velocity expansion may be needed. (b) A covariant two-loop calculation of the LDME for an S-wave colour-octet pair fragmenting into a colour-singlet pair of arbitrary orbital angular momentum finds the IR divergences independent of the Wilson-line direction, as universality requires; the results differ from NQS in some respects (sources identified); both are consistent with NRQCD factorization; "the general principle that underlies this confirmation … has yet to be revealed" (`Bodwin:2019bpf`, abstract).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* （本命题只涉及部分子层次的匹配。）
  - `\uses{def:heavy-nrqcd}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [P] (two loops) (A25). Over-claim to avoid (S58): 「NQS 的规范完备 Wilson 线在 NNLO 不改变结果」 — they are necessary at NNLO.

items.label: rem:front-quarkonium-alternatives
items.title: 唯象张力与替代方案
items.entry:
* **注 `rem:front-quarkonium-alternatives` — 唯象张力与替代方案** (no tag). The LP + NLP collinear factorization in $1/p_T$ (single-parton and heavy-quark-pair fragmentation; `Kang:2011mg`, `Kang:2014tta`, `Kang:2014pya`, `Fleming:2012wy`, `Ma:2013yla`, `Ma:2014eja`, `Bodwin:2014gia`) is the core statement `prop:heavy-quarkonium-fragmentation` (Ch20, [A]); it rests on single-inclusive collinear factorization at high $p_T$, for which `Collins2011` p. 571 singles out the NQS 2005 argument as the "notable exception" to the lack of detailed proofs (A13: check page). LHCb $\eta_c$ data vs heavy-quark spin symmetry: "challenges NRQCD factorization" (`Butenschoen:2014dra`) vs consistent fits (`Han:2014jya`, `Zhang:2014ybe`) — both sides reported (A25); the polarization puzzle persists (not reviewed). Soft-gluon factorization (`Ma:2017xno`, abstract): soft hadronization effects treated without expanding first in the relative velocity, claimed better velocity convergence — a proposal with partial checks (a conjecture as a theorem, in words).
* *Budget of §24.14.* 0.7 pp.

#### §24.15 `sec:front-qed`

items.label: thm:front-luxqed
items.title: 由结构函数确定质子的光子 PDF（LUXqed）
items.entry:
* **定理 `thm:front-luxqed` — 由结构函数确定质子的光子 PDF（LUXqed）** [A].
  - *Statement.* In the $\overline{\rm MS}$ scheme
    $$xf_{\gamma/p}(x,\mu^2)=\frac1{2\pi\alpha(\mu^2)}\int_x^1\frac{dz}z\Big\{\int_{\frac{x^2m_p^2}{1-z}}^{\frac{\mu^2}{1-z}}\frac{dQ^2}{Q^2}\alpha^2(Q^2)\Big[\Big(zp_{\gamma q}(z)+\frac{2x^2m_p^2}{Q^2}\Big)F_2\Big(\frac xz,Q^2\Big)-z^2F_L\Big(\frac xz,Q^2\Big)\Big]-\alpha^2(\mu^2)z^2F_2\Big(\frac xz,\mu^2\Big)\Big\},$$
    $zp_{\gamma q}(z)=1+(1-z)^2$, including all terms of order $\alpha L(\alpha_sL)^n$, $\alpha(\alpha_sL)^n$ and $\alpha^2L^2(\alpha_sL)^n$ ($L=\ln\mu^2/m_p^2$); $F_{2,L}$ include the elastic parts $F_2^{\rm el}=\frac{G_E^2+\tau G_M^2}{1+\tau}\delta(1-x)$, $F_L^{\rm el}=\frac{G_E^2}\tau\delta(1-x)$, $\tau=Q^2/4m_p^2$ (`Manohar:2016nzj` eq. (6), read). `% VF-FRO-11`
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：\cref{asm:intro-wightman}、\cref{asm:intro-composite}、\cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA0、MA1+MA2）。
  - `\uses{def:pdf-gluon, thm:disall-factorization}`.
  - *Proof plan.* Sketch: a fictitious BSM process $l+p\to L+X$ through a transition magnetic moment $(e/\Lambda)\bar L\sigma^{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}l$; its cross section is computed (i) exactly in terms of $F_2$, $F_L$ (the lepton current is not renormalized) and (ii) by collinear factorization with $\overline{\rm MS}$ PDFs (the photon PDF defined as the QED analogue of `def:pdf-gluon`); equating the two to the stated accuracy fixes $f_\gamma$. The follow-up (`Manohar:2017eqh`, abstract) derives the result from the operator definition, gives an exact representation in terms of $F_2$, $F_L$ to all orders in QED and QCD including non-perturbative corrections, the formula one order higher, polarized and TMD photon PDFs, and $P_{\gamma i}$ at $O(\alpha\alpha_s)$ and $O(\alpha^2)$ in agreement with direct calculations.
  - *Status and gap.* [A]: relies on collinear factorization of the auxiliary process (`thm:disall-factorization`, [A]); the operator-definition derivation makes it process independent. Coordination: Ch11 (photon structure) uses VF-FRO-11 as well (§F5).

items.label: prop:front-lepton-pdf
items.title: 轻子与电子的 PDF、QED 与混合演化核
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-lepton-pdf` — 轻子与电子的 PDF、QED 与混合演化核** [A].
  - *Statement.* (a) Lepton PDFs of the proton from the same structure-function input at NLO (`Buonocore:2020nai`); (b) electron, positron and photon PDFs of the electron at NLL in QED with all-order large-$z$ resummation matched to $O(\alpha^3)$ (initial conditions `Frixione:2019lga`; `Bertone:2019hks`, erratum); (c) QED and mixed QCD×QED corrections to the Altarelli–Parisi kernels at $O(\alpha\alpha_s)$ (`deFlorian:2015ujt`) and $O(\alpha^2)$ by "abelianization" (`deFlorian:2016gvk`) — explicit kernels at the stated orders (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：\cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1+MA2）（(a)；(b)、(c) 只涉及部分子层次的演化）。
  - `\uses{thm:front-luxqed, thm:pdf-dglap}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (abstract level); (c) are finite-order results (in words).

items.label: prop:front-ew-pdf
items.title: 电弱 PDF 与 $Q\gg M_W$ 的电弱对数
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-ew-pdf` — 电弱 PDF 与 $Q\gg M_W$ 的电弱对数** [A].
  - *Statement.* At $Q\gg M_W$ electroweak PDFs and their evolution resum EW logarithms (`Bauer:2017isx`; polarization effects `Bauer:2018arx`; $W$, $Z$ PDFs from structure functions `Fornal:2018znf`); in an NLL framework the objects of the factorization theorem need not be $SU(2)\times U(1)$ singlets, and DGLAP-type evolution captures all EW logarithms only for sufficiently inclusive measurements (e.g. invariant mass), while identifying a final-state lepton requires fragmentation functions and soft exchanges (`Manohar:2018kfx`) (abstracts).
  - *Non-perturbative line.* 非微扰地位：\cref{asm:intro-bridge}（MA1+MA2）。
  - `\uses{thm:pdf-dglap}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [A] (abstract level).

items.label: prop:front-ew-violation
items.title: 电弱 Bloch–Nordsieck 抵消的失效与测量弱荷的观测量
items.entry:
* **命题 `prop:front-ew-violation` — 电弱 Bloch–Nordsieck 抵消的失效与测量弱荷的观测量** [V].
  - *Statement.* (a) Collider initial states carry definite non-abelian (weak-isospin) charges, so EW Sudakov double logarithms do not cancel in inclusive TeV-scale cross sections: the Bloch–Nordsieck cancellation fails for non-singlet initial states (`Ciafaloni:2000df`, 「据该文摘要」). (b) For observables that measure the weak charge of final states in hadronic collisions, non-factorizable EW corrections break the parton-model picture at leading power, starting at $O(\alpha_s^2\alpha_W^2\log^4(Q^2/M_W^2))$, not resummable by DGLAP alone (`Baumgart:2018ntv`, 「据该文摘要」).
  - `\uses{def:ir-safe}`.
  - *Status and gap.* [V], evidence: explicit perturbative calculations (as computed in those papers; A25). The QCD analogue is `prop:ir-bn-failure` (Ch4, [V], pointer). Open: resummation of the non-factorizing EW logarithms.
* *Budget of §24.15.* 1.0 pp.

(「预印本」 where applicable). items.label: prop:appB-webs
items.title: 非阿贝尔指数化
items.status:
地位与缺口.** All-order combinatorial argument in the literature for two lines; at $O(g^2)$ the statement is [R, R_def] (`prop:sudakov-webs`, Ch5, pointer); multi-leg webs and their renormalization are not needed in this book.
  - `\uses{prop:appB-rules, lem:appB-shuffle}`

Content: let $\mathcal H_{a,\Gamma}$ be the span of the functions obtained from $\tilde N_{a,\Gamma}$ by finitely many $\partial/\partial p_j^\nu$, multiplications by $p_{j\mu}$ and $m\partial_m$; there is an integer $k$ such that every $h\in\mathcal H_{a,\Gamma}$ obeys $|h(q;p)|\le K_h|q|^{D-1-a}(\ln|q|)^k$ for $|q|\ge2$, uniformly in $q/|q|$ and for $p$ in compact sets (massive Euclidean model, each order). `\uses{def:appM-normal-product}`.

items.label: rem:appM-exceptional
items.title: 例外动量与前向矩阵元
items.entry: - **注 `rem:appM-exceptional` — 例外动量与前向矩阵元** (no tag). The forward Compton configuration $(p,-p)$ is exceptional and on-shell partons are massless; in BPHZL the IR finiteness of zero-momentum gauge-invariant twist-2 insertions in off-shell forward kinematics can be checked at low orders but has no all-order proof; in DR these insertions exist at every order (`prop:appM-zero-momentum-insertion`, [A]), the algebraic identities hold for any momenta, and for forward on-shell partonic amplitudes the analytic step is the per-graph theorem `thm:appM-forward-expansion` (§M.7). Hence the rigorous perturbative OPE with a remainder bound is at Euclidean non-exceptional momenta; the forward on-shell remainder is `asm:appM-forward` (reduced in §M.7 by `cor:appM-forward-ope`, not discharged), and the hadronic transition is `asm:intro-np-ope`. `fig:appM-euclid-forward` (FIGURES_INDEX_v2 N19). Misconception guarded: 「前向在壳部分子矩阵元直接给出 Wilson 系数，无需额外步骤」 (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §6.9).

items.status: 地位与缺口.** [A]: `Breitenlohner:1976te` Thm 1 applies (all vertices of IR degree $\ge4$, fields of IR dimension $\ge1$) and gives the $\varepsilon\to0$ limit as a tempered distribution; that this limit, in the framework set up in `Breitenlohner:1975hg`, is the dimensionally regularized $\overline{\rm MS}$ insertion used here has not been checked against that paper; upgrade path to [R, R_PT]: this identification written out and independently confirmed. (Writer's note, not printed: X3 Remark F.5 proposes [R, R_PT]; that grade was set in X3's final round without an independent confirmation, the reviewed grade is [A]; the v2.3 sentence calling the $\varepsilon$ of `Breitenlohner:1976te` a damping regulator is not supported by the verification records and is not printed.)
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appM-zero-momentum-insertion` — 零动量扭度 2 算符插入在维数正规化中的存在性** [A]. For $n\ge2$ the first-order insertion of $\int d^Dx\,O^{(n)}_i(x)$ (zero momentum transfer) into a two-point function of elementary fields exists in DR at every order; for $p^2<0$ it equals $(-p^2)^{a}\sum_kc_k\ln^k(-p^2/\mu^2)$, with $a$ fixed by dimensional analysis. `\uses{def:dis-twist}`. Proof plan: $\lambda\int O^{(n)}$ is an integrated term of IR degree $n+2\ge4$, and so are its $\overline{\rm MS}$ counterterms; all QCD vertices have IR degree 4 and the fields have IR dimension $\ge1$ in every covariant gauge, so `Breitenlohner:1976te` Thm 1 (hypotheses checked in the X3 report) gives a tempered distribution in $p$; on $p^2<0$ it is a function $f(p^2)$, and dimensional analysis with polynomial $\ln\mu$ dependence, $f(\lambda^2s)=\lambda^{2a}\sum_k(\ln\lambda)^kf_k(s)$, forces the stated form. Given the identification named in the status note, it settles, for off-shell forward two-point functions, the question left open in `rem:appM-exceptional`. **地位与缺口.** [A]: `Breitenlohner:1976te` Thm 1 applies (all vertices of IR degree $\ge4$, fields of IR dimension $\ge1$) and gives the $\varepsilon\to0$ limit as a tempered distribution; that this limit, in the framework set up in `Breitenlohner:1975hg`, is the dimensionally regularized $\overline{\rm MS}$ insertion used here has not been checked against that paper; upgrade path to [R, R_PT]: this identification written out and independently confirmed. (Writer's note, not printed: X3 Remark F.5 proposes [R, R_PT]; that grade was set in X3's final round without an independent confirmation, the reviewed grade is [A]; the v2.3 sentence calling the $\varepsilon$ of `Breitenlohner:1976te` a damping regulator is not supported by the verification records and is not printed.)

Content: massless QCD, DR (Laurent coefficients in $\varepsilon$), on-shell parton target $j$ ($p^2=0$, physical polarizations, spin averaged), Euclidean direction $\hat q$ with $2p\cdot\hat q$ purely imaginary: at each order $T^{\mu\nu}_j-\sum_{d_O\le N}\tilde C^{\mu\nu}_O(q;\mu)\langle p|[O]_\mu|p\rangle=O(|q|^{1-N}\ln^k|q|)$, uniformly in the direction. `\uses{def:dis-compton}`.

items.label: asm:appM-brst-ope
items.title: OPE 的 BRST 结构：带一个复合旁观者的欧氏展开 (Eε)
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appM-brst-ope` — OPE 的 BRST 结构：带一个复合旁观者的欧氏展开 (Eε)** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content (v2.3, after the X3 verification): **(B2) ≡ (Eε)** — in bare DR at fixed generic $\varepsilon$ (any $\xi_0$, $B$ off shell, no $\gamma_5$, D-dimensional algebra), for one composite spectator $Z=s\phi$ ($\phi$ an elementary field) the large-$q$ expansion $\langle\mathcal J(q)\,Z\,\Phi\rangle=\sum_{d_O\le a}C_O\langle O\,Z\,\Phi\rangle+\sum_{O'}C^Z_{O'}(q;p_Z)\langle O'\,\Phi\rangle+\mathcal R'$ holds, with the coefficients $C_O$ of the expansion without $Z$ (`prop:dis-ope-euclid`), **merged coefficients** $C^Z_{O'}$ (hard subgraphs containing the $Z$ vertex) polynomial in $p_Z$, all coefficients graded-homogeneous, and $\mathcal R'=O(|q|^{1-a}\ln^k|q|)$. **(B1)** is retired (the name is not reused): its Ward identities hold exactly in DR and its contact-term clause is not needed. The earlier (B2), without merged terms, is not the correct generalization of the Euclidean expansion: the merged terms turn $sX_d=0$ into $sX_d\in\mathcal E$ (`thm:appM-brst-reduction`). `\uses{def:appM-alien}`.

items.title: 每阶的前向在壳部分子 OPE
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [A]: through (A3) of `prop:dis-ope-euclid` (cited; [A] by decision D3) and (Eε) of `asm:appM-brst-ope`; `asm:appM-forward` is thereby **reduced** to (A3) + (Eε) + Joglekar–Lee, not discharged, and `prop:dis-ope-forward` stays [A]. items.entry:
- **推论 `cor:appM-forward-ope` — 每阶的前向在壳部分子 OPE** [A]. (a) For $|\omega|<1$, at every order and Laurent order, $T^{\mu
u}_j=\sum_OC^{\mu
u}_O\langle j|[O]|jangle$ for an on-shell massless parton target $j$ (physical polarization average); only twist-2 gauge-invariant operators contribute, $A^{(n)}_{i/j}=\sum Z\cdot{m tree}$, and $T^{(j)}_2=4\sum_{n\ {m even}}\omega^{n-1}\sum_iC^{(n)}_{2,i}A^{(n)}_{i/j}$; $T^{(g)}_2$ is regular at $\omega=0$; (b) for $|q|\ge4p^0$, uniformly in the Euclidean direction, $|T_j-\sum_{d_O\le N}C_O\langle j|[O]|jangle|\le C|q|^{1-N}(1+\ln|q|)^k$ — the content of `asm:appM-forward`. `\uses{thm:appM-forward-expansion, lem:appM-matroid, lem:appM-t2-projector, lem:appM-ne, prop:dis-ope-euclid, thm:appM-brst-reduction, prop:appJ-local-operators, lem:appM-alien-vanish}`. Proof plan (full, given the premises): (1) the forward graphs are exactly the hard (AI) two-leg graphs; (2) by `thm:appM-forward-expansion` and `lem:appM-t2-projector` the naive terms sum to $\sum_OC^{m bare}_OV_O(p,-p)$, and on-shell bare matrix elements are trees (scaleless loops); (3) $C^{m bare}=C^{\overline{m MS}}Z$; by `thm:appM-brst-reduction` and Joglekar–Lee the coefficients outside GI ⊕ aliens vanish, GI mixes into GI + aliens and aliens only into aliens; (4) forward on-shell massless trees are built from $p$ alone ($p^2=0$, $\slashed pu=0$, ${m tr}(\slashed p\gamma^{[r]})=0$ for $r
e1$), so they are non-zero only on the $[n]$-isotypic part of dimension $n+2$, i.e. within $\mathcal B^+_n$, where by `lem:appM-ne`(ii) and the Lorentz covariance of $Z$ no evanescent and no four-quark operator occurs — evanescent operators contribute nothing, even through mixing; alien tree vertices contracted with the physical average vanish (`rem:appM-forward-aliens`); (5) gluon regularity: gauge-invariant two-gluon vertices are transverse; (6) with $p^2=0$ only twist 2 survives, with finite coefficients by (A3); (7) the bound (b) from Cauchy estimates on $|\omega|= rac34$ ($|\omega|\le2p^0/|q|\le rac12$, $|\hat P|^2_E\le2(p^0)^2$). **地位与缺口.** [A]: through (A3) of `prop:dis-ope-euclid` (cited; [A] by decision D3) and (Eε) of `asm:appM-brst-ope`; `asm:appM-forward` is thereby **reduced** to (A3) + (Eε) + Joglekar–Lee, not discharged, and `prop:dis-ope-forward` stays [A]. One-loop instances: `ex:appM-forward-oneloop` ($N\le8$).

items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appM-oswi` — 前向在壳胶子振幅的 Ward 恒等式** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for the amputated forward on-shell gluon Compton amplitude $M_{ab}$ at each order in DR, $p^aM_{ab}\varepsilon^b=0=\varepsilon^aM_{ab}p^b$ for all $\varepsilon$ with $\varepsilon\cdot p=0$ (including $\varepsilon=p$); equivalently $p^aM_{ab}\propto p_b$ (the BRST form, the ghost amplitude being inside the proportionality factor). `\uses{def:dis-compton, def:prelim-brst}`.

Convergence of the OPE at finite distance in massive and massless $\varphi^4_4$ at fixed loop order (`Hollands:2011gf`, `Holland:2014pna`); all-order bounds for gauge-invariant correlators in Yang–Mills (`Frob:2015uqy`); existence and recursion of the OPE in Yang–Mills (`Frob:2016mzv`, preprint), associativity and recursive construction (`Holland:2015tia`, `Holland:2014ifa`); OPE from phase-space properties in AQFT (`Bostelmann:2005rr`); curved spacetime (`Hollands:2006ag`, `Hollands:2007zg`); Borel summability in the Gross–Neveu model (`Feldman:1986ax`, `Gawedzki:1985ez`); lattice short-distance comparisons are evidence, not proof. head: Appendix N — Collins 减除法的精确形式 / The precise form of Collins' subtraction method
box: 证明了：`thm:appN-subtraction`（\tagR，$R_{\rm cond}$，前提 `asm:appN-contour`）；`thm:appN-fibered-subtraction`、`lem:appN-identification`、`lem:appN-lp-certificate`（数学：实纤维化底空间上的积分范数形式，可逐图检验的条件 (FR)(FI)）；`lem:appN-lc-positivity`（$R_{\rm PT}$）；`cor:appN-cs3-fibered`（$R_{\rm cond}$，前提 `asm:appN-lce`）；第 9 章 `lem:method-meets`、`lem:method-covering`、`prop:method-chains`、`lem:method-pairing`、`prop:method-product`、`lem:method-no-pole`、`lem:method-telescoping`（数学）、`lem:method-i0-compat`（$R_{\rm PT}$）、`lem:method-local-accuracy`、`cor:method-removing-eps`（$R_{\rm cond}$）的证明；`lem:appN-error-table`（$R_{\rm cond}$）；第 10 章 `prop:disall-two-routes`、`prop:disall-factorized-subtraction`、`thm:disall-renorm-compat`，第 14 章 `prop:tmd-zero-bin-soft`，第 19 章 `prop:excl-soft-cancel` 的证明（$R_{\rm cond}$）；`prop:appN-sia`、`prop:appN-thrust`、`prop:appN-dy`、`prop:appN-tmd-window`、`thm:appN-structure`（$R_{\rm cond}$）；`prop:appN-triangle-exact`、`prop:appN-ladder`（$R_{\rm PT}$）；`prop:appN-triangle-cs`（$R_{\rm PT}$，计算机辅助：单圈离壳三角图的纤维化 (CS1)–(CS3) 与积分减除定理）；`prop:appN-phi36-dis`、`prop:appN-massive-photon`、`prop:appN-twoloop-algebra`（$R_{\rm PT}$，标量模型）；`prop:appN-twoloop-remainder`（$R_{\rm cond}$，前提 `asm:appN-analytic-reg`、`asm:appN-values`）。
