items.label: asm:appN-contour
items.title: (GA1) 围道
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-contour` — (GA1) 围道** [\tagA]. There is a contour $\Omega$ (a complex deformation of real space, equal to it as $\|k\|\to\infty$) such that (a) for $\Gamma$ and every $C_R\Gamma$ the homotopy from real space to $\Omega$ crosses no singularity, so the $\Omega$-integral (when it exists) equals the real-space integral defined with each denominator's own $i0$ (as $i\eta$, $\eta\to0^+$); (b) each $\int_\Omega C_R\Gamma\,d\mu$ (defined for $\varepsilon\in(0,\varepsilon_0]$ by (CS3)) continues to a meromorphic function near $\varepsilon=0$. `\uses{def:appN-integrand, def:method-subtraction}`. Status and users: `ASSUMPTIONS.md`; where the fibered densities are absolutely integrable on the real base, (a) is replaced by the graph-by-graph checkable conditions (FR)+(FI) of `thm:appN-fibered-subtraction` (the one-loop triangle: `prop:appN-triangle-cs`); (b) is still needed.

items.label: asm:appN-envelope
items.title: (GA3) 幂次计数包络
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-envelope` — (GA3) 幂次计数包络** [\tagA]. For every $R_0\in\mathcal R$ there is $\Phi_{R_0}\ge0$ on $U_{R_0}$ with $\int_{U_{R_0}}\Phi_{R_0}\,d\mu\le CL^K$ uniformly in $\varepsilon$, such that (i) every partially approximated integrand of the telescoping sum of `lem:method-telescoping` (each factor $i$ taken as $f_i$, as $T_{R_0}f_i$, or as the envelope $g_i$ of rows 3, 4, 6 of `tab:method-errors`) is $\le C\Phi_{R_0}$ on $U_{R_0}\cap\{\|k\|\le1\}$; (ii) on $U_{R_0}\cap\{\|k\|\ge1\}$ every term of the telescoping sum is uniformly integrable with integral $\le C\lambda^aL^K$ (the error factor itself need not decay); (iii) (pointwise boost bound) on $U_{R_0}\cap\{\|k\|\le1\}$, for rows 3, 4, 6: $|f_i-T_{R_0}f_i|\le C(s_{R_0}/t_{R_0})\,g_i$. `\uses{def:method-neighbourhoods, def:method-collinear-approx, def:method-soft-approx}`.

items.label: asm:appN-separation
items.title: (GA4) 分离性
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-separation` — (GA4) 分离性** [\tagA]. On $U_R$: (i) every line of $\mathsf H_R$ has $|l^2-M_l^2|\ge c\,t_R^2$ (Łojasiewicz-type inequality with exponent 2: "distance $\gtrsim t_R$ from smaller pinch sets" ⇒ "virtuality $\gtrsim t_R^2$"); (ii) every jet line changed by $T_R$ (lines from $\mathsf J_{R,A}$ entering $\mathsf H_R$ that receive projections; lines carrying a soft momentum of $R$) has $|l^+|\ge c\,t_R$ ($B$: $|l^-|$) — $\mathcal R$ contains the (generally subleading) endpoint assignments that make such lines soft; (iii) for every soft momentum $k$ of $R$ and every $A$-jet line $l=p+k$ it flows through ($p$ the $A$-collinear part): $|k^+k^-|\ge c\,\mathbf k_T^2$ and $|\tilde D|\ge c\,(|p^+||k^-|+v_A(p))$, with $v_A(p)\equiv|p^+p^-|+\mathbf p_T^2$ and $\tilde D=(p+\pi_-(k))^2-M_l^2+i0=p^2-M_l^2+2p^+k^-+i0$; $B$ jets with $+\leftrightarrow-$. The first inequality of (iii) says that $\Omega\cap U_R$ contains no Glauber region. `\uses{def:method-neighbourhoods, def:ir-glauber}`.

items.label: asm:appN-lce
items.title: 光锥序表示与协变值的等同（LCE）
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-lce` — 光锥序表示与协变值的等同（LCE）** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for every graph $G$ of the scalar models (M1), (M2) that satisfies the hypotheses of `lem:appN-lc-positivity` and the infrared-finiteness condition (IRF) — its (renormalized) parametric integral converges absolutely for every $\varepsilon\in[0,\varepsilon_0]$ —, the fibered value equals the covariant value: $\int_B\rho_G\,d\mu_\varepsilon=I_G$. `\uses{def:appN-fibered, lem:appN-lc-positivity}`.

items.label: asm:appN-collins
items.title: 一般图的 Collins 条件
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-collins` — 一般图的 Collins 条件** [\tagA]. For every leading-power integrand $\Gamma$ of the process (a single graph, or a family of graphs with a common routing), including multi-direction processes and non-adapted routing, with its region set $\mathcal R$ (meet-closed, containing the endpoint assignments required by `asm:appN-separation`): (CS1)$_{R_0}$ and (CS2)$_{R_0}$ hold for every $R_0\in\mathcal R$, and (CS3) holds. `\uses{def:method-collins-conditions, def:appN-meet-closed}`. Full status/users/upgrade path in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`; in the text the 「地位」 field lists what **is** provable: (CS1) for minimal $R_0$ (`lem:method-local-accuracy`); under (Com)(Abs) the reduction to grouped power counting (`prop:method-product`); the one-loop off-shell triangle (fibered (CS1)–(CS3) completely verified, `prop:appN-triangle-cs`) and the $\varphi^3_6$ one-rung DIS ladder (`prop:appN-phi36-dis`); general one-loop Sudakov-type graphs (slot X2b) and the QCD two-rung ladder (slot X2c) were not delivered; the obstacles (term-by-term conditions false: `prop:appN-ladder`(c); (Abs) failure: `rem:method-abs-failure`; non-adapted routing: `rem:appN-routing`); `CollinsSoperSterman1989` §10.1 "there is as yet in the literature no complete and systematic subtraction procedure in QCD… even in the case of deeply inelastic scattering" (survey item 6, [txt]).

items.label: asm:appN-ward-product
items.title: Ward 恒等式的乘积结构与减除的重组
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-ward-product` — Ward 恒等式的乘积结构与减除的重组** [\tagA]. At fixed order, after summing all graphs and all attachments of longitudinal and soft gluons: **(WI1)** each chain term's approximated integrand factorizes by the Ward identities (`lem:method-ward-multi`, `prop:method-collinear-wilson`, `prop:method-soft-wilson`) into "hard ⊗ collinear matrix elements with Wilson lines ⊗ soft matrix element", and the Ward identities apply equally to integrands already modified by other approximators; **(WI2)** grouped by the order of the $A$-collinear part, $\sum_{\rm graphs,R}C_R\Gamma$ reorganizes into the products used in `prop:tmd-zero-bin-soft`(b) and `thm:appN-structure`. Renamed items: the reference's (W1)(W2) are (WI1)(WI2) here (no clash with (W1)–(W4) of `asm:intro-wightman`). `\uses{lem:method-ward-multi, prop:method-collinear-wilson, prop:method-soft-wilson, def:method-subtraction}`.

items.label: asm:appN-brst-nonlocal
items.title: 多定域光线算符的 BRST 分类
items.status: 地位与缺口」 paragraphs.
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-brst-nonlocal` — 多定域光线算符的 BRST 分类** [\tagC] (new register entry, see `ASSUMPTIONS.md` §00.3; tag fixed at the merge, integrator decision MD1: no all-order argument for the multilocal case exists — Collins 2011 §11.3.2 assumes it, the frontier assessment is [C], `conj:front-brst-multilocal` states the same claim). The BRST-invariant multilocal light-ray operators that appear in the leading-region expansion of Green functions with longitudinal (K) gluon attachments (`Collins2011` eqs. (11.12)–(11.17)) are, modulo BRST-exact (class A) and equation-of-motion (class B) operators, gauge invariant; classes A and B have vanishing matrix elements between physical states and vanishing insertions into Green functions of gauge-invariant operators at separated points. `\uses{def:appM-alien, prop:appJ-local-operators}`. Used only by `thm:appN-structure` (whose content grade is therefore [C]). It is **not** a `\uses` premise of `lem:method-ward-multi` or of the chapter [A] process theorems: there it is a *named gap* (WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.6 item 6), stated in their 「地位与缺口」 paragraphs.

items.label: asm:appN-cutsum
items.title: 割图求和的公共表示
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-cutsum` — 割图求和的公共表示** [\tagA]. $\sigma[M]=\sum_G\sum_{\mathcal C}\int\Gamma_{G,\mathcal C}M$ ($G$ forward graphs, $\mathcal C$ final-state cuts compatible with the measurement $M$). **(CU1)** For each $G$ there are a common domain $\Omega_G$ (e.g. light-cone-ordered PT: all minus components integrated by residues for uncut and by $\delta$ functions for cut lines, leaving the $(+,T)$ components) and an integrand $F_G$ (rational functions × measurement) with $\sum_{\mathcal C}\int\Gamma_{G,\mathcal C}M=\int_{\Omega_G}F_G\,d\mu_G$. **(CU2)** The approximators on cut graphs induce linear maps on $F_G$ (commuting with the cut sum: cutting replaces a propagator by $\delta^+$ without changing its momentum; eikonal lines obey the same cutting rules), and (GA1)–(GA4), (CS1)–(CS3) hold for $F_G$, $\lambda$ possibly a measured variable. **(CU3)** (event shapes) for all $R$ and $s\in(0,1)$: $\int_{U_R\cap\{|\tau_R-\tau|\le s\tau\}}|F_G|\,d\mu_G\le C\,s\,L^K$. Renamed items: the reference's (X1)–(X3) are (CU1)–(CU3) (no clash with the verify extensions X1–X3). `\uses{def:appN-integrand, def:prelim-cut}`.

items.label: asm:appN-uv
items.title: 被积函数层次的紫外重整化
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-uv` — 被积函数层次的紫外重整化** [\tagA]. **(U1)** $\Gamma$ is renormalized at the integrand level — by DR + $\overline{\rm MS}$ with the subtraction of UV subdivergences organized as local integrand counterterms ($R$ operation in DR), or by Zimmermann's forest formula with BPHZ(L) Taylor subtractions **supplemented by the finite non-invariant counterterms that restore the Slavnov–Taylor identities** (algebraic renormalization; `Breitenlohner:1975hg`, `Breitenlohner:1976te`, `Piguet:1995er`) — so that $\Gamma$ is a single function on $\Omega$ with $\int|\Gamma|$ uniformly bounded near $\varepsilon=0$; graphical Ward identities hold exactly for DR graphs; **(U2)** for every $R$ and every renormalization part $\gamma$, $T_R$ and $t_\gamma$ commute up to polynomials in the external momenta of $\gamma$ (finite local counterterms) that give no leading contribution in the power counting of $T_R$. Corrects ERR-M28 (the passage to $\overline{\rm MS}$ is not merely a finite renormalization of couplings and fields). `\uses{def:appN-integrand, thm:prelim-composite-renorm}`.

items.label: asm:appN-multren
items.title: 共线因子的乘法重整化（维数正规化路线）
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-multren` — 共线因子的乘法重整化（维数正规化路线）** [\tagA]. **(Z1)** In moment space the bare collinear factor renormalizes multiplicatively, $f_N^{\rm bare}=Z_Nf_N^{\rm ren}$ (matrix in parton species, $Z_N$ a pure $\overline{\rm MS}$ pole series, target independent) — a theorem for gauge-invariant local twist-2 operators between on-shell states (`thm:prelim-composite-renorm`, `prop:appJ-local-operators`, `thm:pdf-moments-local`; off shell, mixing with BRST-exact and EOM operators has non-zero matrix elements), an independent input for fragmentation functions (`rem:pdf-ff-multren`: FF moments are not local-operator matrix elements); **(Z3)** (DR route) for on-shell massless partonic targets with DR as the only IR regulator: (i) the factorization identity holds with the same $\hat{\mathsf H}^{\rm bare}$ (bare partonic PDFs scaleless, $f^{\rm bare}_{\cdot/j}=\delta$; consistent with `asm:appN-values`(V2) but not derived from it); (ii) $C\equiv\hat{\mathsf H}^{\rm bare}Z$ has no pole at $\varepsilon=0$ (mass factorization: the IR poles of the DR partonic forward amplitude are exactly those of $Z^{-1}$; verified at fixed orders by the finiteness of the NNLO/N3LO coefficient functions). (Z3)(ii) is what the process theorems use; under (Z2) it follows from (Z1) and (Z3)(i) by `thm:disall-renorm-compat`. The register's (Z2) is the separate entry `asm:appN-ir-regulator`. `\uses{thm:pdf-moments-local, prop:pdf-partonic-dr}`.

items.label: asm:appN-ir-regulator
items.title: 保持 Ward 恒等式的部分子靶红外正规化
items.entry:
- **假设 `asm:appN-ir-regulator` — 保持 Ward 恒等式的部分子靶红外正规化** [	agC]. **(Z2)** There exist partonic targets $j$ with an IR regularization (parameter $\lambda$) preserving the Ward identities used in `prop:disall-factorized-subtraction`, such that `prop:disall-two-routes`(a)(b) hold and $f^{m ren}_{N,\cdot/j}$ is finite at $\varepsilon=0$ and invertible order by order. Partial realizations: non-singlet (quark) targets with massive on-shell quarks; gluon targets only off shell with alien counterterms (`Collins:1994ee`, `Falcioni:2022fdm`), at the price of replacing (Z1) by its off-shell form with BRST-exact and EOM operators. Used only by `thm:disall-renorm-compat` (whose content grade is therefore [C]); the process theorems use the DR route (Z1)(Z3)(ii) and never this entry. `\uses{asm:appN-multren}`.

items.label: asm:appN-tmd
items.title: TMD 输入
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-tmd` — TMD 输入** [\tagA]. For SIDIS, $e^+e^-\to h_1h_2X$ and DY in the TMD region ($y_A=-y_B=Y$, approximators `def:appN-tmd-approx`): **(T1)** tails — constants $a>0$, $c_1\ge c_0>1+2a$, $J$ such that for $c_0L\le Y\le c_1L$, on every $U_R$ and on the subset where some soft or collinear line has $|\mathbf k_T|\le\lambda^{1+a}$, the integral norm of integrand minus approximants is $O(\lambda^aL^KY^J)$, and the constants of (CS1)(CS2) grow at most like $Y^J$; **(T2)** asymptotic linearity in $b$ space — $\ln\tilde S(y_1,y_2)=a_S+(y_1-y_2)\tilde K+O(e^{-(y_1-y_2)})$, $\ln\tilde f_A^{\rm unsub}(y_B)=\alpha_A-y_B\tilde K+O(e^{y_B-y_{P_A}})$ with the **same** slope $\tilde K$ ($B$ alike); **(T3)** $b$-space multiplicative renormalization $\tilde f^{\rm bare}=Z_{\rm TMD}(\mu,\zeta)\tilde f^{\rm ren}$, soft-factor renormalization by the cusp anomalous dimension; **(T4)** in the combination divided by the soft factor, $y_B\to-\infty$ ($y_A\to+\infty$) can be taken under the integral, so that the $O(e^{2(y_B-y_k)})$ difference of `def:appN-tmd-approx` disappears and the collinear factor equals the light-front TMD of `def:tmd-unsub`. `\uses{def:appN-tmd-approx, def:tmd-unsub, def:tmd-soft}`.

items.label: asm:appN-endpoint
items.title: 端点条件
items.entry:
- **假设 `asm:appN-endpoint` — 端点条件** [\tagA]. For every graph of the pion form factor (and of the meson side of $\gamma_L^*$ meson production), at each order: **(E1)** endpoint integrability of meson-jet subgraphs — integrating the meson-jet subgraph over its internal loop momenta at fixed fraction $x$ (with absolute values), $|J|(x)$ satisfies $\int_0^t|J|(x)\,dx+\int_{1-t}^1|J|(x)\,dx\le C\,t\,L^K$ for $0<t<1$ (the partonic analogue of "the DA vanishes linearly at the endpoints"); **(E2)** the hard kernel is at most $1/x$, $1/\bar x$ singular at the endpoints; **(E3)** $\int_\Omega|C_{R_{\rm end}}\Gamma|\,d\mu\le C\lambda^aL^K$ and $C_R\Gamma\in\mathfrak S(U_{R_{\rm end}})$ for every $R>R_{\rm end}$. (E1)(E2) make row 8 hold on $U_R$ and give $O(t)$ bounds for $\int_0^tdx\,|J|(x)/x$; (E3) makes the endpoint region and the leakage of larger regions into it power suppressed. Inner names (E1)–(E3) as in WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.4 item 4 (scoped; not the error types E-S…). `\uses{def:appN-excl-approx, def:method-collins-conditions, def:excl-da}`.
- *Target:* **`prop:excl-soft-cancel`** (Ch19, [R, R_cond: `asm:appN-endpoint`, `asm:appN-collins`, `asm:appN-ward-product`] — the premise sentence must contain `asm:appN-ward-product` because step (i) uses (WI1); report to the core outline if its wording lacks it) — 色单态介子的软胶子在被积函数层次相消: (a) pion form factor — regions $H$, collinear jets of the incoming and outgoing pion (each entering $H$ by a valence pair plus longitudinal gluons), soft subgraph connecting them, endpoint regions: (i) for every region with soft lines attached to meson jets, after summing all attachments of the soft lines to the meson jets, $\sum C_R\Gamma=0$ **exactly** (integrand-level algebraic identity); (ii) on $U_S$ the attachment-summed exact graphs are power suppressed — soft regions do not contribute at leading power; (iii) endpoint contributions are power suppressed; (iv) `thm:appN-subtraction` gives factorization with only hard–collinear subtraction terms; (b) $\gamma_L^*$ meson production: as (a) on the meson side; the proton side is a single forward jet (non-forward matrix element → GPD), soft lines attached to it belong to it, Glauber excluded by (GA4)(iii) — an assumption for DVMP; (c) if the hard kernel is more singular than $1/x$ at an endpoint (twist-3 contributions, transverse photons) so that $\int_0dx\,|J|(x)|\mathsf H(x)|$ diverges, (E2) and (GA3) fail on $U_{R_{\rm end}}$: the premise of `thm:appN-subtraction` is violated. *Proof plan:

items.title: 两圈图样积分的辅助解析正规化
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appN-analytic-reg` — 两圈图样积分的辅助解析正规化** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content (two-loop planar vertex of (M1), each line raised to an independent power $1+\delta_l$): **(RA1)** the analytically regularized pattern integrals are meromorphic in $(\varepsilon,\delta)$ (analytic renormalization proves this for quadratic propagators, not for the eikonal-type linear factors); **(RA2)** the nine single-approximator integrals $\int T_R\Gamma$ are regular at $\delta=0$ for $\varepsilon$ in a punctured neighbourhood of 0, and their $\delta\to0$ limits are their dimensionally regularized values. `\uses{prop:appN-twoloop-algebra}`.

head: Appendix O — 光锥排序微扰论与 Drell–Yan 的 Glauber 相消 / Light-cone-ordered perturbation theory and the Glauber cancellation in Drell–Yan
box: 证明了：`lem:appO-lcopt`、`lem:appO-numerators`、`lem:appO-glauber-pc`、`lem:appO-insertion-values`、`lem:appO-joint-localization`（扇区规则、含 $\sum_\sigma|w_\sigma|$ 的误差界、权重的连续性与扭结）、`lem:appO-multipole-localization`、`lem:appO-quadrant-residues`、`lem:appO-preintegration-localization`、`lem:appO-no-crossing`、`prop:appO-target`、`prop:appO-eikonal`、`prop:appO-strict-window-shape`（\tagR，$R_{\rm PT}$）；`lem:appO-cut-position`、`lem:appO-equal-time`、`lem:appO-carrier`、`lem:appO-kplus-rotation`、`lem:appO-ray-identity`、`lem:appO-two-insertion-bounds`（数学）；`lem:appO-glauber-operator`、`lem:appO-halfcoinc-colour`（$R_{\rm def}$；指向过去的软因子的幺正性是第 9 章 `lem:method-soft-unitarity` 的过去指向情形）；`lem:appO-hard-locality`、`lem:appO-unitarity`、`prop:appO-ss-localize`、`lem:appO-side-independent-windows`、`prop:appO-ss-cancel`、`prop:appO-one-sided`、`thm:appO-main`、`cor:appO-interface`、`prop:appO-tmd`（$R_{\rm cond}$）；`lem:appO-orientation`（$R_{\rm PT}$；第 12 章 `lem:dy-poles-orientation` 即其陈述）；第 12 章 `prop:dy-eikonal-twogluon` 的证明（$R_{\rm PT}$）；全局两时模型中的模型定理 `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator`、`prop:appO-twoexch-regulated`、`prop:appO-halfcoinc-sensitivity`、`prop:appO-pergraph-weights`（模型内完整证明；作为 QCD 陈述为 [P]）。
给出全阶论证：`prop:appO-past-wilson`（\tagA：Wilson 线指向过去；逐项匹配归入 `asm:appO-rewritten-cs`）；`prop:appO-g6-ladder`（\tagA：$O(g^6)$ 直接线梯形图类在幺正性下不封闭）。

没有证明：LCOPT 的零模与瞬时圈（`asm:appO-lcopt`）；纤维积分误差的可积包络（`asm:appO-envelope`，对重合连接按侧求和族施加）；一般软子图与同一部分子上非对易插入的完整图集相消（`asm:appO-mixing`）；一般构型的形变、与区域集合代数的相容性、软角区、H-发射端点（`asm:appO-deformation`，(b)(c)(d) **即使对阿贝尔理论与 $\mathcal G_0$ 也需要**）；改写形式的 (CS1)(CS2)（`asm:appO-rewritten-cs`）；被割的直接 SS 线（实发射，`rem:appO-cut-ss`）；共线端点的匹配（`asm:appO-collinear-ends`）及 QCD 喷注的 (ADJ)(REAL)（`asm:appO-adjacent-swap`、`asm:appO-real-jets`；三者只进入模型定理的 QCD 转移，不是 `thm:appO-main` 的前提）。外态为色单态微扰模型；非微扰强子见 `asm:intro-bridge`。

items.label: asm:appO-lcopt
items.title: 光锥序微扰论的适用性
items.entry:
- **假设 `asm:appO-lcopt` — 光锥序微扰论的适用性** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for a DY leading region and $J=J_A$ (likewise $J_B$): (i) (zero modes, endpoints, truncation) on $U_R$, in the integral norm, the regularized Feynman integral of $J$ equals up to $O(\lambda^a)$ the iterated integral "all internal minus components over $\mathbb R$ first (`lem:appO-lcopt`, `lem:appO-numerators`), then plus and transverse components over $\{l^+\ne0\}$"; distributions concentrated at $l^+=0$ and endpoint contributions of plus integrals are absent at leading power, and the minus-component restriction of `def:method-neighbourhoods` can be dropped (removed tail $O(\lambda_J/\lambda^\beta)$); (ii) (instantaneous loops) there is an assignment of the one-dimensional integrals of `lem:appO-numerators`(v) (depending only on plus and transverse components) for which the minus integral equals the expansion of `lem:appO-numerators`. Item (iii) of the earlier formulation (Hermiticity of the cut rules for ghost and three-gluon vertices) is **not** an assumption: it is `lem:appJ-cut-hermiticity` (App J). `\uses{lem:appO-lcopt, lem:appO-numerators, def:method-neighbourhoods}`.
- Figure `fig:appO-lcopt-term` (FIGURES_INDEX_v2 S15): one LCOPT term of $J_A$ (amplitude side) with $V_H$ at $\tau=0$, two soft injections, denominators $D_1,\dots,D_5$ marked initial/final.

items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-adjacent-swap` — 相邻交换对称性（ADJ）** [\tagP]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. items.label: asm:appO-collinear-ends
items.title: 共线端点的匹配
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-collinear-ends` — 共线端点的匹配** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: the SS windows carry the two-sided analytic rapidity regulators of `def:appO-regulator-class`(c); the complements — the $A$-collinear end ($|k^+|\gtrsim K^+$) and the $B$-collinear end ($|k^-|\gtrsim K^-$), together with the cut contributions located there — are assigned to the collinear regions, where collinear factorization (Wilson lines and subtraction terms) reproduces them with no leftover Hermitian $C_AX$ term (fully coincident pattern) and no leftover $[X_1,X_2]$ term (half-coincident pattern). It **relocates**, rather than removes, the content of `asm:appO-mixing`(c) for the coincident $O(g^4)$ patterns; it is not a premise of `thm:appO-main` or `thm:dy-factorization`. `\uses{def:appO-regulator-class, def:appO-glob-model}`.

items.label: prop:appO-twoexch-spectator
items.title: 全重合 SS 对的 $O(g^4)$ 侧求和（未割线）：全局两时模型中的相消
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement (model theorem, WRITER_SPEC_v2 §4.3 item 4): the model-internal statement (a) is fully proved; the QCD transfer (b) rests on the \tagP entries; the physical reading (c) rests on `asm:appO-collinear-ends` and on the open cut contributions. Prior art: the physical $O(\alpha_s^2)$ cancellation for this pattern in explicit two-loop model calculations — `Lindsay:1983ny` (meson + meson, Feynman gauge, all graphs) and `Brandt:1988xt` (eikonal "mesons"); the reggeization reading is textbook (`Fadin:1975cb`, `KuraevLipatovFadin1977`, `RothsteinStewart2016`). Ours: the derivation for general LCOPT jets with explicit estimates, the ray-identity mechanism and the regulator analysis (it extends ERR-S1 from eikonal lines to composite spectators); no novelty marker (the check of `CollinsSoperSterman1988` and `Collins2011` §14.4 for non-commuting coincident exchanges is open). Slot X1f: PARTIAL (inserted as a model theorem; the first sentence states the restrictions).
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator` — 全重合 SS 对的 $O(g^4)$ 侧求和（未割线）：全局两时模型中的相消** [P]. 本命题是关于全局两时模型 $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$（`def:appO-glob-model`）的陈述：在 $\mathcal N_A\cap\mathcal N_B$ 上逐点、$O(g^4)$、两条**未割**的 SS 线连接同一个 $A$ 旁观者 $i$ 与同一个 $B$ 旁观者 $j$（振幅侧），且满足下述 (iv)(v)。Hypotheses: (i) $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$ with exact connecting propagators; (ii) $J_A$ satisfies (SEC), (EQ), (REAL), and $J_B$ satisfies (SEC), (EQ), (ADJ), (REAL); (iii) the configuration lies in $\mathcal N_A\cap\mathcal N_B$; (iv) $\varepsilon\le\min(\frac1{16},a_{\min}^2/(4a_1a_2))$; (v) $\delta_Y\le\frac12$ (an explicit combination of the error terms, not implied by (iv)). (a) *(model-internal; complete proof)* $|N/N_0-1|\le C_N\varepsilon^{1/2}(1+L_B)^2$, $|{\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}|\le C_T\varepsilon^{1/2}(1+L_B)^2(1+L)$ and $|{\rm Im}\,p_{\rm opp}+\frac1\pi\ln\frac1\varepsilon|\le C_I$, with $C_N,C_T,C_I$ explicit polynomials in $m_A,m^\flat_A,m^\flat_B,m_B,c_\rho,a_{\max}/a_{\min}$ and the logarithms $\ell_A=\ln(1+\lambda_A/\mu_A)$, $\ell_B=\ln(1+16\lambda_B/\mu_B)$, $L_B=\ln(1+4\varepsilon^{-1/2}\lambda_B/\mu_B)$; hence the uncut-line side-sum residual $-\frac12C_A\chi^2({\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp})X$ is power suppressed, and the $C_A$ term of $\mathcal M^{(2)}$ equals $(-i\chi X)(-C_A\chi\ln(1/\varepsilon)/(4\pi))$ at leading-logarithmic accuracy — a real multiple of the anti-Hermitian one-exchange amplitude (the gluon reggeization phase). (b) *(QCD jets)* for leading-power cut-summed LCOPT jets of QCD graphs (SEC), (EQ) hold under `asm:appO-lcopt`, and (ADJ), (REAL) are `asm:appO-adjacent-swap`, `asm:appO-real-jets`; (a) holds for them conditionally (content [P], set by the tags of these entries); in the scalar spectator model all hypotheses (ii) hold exactly. (c) *(physical reading)* within App O's framework the side sum of the **uncut** direct lines cancels once the window is combined with the adjacent near-shell region of the same lines: the $-\frac12$ is generated at the $A$-collinear end on the rotated contour, i.e. in the near-mass-shell region $2k^+k^-\sim\mathbf k_T^2$ on the real contour (absent with the strict propagator, `prop:appO-strict-window-shape`), so the physical content needs `asm:appO-collinear-ends`; the cut direct lines (real emission, inside $\mathcal G_0$) are not included (`rem:appO-cut-ss`), so this does **not** establish the $\mathcal G_0$-restricted complete-set clause and does not refute `asm:appO-mixing`(c); nothing is claimed for the spectator-integrated cross section.

items.label: prop:appO-twoexch-regulated
items.title: 正规化版本、端点极点与双侧正规子
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement (model theorem): (a), (b) are fully proved in the model, (c) is numerical; the physical reading rests on `asm:appO-collinear-ends`. Ours (no novelty marker).
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-twoexch-regulated` — 正规化版本、端点极点与双侧正规子** [P]. 本命题是关于全局两时模型 $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$ 的陈述（$O(g^4)$，全重合 SS 对，未割线）。(a) *(model-internal; complete proof)* under the hypotheses of `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator` except $\mathcal N_A$, with a class-$\mathfrak X$ regulator $\prod_e\chi(k_e^+)$, $\lambda_B\ll K_c\ll a/\lambda_A$: ${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}=O\big((\lambda_B/K_c)^{1/2}+K_c\lambda_A/a\big)$ up to logarithms (mirror statement with a $k^-$ regulator on $\mathcal N_A$); the real part is regulator independent only for regulators that retain the near-shell segment. (b) *(end poles; model-internal, complete proof)* without a regulator and without $\mathcal N_A$ (on $\mathcal N_B$): ${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}=-\frac12\sum_p{\rm Res}_{k_p}(\rho_{12}+\rho_{21})/k_p+O(\text{power})$; only the final-gap energies of the mixed sectors enter; the poles sit at the $A$-collinear end $k^+\sim a/\lambda_A$ — artefacts of $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$ for massive spectators, genuine $A$-collinear configurations for massless ones (assigned to the collinear region by `asm:appO-collinear-ends`, or removed by (a)); in the scalar spectator model ${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}=\frac12a_1\alpha_1/(a_1\alpha_1+a_2|d_{10}|)$ if $\alpha_1>0$ (numerically 0.2520 against the predicted 0.2517 at $\lambda=0.001$). (c) *(two-sided analytic regulators; numerical)* with $\chi^+(k^+)$ at $K^+$ and an even, line-identical $\chi^-(k^-)$ at $K^-$: ${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}\to0$ when the near-shell segment is retained ($K^+K^-\gg\mathbf k_T^2$) and $\to\frac12$ when it is excluded ($K^+K^-\ll\mathbf k_T^2$; the value then depends on the regulator shape, `prop:appO-strict-window-shape`), through a crossover (${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}=0.149$ at $K^+K^-/a=1$); the cut contributions are not part of this computation. `\uses{prop:appO-twoexch-spectator, def:appO-regulator-class, lem:appO-multipole-localization, lem:appO-ray-identity, asm:appO-collinear-ends}`. Proof: (a), (b) as for `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator` with the regulator inserted (`lem:appO-ray-identity` with axis poles for (b)); (c) numerical (X1 `fix_r1_scripts/regulator_indep.py`, reproduced on the real contour by a reviewer). **地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement (model theorem): (a), (b) are fully proved in the model, (c) is numerical; the physical reading rests on `asm:appO-collinear-ends`. Ours (no novelty marker).

items.label: prop:appO-pergraph-weights
items.title: 全重合对的逐图次序权重不由窗口数据决定
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement: (a), (b) are statements about the defined class in the model with complete proofs; whether graph-generated QCD jets realize the perturbation of (b) is open; QCD membership as in `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator`(b). Ours; it sharpens ERR-S3.
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-pergraph-weights` — 全重合对的逐图次序权重不由窗口数据决定** [P]. 本命题是关于全局两时模型 $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$ 中所述喷注函数类的陈述（$O(g^4)$，全重合对，未割线）。Class: $J_A$ with (SEC), (EQ), (REAL) on $\mathcal N_A$; $J_B$ with (SEC), (EQ), (ADJ), (REAL) on $\mathcal N_B$; window data $D=(D_{\rm win}(J_A),D_{\rm win}(J_B),a_e,\mathbf k_{Te})$, $D_{\rm win}(J_X)=\{\mathcal J_\sigma\ \text{for all sectors};\lambda_X\}$. (a) *(model, proved)* $W(12,21)=W^{\rm in}+W^{\rm out}$ with $W^{\rm out}=-\frac i{2\pi}\int_K^\infty\frac{d\kappa}\kappa\varrho_{12}(\kappa)+O(\lambda_B/K)$ and $W^{\rm in}$ depending on $J_A$ only through $D$ up to $O(\lambda_AK/a_{\min})$. (b) *(model, proved)* adding to the mixed sector $1V2$ of $J_A$ the two-state term $s\,c_2\frac i{A_1+k_1}\frac i{A_2+k_1}\frac i{A'-k_2}$ ($c_2=-i\tilde c_2$, $\tilde c_2/\mathcal J_A$ real, $|A_{1,2}|\le\lambda_A$, $A_1,A_2,A'<0$) preserves (SEC), (EQ), (REAL) and $D$ (it breaks (ADJ) for $J_A$, which the class does not require) and shifts $W(12,21)$ by a purely imaginary amount that is **non-zero whenever $\tilde c_2\ne0$**. (c) *(numerical)* with in-window regulators the $A$-side out-of-window dependence is suppressed, but the per-graph weights still depend on the in-window shape of the mixed sectors of $J_B$ (a shift $-0.0287i$ in an explicit example that leaves $D_{\rm win}(J_B)$, (EQ), (ADJ), (REAL) unchanged). Consequence: within the class no per-graph jet-local rewriting by window data can satisfy per-graph weak equivalence for coincident pairs; all shifts are purely imaginary in the side sum, so ${\rm Re}\,p_{\rm opp}$ is unaffected, and `asm:appO-envelope` must be imposed on side-summed families for coincident connections. `\uses{def:appO-glob-model, lem:appO-quadrant-residues, prop:appO-twoexch-spectator, asm:appO-adjacent-swap, asm:appO-real-jets}`. Proof: (a), (b) Step 4 of the proof of `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator` per colour pair with `lem:appO-quadrant-residues`; Cauchy's theorem for the shift integral (the shift density has a fixed sign on $(0,\infty)$); (c) numerical (X1 `fix_r2_scripts/p4_regulated_B.py`). **地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement: (a), (b) are statements about the defined class in the model with complete proofs; whether graph-generated QCD jets realize the perturbation of (b) is open; QCD membership as in `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator`(b). Ours; it sharpens ERR-S3.

items.label: rem:appO-halfcoinc
items.title: 半重合对：无正规子的两时模型
items.entry: - **注 `rem:appO-halfcoinc` — 半重合对：无正规子的两时模型** (no tag). In $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$, on $\mathcal N_B$, at $O(g^4)$, for two **uncut** SS lines $i$–$j_1$, $i$–$j_2$ ($j_1\ne j_2$) without a rapidity regulator: the side-sum residual is $\mathcal R=2ic_1c_2\,{\rm Im}W_{12}[X_1,X_2]$ (`lem:appO-halfcoinc-colour`(a)) with ${\rm Im}W_{12}=O(1)$ in general (scalar model: $W_{12}\to0.5-0.030559i$; symmetric configurations ${\rm Im}W_{12}=0$; model numerics [P]); its colour factor vanishes for valence remnants and real colour states, including the model's own configuration (`lem:appO-halfcoinc-colour`(c),(d)); the coincident SA patterns ($i$–$j_e$ together with $i$–$b$) carry the same colour structure after colour conservation and were not included; only uncut lines are included (`rem:appO-cut-ss`); for exact on-shell lines the residual is expected to be absent (`rem:appO-onshell-unitarity`, not certified). The fate in QCD is the matching of `asm:appO-collinear-ends` at the $k^-$ end, together with the cut contributions (open, Ch25). The configuration does not occur in `Lindsay:1983ny`, `Brandt:1988xt` (one spectator per hadron) or `Lindsay:1983dt` (no $A$-spectator).

items.label: prop:appO-halfcoinc-sensitivity
items.title: 半重合对：$W_{12}$ 的实部与对 $k^-$ 正规子的敏感性
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement (model theorem): (a)–(c) are proved in the model; the QCD transfer needs (ADJ), (REAL) (\tagP entries) and the physical reading `asm:appO-collinear-ends` (open, together with the cut contributions); the fate of the colour factor for generic remnants is open (`lem:appO-halfcoinc-colour`). Ours (no novelty marker before the literature check).
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-halfcoinc-sensitivity` — 半重合对：$W_{12}$ 的实部与对 $k^-$ 正规子的敏感性** [P]. 本命题是关于全局两时模型 $\mathbb M_{\rm glob}$ 的陈述（在 $\mathcal N_B$ 上、$O(g^4)$、两条未割的 SS 线 $i$–$j_1$、$i$–$j_2$）。Hypotheses: $J_A$ with (SEC), (EQ); $J_B$ with (SEC), (EQ), (ADJ), (REAL); $\varepsilon\ll1$ with smallness conditions as in `prop:appO-twoexch-spectator`. (a) *(model, proved)* $W_{12}=\frac12-\frac1{\mathcal J_B}\int v(\kappa)f_B(\kappa)\frac{d^2\kappa}{(2\pi)^2}+E_b$ with a purely imaginary integral and $|E_b|\le C_b\varepsilon(1+L')^2$, $L'=\ln(1+a/(\lambda_A\mu_B))$; hence ${\rm Re}\,W_{12}=\frac12+O(\varepsilon L'^2)$. (b) *(model, proved)* ${\rm Im}W_{12}=0$ for configurations symmetric under $1\leftrightarrow2$. (c) *(model, proved: sensitivity)* with the even Lorentzian regulator $\chi_K(k^-)$ on the $A$-side minus components of both lines, $\lambda_A\ll K\ll a/\lambda_B$: $|W_{12}(K)-\frac12|\le C_e\big[\frac{K\lambda_B}{a_{\min}}(1+\ln(1+\frac{a_{\min}}{K\mu_B}))^2+\frac{\lambda_A}K(1+\ln(1+\frac{a_{\min}}{K\mu_B}))^2+\varepsilon(1+L')^2\big]$, every term boost invariant and $C_e$ an explicit polynomial in $m_A,m^\flat_A,m^\flat_B,a_{\max}/a_{\min}$: any in-window Lorentzian suppression of $|k^-|\gtrsim K$ removes the $O(1)$ part of ${\rm Im}W_{12}$ up to this bound (an instability under such regulators, not a statement that the $O(1)$ part is "not determined by the integrand on a window"). (d) *(numerical)* ${\rm Im}W_{12}(K)$ is linear in $K$ up to slowly varying factors (the logarithms of (c) are not sharp). The half-coincident part of `asm:appO-collinear-ends` is thus proved in the model with the $k^-$ regulator **alone**; adding the class-$\mathfrak X$ $k^+$ factor is expected to cost $O(a/(K^+K^-))$ (not proved). `\uses{def:appO-glob-model, def:appO-regulator-class, lem:appO-multipole-localization, lem:appO-kplus-rotation, lem:appO-two-insertion-bounds, lem:appO-halfcoinc-colour, asm:appO-adjacent-swap, asm:appO-real-jets, asm:appO-collinear-ends}`. Proof: (a) `lem:appO-kplus-rotation`, $A$-side localization and the $S$-type bounds of `lem:appO-two-insertion-bounds` for $f_B$; imaginarity by (REAL) and the oddness of $v$; (c) rotation to $\theta=\pi/4$ with the regulator, localization with `lem:appO-multipole-localization` ($\sum|w|\le2$, $c_U\le1+\sqrt2$), $|v_K|\le\min(\frac12,8KR/a_{\min})$, integration with `lem:appO-two-insertion-bounds`(h); (d) X1 `final_scripts/t3f_recompute.py`. **地位与缺口.** [P] as a QCD statement (model theorem): (a)–(c) are proved in

items.label: prop:appO-g6-ladder
items.title: $O(g^6)$：直接线梯形图类在幺正性下不封闭
items.status: 地位与缺口.** [A]: an argument with standard substance (BFKL); the interference identity and its sign are checked numerically for eikonal currents, not proven in general; the formulation (closure of the direct-line class) is ours. The fully coincident two-line ladder class from $O(g^6)$ on therefore needs `asm:appO-mixing`(c); expected, not shown, for the other coincident patterns.
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-g6-ladder` — $O(g^6)$：直接线梯形图类在幺正性下不封闭** [A]. Two on-shell eikonal (or massive) lines $A$, $B$; $\mathsf C$ = the class of direct-line ladder graphs at $O(g^6)$ (all three gluons join the two lines, any crossings); unitarity defect $D_{\mathsf C}={\rm Disc}_s(\sum_{\Gamma\in\mathsf C}\Gamma)-\int d\Phi_2(\mathcal M_{\mathsf C})^\dagger\mathcal M_{\mathsf C}$ at $O(g^6)$. (i) *(interference form)* by Cutkosky's rules graph by graph, $D_{\mathsf C}$ is the sum of the three-particle cuts of class-$\mathsf C$ graphs, which cut one rung whose ends lie on opposite sides of the cut: $D_{\mathsf C}=\int d\Phi_3[A_A^\dagger A_B+A_B^\dagger A_A]$, the interference of emission from line $A$ with emission from line $B$ (the self terms lie outside $\mathsf C$); $A_X$ is the tree $2\to3$ amplitude with one gluon exchanged between the lines and one radiated from line $X$ (emissions before and after the exchange combined), with exchanged-gluon propagators $1/\mathbf q_2^{\,2}$ and $1/\mathbf q_1^{\,2}$ ($q_1$, $q_2$ the momenta exchanged on either side of the emission). (ii) *(sign in Feynman gauge)* for straight lines the line parts of the Lipatov vertex give $A_A\propto C\,v_A^\mu/(v_A\cdot k)$, $A_B\propto-C\,v_B^\mu/(v_B\cdot k)$, $C=f^{a_1a_2b}T_A^{a_1}T_B^{a_2}$, and $D_{\mathsf C}\propto\int d\Phi_3\,\frac{2\,C^\dagger C\,(v_A\cdot v_B)^3}{(v_A\cdot k)(v_B\cdot k)\,q_1^2q_2^2}>0$; the self terms $-C^\dagger C\,v_X^2/(v_X\cdot k)^2\le0$ vanish for light-like lines. (iii) *(gauge dependence)* $\mathsf C$ is **not gauge invariant** without the central (three-gluon) term of the Lipatov vertex, so $D_{\mathsf C}$ is gauge dependent; the full $2\to3$ amplitude squared is gauge invariant (conserved total current). Conclusion: in Feynman gauge with eikonal lines $D_{\mathsf C}\ne0$ — the class is not closed under unitarity, and the gauge-invariant $2\to3$ amplitude needs the full Lipatov vertex; in Drell–Yan part of this real emission corresponds to cut direct lines (inside $\mathcal G_0$), part to soft lines emitted and absorbed by one spectator (outside $\mathcal G_0$). It concerns the closure of $\mathcal G_0$ under unitarity (the SS-family bookkeeping), not a failure of factorization; consistent with `Schwartz:2018obd` (pure Glauber ladders cancel for single-scale observables; the leading violation needs the Lipatov vertex) and `RothsteinStewart2016`. `\uses{prop:dy-eikonal-twogluon, lem:appO-glauber-operator}`. Proof plan: Cutkosky's rules (`Cutkosky1

items.label: asm:appO-envelope
items.title: 纤维积分误差的可积包络
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-envelope` — 纤维积分误差的可积包络** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for each leading region $R$ there is $\hat\Phi_R\ge0$ on $U_R$, independent of the localized soft components, with $\int_{U_R}\hat\Phi_R\,d\hat\mu\le CL^K$ uniformly in $\varepsilon\in(0,\varepsilon_0]$ and in the $i0$ regulator $\eta_0$, such that for $\Gamma$ and every chain term $T_c\Gamma$: (i) the fibre-integration error of each unit localization (`prop:appO-ss-localize`, the remainder of `lem:appO-equal-time`(iii), the remainder of `lem:appO-joint-localization`(b), truncation terms at fibre endpoints), with the other $i0$ replaced by $i\eta_0$, is bounded pointwise by $C\lambda^a\hat\Phi_R$; (ii) on boundary layers of relative width $\lambda^a$ (including fibre endpoints set by neighbourhoods $N_{R'}$ with $\beta_{R'}>\beta_R$), $\int\hat\Phi_R\le C\lambda^aL^K$. **For coincident connections the bounds are imposed on side-summed families** (rewording v2.3: within the class of `prop:appO-pergraph-weights` the per-graph version cannot hold; for graph-generated jets the per-graph question is open). `\uses{def:appO-rewriting, def:appO-windows}`.

items.title: Glauber–软混合与重合连接的完整图集相消
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-mixing` — Glauber–软混合与重合连接的完整图集相消** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: $\Gamma$ a DY forward graph, $R$ a leading region, windows as in `def:appO-windows`, $\hat\Phi_R$ as in `asm:appO-envelope`. (a′) (*pre-integration localization with envelope bounds*; replaces the earlier half-plane splitting clause (a)) localization is performed before the integration over the internal loops of $S$, pointwise outside the exceptional sets $E_j$ of `lem:appO-preintegration-localization`; assumed: envelope bounds $C\lambda^aL^K$ (i) for the $S$-loop integral of the absolute localization error, including the factor $\sum_\sigma|w_\sigma(p)|$ when there are several insertions, and (ii) for the unlocalized integrand on the $E_j$ — these bounds also justify the Fubini interchange; same for $J_B$; (b) (*cut compatibility of $S$*) after the localization of (a′) the cut sum of $J_A\otimes J_B\otimes S$ takes the closed-time-path form of `lem:appO-unitarity` with $S$'s fields as $\langle0|\bar{\rm T}\{\cdots\}{\rm T}\{\cdots\}|0\rangle$, and the $\tau=0$ insertions with both ends on spectators (also through $S$) assemble into operators on $\mathcal H_A\otimes\mathcal H_B\otimes\mathcal H_S$; (c) (*complete graph set*) for the set $\mathfrak G$ of all forward graphs of the given order with the given $J_A$, $J_B$ (closed under adding soft three- and four-gluon vertices between Glauber and soft lines, including real soft emission through Lipatov-type vertices), summed over all coincident connections and side assignments, combining the window with the adjacent near-on-shell soft region of $U_R$ (including real emission), the contribution after $\mathfrak P$ is $O(\lambda^aL^K)$ in the weak sense; equivalently $\mathcal W'^\dagger\mathcal W=1+O(\lambda^a)$ on spectator states at $\tau=0$. The per-graph fixed-order clause of the earlier formulation is deleted (replaced by `lem:appO-joint-localization`). Status sentence (v2.3): (c) holds for two-gluon exchange between eikonal lines at $O(g^4)$ (`prop:dy-eikonal-twogluon`); for composite spectators in the global two-time model the uncut-line part of the fully coincident $O(g^4)$ family cancels pointwise on NF (`prop:appO-twoexch-spectator`, model theorem); the cut direct lines, the half-coincident pattern at the collinear ends, $O(g^6)$ (`prop:appO-g6-ladder`) and coincident SA/AS insertions are open. `\uses{def:appO-windows, def:appO-family, def:appO-weak-equivalence, asm:appO-envelope, lem:appO-unitarity,

items.label: asm:appO-deformation
items.title: 一般构型、相容性、软角区与 H-发射端点
items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-deformation` — 一般构型、相容性、软角区与 H-发射端点** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: for any $\Gamma$, $R$, $F=\tilde F_{\Gamma,R}$: (a) a deformation target exists (Glauber flows; two separately conserved flows on localized legs with imaginary parts $\le$ half the carrier width; internal deformations of $S$; single-leg-type components moved in the component their jet does not see) with the sign condition of `lem:appO-no-crossing`(a), $|q_e^+||q_e^-|\ge cq_{Te}^2$, and no denominator of $S$ crossed; (b) the target is compatible with $\mathfrak B$ (`def:appO-target`(d)); (c) on the soft-angle region — including the out-of-window parts of the side-independent windows and the wee-line endpoint region of `lem:appO-side-independent-windows`(c); the window-edge terms themselves vanish identically —, (CS1)$_R$ and (CS2)$_R$ hold for the rewritten forms: $\int_{h_1(U_R)}(1-\prod_u\Theta'_u)\big(|\mathfrak r_R(1-T_R)X_R[F_\Gamma]|+\sum_{R'\not\le R}|\mathfrak r_RC_{R'}F_\Gamma|\big)d\mu_\Omega\le C\lambda^aL^K$; (d) for regions with H-emission endpoints **and for coincident SA/AS insertions** (non-analytic ordering weights), a weakly equivalent rewriting exists in which each uncut soft momentum appears in each jet only in denominators of one orientation or only in carriers, with a deformation target such that `prop:appO-eikonal` and `prop:appO-past-wilson` hold. (a) is proved for $\mathcal G_0$ and graded configurations (`prop:appO-target`); **(b)(c)(d) are needed even for abelian $\mathcal G_0$**. `\uses{def:appO-target, def:appO-rewriting, def:appO-graded, prop:appO-ss-cancel, lem:appO-side-independent-windows}`.

items.entry: - **假设 `asm:appO-rewritten-cs` — 改写形式与族求和形式的 Collins 条件** [\tagA]. Full text in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`. Content: (CS1)$_R$ and (CS2)$_R$ of `def:method-collins-conditions` hold for the rewritten forms $\mathfrak r_R(\cdot)$ and for the family-summed forms $\sum_{\mathfrak F}\mathfrak P[\cdot]$ on $h_1^{(R)}(U_R)$, including (i) the term-by-term matching of the localized spectator terms (plus the $(1-T_R)$ errors) with the external-endpoint distributions at $n_A\cdot K_i=0$ that fixes the Wilson-line prescription, and (ii) the allocation of localized SA/AS endpoints between the region $R$ and the $A$-collinear region $R'$ (the $A$-end Glauber recoil is not reproduced by $T_R$; overlap = zero-bin). Glauber specific (absent in DIS and $e^+e^-$); harmless for collinear PDFs (direction irrelevant), substantive for TMD. `\uses{def:method-collins-conditions, def:appO-rewriting, def:appO-family}`.

items.title: Ward 恒等式与指向过去的 Wilson 线
items.status: 地位与缺口」: [A] because of step (3); harmless for collinear factorization (soft-factor unitarity holds for past, future or mixed directions), substantive for TMD (staple direction; Sivers sign). VF-REF-11 (single cut graph = future-pointing line, step 2); VF-WL-1 (eikonal rules); directions as in §00.5 of this file. Literature: `Collins2002`, `Collins2011` §14.4, `CollinsSoperSterman1988`.
items.entry: - **命题 `prop:appO-past-wilson` — Ward 恒等式与指向过去的 Wilson 线** [A]. Under `prop:appO-eikonal`, on $\Omega=\Omega_R$, summing all graphs and all attachments of soft gluons and longitudinal collinear gluons: (a) for the soft-approximated cut-summed integrand (the soft-factorized part of subtraction terms), the sum of all soft attachments to $J_A$ (including final-state spectators and lines emitted by $V_H$) equals, where the eikonal denominators are non-zero, $J_A$ without soft attachments times a Wilson line along $n_A$ ending at $V_H$; with the prescription fixed by the deformation it is the past-pointing $W[0,-\infty n_A]$, eikonal factors $\prod_i\frac{i}{n_A\cdot K_i+i0}$ (conjugate: Hermitian conjugate at $V_H^\dagger$); soft attachments to $J_B$ give $W[0,-\infty n_B]$; $A$-collinear longitudinal gluons attached to $H$ or $J_B$ give the past-pointing line $W[\cdot,-\infty n_B]$ in $A$'s collinear factor (direction irrelevant for collinear PDFs, `prop:method-collinear-wilson`); (b) the soft factor is $S^{(-)}(k_{\rm tot})=\sum_{X_s}\langle0|\bar{\rm T}[\mathcal U^{(-)\dagger}]|X_s\rangle\langle X_s|{\rm T}[\mathcal U^{(-)}]|0\rangle\delta^4(k_{\rm tot}-p_{X_s})$, $\mathcal U^{(-)}=W[0,-\infty n_A]\,W[0,-\infty n_B]$ (colour charges in the representations of the active partons); (c) localized SS endpoints cancel in the family sum (`prop:appO-ss-cancel`); SA endpoints belong, in the $A$-collinear region, to $J_A$ and become part of $A$'s past-pointing line (the $i0$ comes from $J_B$'s initial denominator); the term-by-term agreement on $U_R$ is `asm:appO-rewritten-cs`. `\uses{prop:appO-eikonal, prop:appO-ss-cancel, asm:appO-rewritten-cs, asm:appN-ward-product, lem:method-ward-multi, prop:method-soft-wilson, prop:method-collinear-wilson, prop:prelim-wilson-rules, lem:appO-no-crossing}`. items.label: rem:appO-literature-comparison
items.title: 与其他全阶论证的比较；TMD 版本；有争议的提议
items.entry: - **注 `rem:appO-literature-comparison` — 与其他全阶论证的比较；TMD 版本；有争议的提议** (no tag). (1) *Graph-by-graph argument* (`Diehl:2015bca` §4, single DY): region approximants with subtraction terms integrated over all loop momenta (soft–collinear overlaps removed by the subtraction terms of larger regions); cut sums in LCPT; the final-state factor of $A$, summed over cuts and integrated over $k^-$, equals 0 or 1, so the final-state pinches disappear (with a routing assumption the authors state as "desirable to have a formal proof"); Grammer–Yennie and Ward identities give Wilson lines. Each forward graph has a fixed colour factor and insertions are never localized at equal times in both jets, so **no ordering weights arise**: no gap of that argument is identified here, and every "needed / not needed" statement about `asm:appO-mixing`(c) in this appendix is relative to App O's two-time framework. (2) `AybatSterman2009`: an outline in hybrid LCOPT form; spectator attachments cancel by their causal identity (the sector-sum identity of `lem:appO-joint-localization`(c)).
